around the glassy sea,
Cherubim & Seraphim falling down before Thee
Which wert, and art, and evennore shall be.
Holy, holy, holy! though the hardness hideThee
Though the eyes of sinful man
Thy glory may not see
Only thou an holy: there is none beside Thee
Perfect in power, in love and purity.
Holy, holy, holy! Lord God Almighty
All Thy works shall praise Thy
name, in earth, and sky and sea:
Holy, holy, holy! Merciful and Mighty,
God in Three Persons, Blessed Trinity. Amen
hymns.author: Reginald Heber

hymns.title: Father, before thy Throne of Light
lyrics: FATHER, before thy throne of light
The guardian angels bend
And ever in thy presence bright
Their psalms adoring blend
And casting down each golden crown
Beside the crystal Sea
With voice and lyres in happy choir
Hymn glory, Lord to thee.
And as the rainbow, lustre fails
Athwart their glowing wing
While Seraph unto Seraph calls
And each thy goodness sings
Oh! may we feel, as low we kneel
To pray thee for thy grace
That thou art here for all who fear
The brightness of thy face.
Here where the Angels see us come
To worship day by day
Teach us to seek our heavenly home
And serve thee e'ven as they
With Cherubim and Seraphim
With them thy love to own
Till life’s first flower and fullness Power
BeThine and Thine alone. Amen
hymns.author: Frederic William Farrar

hymns.title: Spirit Divine Attend our Prayers
lyrics: SPIRIT Divine attend our prayers
And make this house Thy home
Descend with all Thy gracious power
Oh come, Great Spirit come.
Come as the light to us reveal
Our emptiness and woe
And lead us in those paths of life
Where all the righteous go.
Come as the fire and purge our heart
Like sacrificial flame
Let our whole soul an offering be
To our redeemer's name.
Come as the dew, and sweetly bless
This consecrated hour,
May harmless rejoice to own
Thy fertilizing power.
Come as the dove, and spread thy wings
Thy wings of peaceful love
And let thy Church on earth become
Bless’d as the Church above.
Spirit Divine attend our prayers
Make a lost world thy home
Desoend with all Thy gracious powers
Oh come, Great Spirit, Come. Amen
hymns.author: Andrew Reed

hymns.title: Come Thou Holy Paraclete
lyrics: COME,Thou Holy Paraclete
And fromThy celestial sent
Send Thy light and brilliancy.
Father of the poor, draw near
Giver of all gifts, be here
Come, the soul’s true radiaancy.
Come, of comforters the best
Of the soul the sweetest Guest
Come in tail refreshingly.
Thou in labour rest most sweet
Thou art shadow from the heat
Comfort in adversity.
O Thou Light, most pure and blest
Shine within the inmost breast
Of Thy faithful company.
Where Thou art not, man hath nought
Every holy deed and thought
Comes from Thy Divinity.
What is soiled, make Thou pure
What is wounded, work its cure
What is parched, fortify.
Cold and hard hearts quicken Thou,
Stubborn necks to Jesus bow
Draw the wanderer tenderly.
Fill Thy faithful, who confide
ln Thy power to guard and guide
With Thy Sevenfold Mystery.
Here Thy grace and virtue send
Grant Salvation to the end
And in heaven felicity. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: The Earth is the Lord’s and his Alone
lyrics: THE EARTH is the Lord’s and His alone
The world with all its creatures
He found its foundation on the seas
And on the roaring forties.
Who will ascend on the Holy Hill
The Holy Hill of the Lord
Who will ever stand before the King
The Holy King of Glory.
He who lives holy life all his days
And also keeps holy heart
Whose heart never raise to vanity
And no deceit in his tongues.
These only will receive His blessings
Blessings from the Lord of Host
We who daily ask Thy face Oh! God
Daily in Thy Holy Courts.
Only those who daily seek Thy face
Thy merciful face Oh God
We who daily lift up all our hearts
And hands in holy temple.
hymns.author: Cherubim & Seraphim Church
chorus: Lift up your heads
Oh Holy Gates be ye lifted up
King of glory to enter.

hymns.title: The Earth is the Lord's our God
lyrics: THE EARTH is the Lord's our God,
And all the fullness thereof
The world and all Living creature
Dwelling now and evermore.
Who' will ascend to the Lord's Hill
And on to His Holy place,
He that keeps his bands ever clean
And pure heart in all his days.
He that lifted not his heart on
All the Worldly vanity
And Swearth not deceitfully
Shall lack not the Lord‘s Blessing.
This is the Generation seeking
Face of the God of Jacob
They that standeth by the Lord God
Shall lack not the Lord's Blessing.
Lift up your heads O ye Holy gates
And be ye lifted up high
O ye everlasting Gate
Let the King of Glory in.
And who is the King of Glory
O Lord, God of all the Hosts
Who has full might in the battle
Is the Lord King of Glory.
Lift up your heads O Ye Gate
Let The King of Glory in
And who is the King of Glory?
O Lord God of All the Hosts.
hymns.author: anon
chorus: Marvellous are aII thy works
O Lord god of all the Host
Glory, Honour and The Power
To the Holy Trinity.

hymns.title: Holy Father Draw Nigh Unto us
lyrics: HOLY Father draw nigh unto us
Holy Son please draw nigh unto us
Holy Spirit draw nigh unto us
We draw nigh unto Thee to bless us.
Abide with us Jehovah‐Jireh
Dwell in our hearts we beseech Thee Lord
With Thy merciful eyes look on us
Firmly build this Band Lord God of Host.
Give unto us thy spirit Good Lord
That we may all serve Thee to the end
And direct Thee O Lord our band
That we may gain Thy Kingdom O Lord.
Provide for all our members O Lord
To the jobless provide work O Lord
Let us all not lament Lord we pray
Let Thy blessing go round all of us.
When we depart from world to Thy hand
Let us be acceptable to Thee
That we may reign with Jesus our Lord
Before Thy Holy Trinity Throne.
That we may hear that voice at the end
Come to me thou blessed ones of God
Enter on to the joy of thy Lord
With the Angel‘s to sing Hymns of praise.
hymns.author: Cherubim & Seraphim Church
chorus: Our Father, Our Father
Almighty we beseech Thee bless us
Our Father, Our Father
Almighty we beseech Thee bless us.

hymns.title: I Am Thine O Lord I Have Heard thy Voice
lyrics: I AM Thine O Lord I have heard Thy voice,
And it told Thy love to me;
But I long to rise in the arm of faith
And be closer drawn to Thee.
Consecrate me now to Thy service Lord,
By the power of grace Divine
Let my soul look up With a steadfast hope,
And my will be lost in Thine.
Oh! the pure delight of a single hour
That before Thy Throne I spend
When I kneel in prayer and with Thee my God
I commune as friend with friend.
There are depths of love that I can not know
Till I cross the narrow sea;
There are heights of joy that I can not reach
Till I rest in peace with Thee.
hymns.author: Fanny J. Crosby
chorus: Draw me nearer, nearer, nearer blessed Lord
To the Cross where Thou hast died:
Draw me nearer, nearer, nearer
blessed Lord, To Thy precious bleeding side.

hymns.title: Be Glad in the Lord and Rejoice
lyrics: BE GLAD in the Lord, and rejoice
All ye that are upright in heart
And ye that have made Him your choice
Bid sadness and sorrows depart.
Be joyful for He is the Lord
On earth and in heaven supreme
He fashions and rules by His word;
The "Mighty" and “Strong to redeem"
What tho’ in the conflict for right
Your enemies almost prevail
God’s armies, just hid from your sight
Are more than the foes which assail.
Though darkness surround you by day
Your sky by the night be o’ercast
Let nothing your spirit dismay
But trust till the danger is past.
Be glad in the Lord and rejoice
His praise proclaiming in song
With harp, and with organ and voice
The hallelujahs prolong!
hymns.author: Mary Elizabeth Servoss, 1849-1906
chorus: Rejoice Rejoice be glad in the Lord
and rejoice. 2ce

hymns.title: Band of Cherubim Has Come
lyrics: BAND of Cherubim has come
giving praises to our God
Oh come the whole universe giving
Praises to our God.
Band of Seraphim has come
givmg praises to our God
Come Ibo and Hausa, Come
Let's praise our Father.
The four cardinal points come lets
go praise our Father
Cherubim and Seraphim we are
praising the Father.
Both young and old all come, come
let us praise the father
Cherubim and Seraphim
we praise thee oh Father.
Jesus the Saviour we come
we come to praise our father
Leader remember Cherubim
make them to be thy own.
Jesus Saviour take us please
take us right there
Up at our father‘s place,
please take us there.
Jesus, Saviour thank,
for not letting us carry
Satan burden tied down,
you didn't let us carry it.
Your women should endure and
don‘t let yourself be bogged
All those who are like Hannah
the Father will provide for them.
Father remember the old ones that
are among us
So that they don‘t starve at old age,
Father do remember them.
Holy Spirit do please, please
reveal it unto us
Holy words in the Bible, please
reveal it unto us. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: We Give Thanks to that Almighty
lyrics: WE give thanks to that Almighty
For sparing our lives to date
For making souls to meet again
Glory be to thy name.
There‘s much to do at osogbo
Much more at Ilesa
The Bands at Ondo are prepared
To uphold Jesus.
Tie your girdles Bands of Lagos
To battle with satan
The harvest up‐country ready
Who will go to harvest.
We greet our Spiritual father
For joy of re-union
Captain has fought for Jesus Christ
And has conquered Satan.
Songs of Halle Hulleluyah
Shall we sing in heaven
When we shall see the Saviour Lord
On his Throne on high.
hymns.author: Cherubim & Seraphim Church
chorus: We give thanks to thee O Lord
For sparing our lives to this day
For making souls to meet again
Glory be to thy name.

hymns.title: Ye Angels that Dwell in Heaven
lyrics: YE angels that dwell in Heaven,
Give praise to our Father,
For the band established here below
For the redemption of soul;
Therefore let's rejoice and be glad
And then shout Hallelujah,
ln remembrance of Jesus death
Painful death on the cross.
Ye Cherubirn and Seraphim
Give praises to our Father,
Who has established this Holy Band
To procure us salvation;
Therefore let us run the swift race
Of service to Almighty
Perseverance to the end shall bring
Everlasting life to us.
All the works we do in this world
All the characters we show
All the words that we utter therein
Let’s be watchful and careful
For the Lord shall bring to Judgement
All that we do in this world
With every secret thing we do
Be it good or evil.
Jesus proclameth us Light of world
To cast all darkness away;
The city built on the top of Hill
Can never hide from vision,
God has made us the salt of the earth
To greatly sweeten the earth
But if salt has lost its savour,
How can it be seasoned?
Glory be to Lord our saviour
For the love bestowed on us
Calling us into this Holy Band
The lst Ark of Salvation
Glory and honour Might and power,
Highest honour and wisdom
To Father, Son and Holy Ghost, For
ever Trinity.
hymns.author: Cherubim & Seraphim Church
chorus: There's Command from Heaven's
Courts above
That this Band must multiply!
There's Command from heaven's
Courts above,
It must grow from strength to strength;
Till Blind in spirit behold Light
In this world and that to come
So that death of Jesus on Cross
Would never pass in vain.

hymns.title: Blessed Assurance, Jesus is Mine
lyrics: BLESSED assurance, Jesus is mine!
Oh, what a fore-taste of glory divine
Heir of salvation, purchase of God
Born of His Spirit, wash’d in His blood.
Perfect submission, perfect delight
Visions of rapture now burst on my sight
Angels descending, bring from above
Echoes of mercy, whispers of love
Perfect submission, all is at rest
I in my Saviour am happy and blest
Watching and waiting, looking above
Fill’d with His goodness, lost in His love.
hymns.author: Fanny Crosby, 1820-1915
chorus: This is my story, this is my song
Praising my Saviour all the day long
This is my story, this is my song
Praising my Saviour all the day long.

hymns.title: O Lord of Heaven and of Earth
lyrics: O LORD of heaven and of earth
To Thee all praise and Glory be
How shall we Show our love to Thee
Giver of all, giver of all, giver of all.
The golden sunshine, vernal hair
Sweet flower and fruits,Thy love declare
Where harvests ripen, Thou art there
Giver of all.
For peaceful homes and healthful days
For all the Blessings earth displays
We owe Thee thankfulness and praise
Giver of all.
Thou did not spare Thine only Son
But gav’st Him for a world undone
And freely with that blessed One
Thou givest all.
Thou giv’st the Holy Spirit’s dower
Spirit of life and love and power
And dost His even fold graces shower
Upon us all.
For souls redeemed, for sins forgiven
For mean of grace and hopes of heaven
What can to Thee O Lord, be given
Who givest all?
We lose what on ourselves we spend,
We have as treasure without end
Whatever Lord to Thee we lend
Who givest all.
Whatever Lord will lend to Thee
Repaid a thousand fold will be
then gladly will we give to Thee
Giver of all.
To Thee from whom we all derive
Our life, our gifts our power to give
Oh may we ever with Thee live
Giver of all. Amen
hymns.author: Christopher Wordsworth

hymns.title: Praise be Unto God Redeemer
lyrics: PRAISE be unto God redeemer
Praises be to Trinity
Who preserved us up to this day
Glory to his Holy name.
Trinity and King of glory
Father power send to us
Let the elders be victorious
Wisdom from above descend.
Thou the great and glorious Father
Forget not the praying band
Power and love to them be given
Teach them how to pray to Thee.
Jehovah Nissi our Father
Mercy to Seraph descend
Let Cherubim be victorious
Like their counter-parts be blessed.
Provide jobs-for all the jobless
The barren shall be made whole
All Children shall be protected
Death shall have no power on us.
Our prayers we beg Thee hearken
All our branches to sustain
Strength and victory to them given
Uphold, keep them to the end.
Jehovah Shammah our Great King
When the last call shall be made
Into thy Kingdom please call us
Unto glory to thy throne.
hymns.author: Cherubim & Seraphim Church
chorus: Sing and chorus Halleluyah
Songs of glory shall we sing
Sing and chorus Halleluyah
Shout Hosanna to our King.

hymns.title: Praise the King of Glory
lyrics: PRAISE the King of Glory
He is God alone
Praise Him for the Wonders
He to tis hath shown
For His promised presence
All the pilgrim ways
For the flamming pillar
And the cloud by day.
Praise Him for redemption
Free to every soul
Praise Him for the Fountain
That can make us whole
For His gifts of kidness
And His loving care
For the blest assurance
That He answers prayer
That He answers prayer
Praise Him for the trials
Sent as cords of love
Binding us more closely
To the things above
For the faith that conquers
Hope, that naught
For the land where loved ones
Gather unto Him.
hymns.author: anon
chorus: Praise... Him, shinning Angel
All... His hosts adore Him
who... His face behold
Through... His great dominion
While... the ages roll...
All His works shall praise Him
All His works shall praise Him,
All His works shall praise Him,
Bless the Lord, my soul!

hymns.title: O Lord my God
lyrics: O Lord my God!
When I in awesome wonder
Consider all the works Thy hands hath made
I see the stars, I hear the rolling thunder
Thy pow’r thro' out the universe displayed
When through the woods and
Forest glads l wander
And hear the birds sing sweetly in the trees
When I look down from lofty
mountain grandeur
And hear the brook and feel the gentle breeze.
And when I think that God, His Son not sparing
Sent him to die, I scarce can take it in
That on the cross, my burden gladly bearing
He bled and died to take away my sin.
When Christ shall come with shout of acclamation
And take me home, what joy shall fill my heart
Then I shall bow in humble adoration
And there proclaim, my God how great thou art.
hymns.author: anon
chorus: Then sings my soul,
My Saviour God to Thee
How great Thou art, how great Thou art!
Then sings my soul,
My Saviour God to Thee;
How great Thou art, how great Thou art!

hymns.title: We Thank Thee Lord we Praise Thee God
lyrics: WE thank Thee Lord we praise Thee God
For victory over the Nebuchadnsar
Witches, wizard busy body
All evil spirit we match on our feet.
The Members of the Cherubim
Be ready to match the devil on your feet.
Let all who stand ever be watchful
That satan will never never push you down.
The song Halle‐Halleluyah
Shall be our song when
temptations is over.
Give glory to Heavenly Father
Give glory to His Holy Son.
Let's give glory to Holy Ghost
Praises be to the Holy trinity.
hymns.author: anon
chorus: Glory be to, glory be to
Glory be Thy Holy name.

hymns.title: Fasten your Girdle Ye Scraf‘
lyrics: FASTEN your girdle ye Scraf‘
And take your harps along too
And let your timbrels sing loudly
To welcome our glorious King.
With drum and dance glorify Him
He will give onto us joy
As long as we can trust in Him
Bountiful blessing for us.
Deny us not of your blessing
We Scraphim of this world
Make us fit for various service
And lets be crowned in the end.
Father who hearest Elijah
Please hear us we Seraphim
Jehovah Jireh thou our King
Make us fit on judgement day.
We'll give glory to our father
And to the Son who spares us
And as the year progresses on
Glory be to Trinity.
hymns.author: Cherubim & Seraphim Church
chorus: Up by the river of Eden
Holy and beautiful dwelling
Where Cherubim and Seraphim
Clarify the Holy one.

hymns.title: Praise my Soul, the King of Heaven
lyrics: PRAISE my soul, the King of heaven;
To His feet the tribute bring
Ransom'd heal‘d restored forgiven
Who like Thee His praise shall sing?
Praise Him for Ark of Salvation
Sent down to us in the world
And He made the praying Father
As the head over the Band.
Praise Him for His grace and favour
To the Cherubim, Seraph
To keep us all up to this day
And gives us victory always.
Praise for love He has shown to us
And favour in all our ways
In trouble and in temptation
His mercies ever remains.
Praise His ever-constant refuge
We Cherub, Seraph enjoys
Witches, Wizards and all evils
Woe betides them before us.
Father-like He tends and spares us
Well our feeble frame He knows;
In His hands He, gently bears us
Feeding us with bread of life.
Army of heaven joins and praise Him
Father, Son and Holy Ghost
Sun and Moon join all and praise Him
And ye all creatures on earth.
hymns.author: Henry Francis Lyte
chorus: Praise Him/ Praise Him
Praise Him/ Praise Him
Praise the everlasting King.

hymns.title: Now Thank we All our God
lyrics: NOW thank we all our God
With heart and hands and voices
Who wondrous things hath done
In whom His world rejoices
Who from our mother's arms
Hath bless‘d us on our way
With countless gifts of love
And still is ours today.
Oh may this bounteous God
Through all our life be near us,
With ever joyful hearts
And blessed peace to cheer us,
And keep us in His grace
And guide us when perplex'd
And free us from all ills
In this world and the next,
All praise and thanks to God
The Father now be given
The Son, and Holy Ghost
Supreme in highest heaven
The One eternal God
Whom earth and heaven adore
For this it was, is now
And shall be evermore. Amen
hymns.author: Martin Rinkart

hymns.title: Christ Jesus Come I Unto Theo
lyrics: CHRIST Jesus come I unto Theo
Closely let me follow behind
Though my possession increaseth
And my every thought awakened.
Pagans and all moslem come,
And all Xtians come along;
Let's adore our only God
May our heads be crowned at the end.
We give praises unto our God,
Who offered Christ Jesus to us
To redeem the earthly ones
From the pangs of sin and Satan.
Seraph band your girdle fasten
Band of Cherub fervently pray
Christ the Saviour shall redeem us
Divine Healer shall heal us all.
The world shall soon cease to be
Lo! beware all Oh ye saints
Those before us keep marching on
Never weary those behind us.
Those who were before victorious
Gaze at us as we now rejoice
Hailing and encouraging us
Forward ever backward never.
Doubtful never be on this way
However tough it seems to be
Seraphim Band be courageous
We shall savour sweet taste at last.
When the last trump shall sound to call
Jesus will take us to Canaan
Let's rejoice Lord in your bossom
Lead us to your fold of comfort.
Glory be to Father above
Glory be to His only Son
Glory be to Holy Spirit
All praises to the Trinity.
hymns.author: Cherubim & Seraphim Church
chorus: Praise Him loudly oh all ye Saints
Offer thanks to Father above
Spare our souls in Seraph Band
At the end Lord save our souls.

hymns.title: Let us Together Give Thanks to our God
lyrics: LET us together give thanks to our God
Songs of praise and thanks we should give
Wonderful in His love unto us all
Sing praises to our benevolent God.
How are we better than those who are dead
You have shown us kindness up till today
You protect us and save us from dangers
Sing praises to Him who’s caring for us.
All the living you give their daily bread
It is you who provide for every one
It is you who bless all your creatures
Sing praises to Him who‘s caring far us.
Our voices are not sweet enough to sing
Our mouths are not wide enough for thanks
Though we have thousand tongues each
everyone
They're too small to appreciate your
good deeds.
Let us be above danger every day
Let us have joy and have your peaceful mind
Let us all have mercy on our way home
So we can come give glory to your name.
Oh you angels from Heaven be with us
Song of praise and thanks we should give
To our Father immortal and blessful
Our King Jehovah who is reigning.
hymns.author: A. K. Ajiṣafẹ
chorus: Halleluyah, glory be to our God
We'll with drumming and dancing praise
Our Lord
The living should praise thee
as it should be
Halleluyah, glory be to our God
Halleluyah, glory be to our God.

hymns.title: Ye Handiworks of the Lord
lyrics: YE handiworks of the Lord
Come Glorify ye the Lord
All ye the priest of the Lord
Come, Glorify ye the Lord
All ye His prophets
Come Glorify ye the Lord
Worship and praise Him now
and evermore.
Ye Cherubim Band
Come, Clarify ye the Lord
Ye Seraphim Band
Come Glorify ye the Lord
All ye Holy Band
Come Glorify ye the Lord
Worship and praise Him now
and evermore.
Ye Branches in Lagos
Come Glorify ye the Lord
Abeokuta branch
Come Glorify ye the Lord
Ye Ibadan branch
Come Glorify ye the Lord
Worship and praise Him now
and evermore.
All ye Ife Branch
Come Glorify ye the Lord
Ye llesha Branch
Come Glorify ye the Lord
All ye Ondo branch
Come Glorify ye the Lord
Worship and praise Him now
and evermore.
Ye Agege branch
Come Glorify ye the Lord
Odo'gbolu branch
Come Glorlfy ye the Lord
'Jebu-Ode branch
Come Glorify ye the Lord
Worship and praise Him now
and evermore.
Akintoye branch
come Glorify ye the Lord
Osiele branch
Come Glorify ye the Lord
Ye Eruwa branch
Come Glorify ye the Lord
Worship and praise Him now
and evermore.
Araromi Branch
Come Glorify ye the Lord
Ye Ibogun branch
Come Glorify ye the Lord
All ye Remo Branch
Come Glorify ye the Lord
Worship and praise Him now
and evermore.
Onidudun Branch
Come Glorify ye the Lord
Ye Ifako branch
Come Glorify ye the Lord
All ye Otta Branch
Come Glorify ye the Lord
Worship and praise Him now
and evermore. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: God our Creator who Established Seraph
lyrics: GOD our Creator who established Seraph
And Cherubim throughout all the universe
From great Prophet Moses Orimolade
We do praise and magnify Thy Name.
Where are all the elected children of God
Listen to the Shepherd’s voice now calling you;
Repent and come enter the last Ark of Christ
The time of judgement is right at hand.
Cherub and Seraph give thanks to our Father
Continue with courage in the Holy task;
You will soon hear the voice of our Lord Saviour
Saying come and receive the reward.
All who are passing-by come to the Saviour
To receive the new Grace of the Holy Band
Do not miss this Holy Ark of Christ Jesus
That God of Moses descend to us.
Jesus our Lord shall come to reign in the world,
in the Midst of Cherubim and Seraphim;
A thousand year shall He reign here undisturbed
In the midst of the Band here below.
Jesus Christ the Lord of Glory and of Grace
With whom is the path of everlasting life;
He will take to Him all that believe His words,
To our Heavenly Father above.
hymns.author: Cherubim & Seraphim Church
chorus: A! Rejoice, rejoice,
rejoice, rejoice Band of Seraph
A! Rejoice, rejoice
Rejoice, rejoice Band of Cherub.

hymns.title: All Ye Band of Seraph
lyrics: ALL ye Band of Seraph
Come show the joy of your heart
Together sing a sweet song
For wondrous work he's done to us
For He has not let us go astray from His side.
O ye Praying Father
Give thanks to our God
That made you triumph o'er enemies
And let no enemy prevail
And has made you the head
And head till eternity.
Ye Chorister's Band
Show forth the joy of your heart
For his firm strong covenants
Amidst the Band of Seraphim
That he fulfilled
And fill the world to come.
People may be mocking
And may though condemn
But they know not our God
But we Band of Cherubim
Know the God we serve
And He will bless us still.
Cherubim, Seraphim
Be zealous in Spiritual work
For ye shall work and serve till the end
Your saviour thou shall surely see
Right here on earth
And also in heaven above.
hymns.author: anon
chorus: We’re marchng to zion
Zion the greater! of all
We are marching forth to zion
The habitat of our God.

hymns.title: All Ye Band of Seraphim
lyrics: ALL ye Band of Seraphim
And ye fold of Cherubim
Give all praises unto our God
Who spared us till this day.
Satan truely rages
But can not overcome
By the power of our trinity
We shall be victorious.
Though one else had passed on
Others incarcerated
And some other throd on the ground
Got knocked down and passed on.
Thanks we give unto God
For His mercies on us
For all our request He granted
Glory be unto God.
Merciful Father God
Be merciful to us
Provide for all our daily needs
Let Thy peace dwell with us.
Healing grant to the sick
Jesus Christ Saviour Lord
Let all the Sick receive from Thee
Divine, perfect healing.
Divine promise fulfil
Jehovah Thabbicubb
Restore the sight to all the blind
And give strength to the weak.
Many had gone astray
They can not find The Way
Many leaders supposedly
Weary and retreating.
Jehovah Jireh God
Provide for all our needs
Bless the barren With good children
Thy blessings let's receive.
Merciful father God
Forgive us all our sins
Do not recompense all our sins
Rain Thy blessings on us.
Blessing give unto Kings
And to the council too
Let peace supreme reign in our land
Cast civil strife away.
Glory to Father be
Give glory to the Son
Glory be to Holy Spirit
Eternal Trinity.
hymns.author: Cherubim & Seraphim Church
chorus: I cannot but offer thanks
I cannot but offer thanks
For all good receiveth of God
I can not but offer thanks.

hymns.title: Spirit of the Living God
lyrics: SPIRIT of the living God
O descend Thou now
With pow'r of the Pentecost
And revive our souls
And make us to be warm
Like heavenly fire, come
With Thy great comfort
Show us Thy Light.
The world and our soul receive
And make it Thy Own
Lord, In our adoration
Let us see Thy help
And sincerity be
And the gift from heav'n
Of the Pentecost
Be upon us.
Wash us with Thy precious blood
of the Calvary
Wash our souls of sin away
And redeem us now
Fill our heart with Thy love
To walk the good path
Lord, Thy will, we'll do
As done in heav'n.
Father Son and Holy Ghost
‘ternal Trinity
Praises, glory and power
Be to Thee alone
Thy beauty in this world
Shall now be our joy
And with thanksgiving
Hallelujah. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Lmmortal, Invisible, God Only Wise
lyrics: lMMORTAL, Invisible, God only wise,
In light inaccessible hid from our eyes,
Most blessed, most glorious the
Ancient of Days,
Almighty, victorious, thy great name we praise.
Unresting, unhasting, and silent aslight,
Nor wanting, nor wasting thou rulest in might;
Thy justice like mountains high soaring above
Thy clouds which are fountains
Of goodness and love.
To all life than givest, to both great and small,
In all life thou livest, the true life of all,
We blossom and flourish as leaves on the tree
And wither and perish; but naught changeth thee.
Great Father of glory, pure father of light,
Thine angels adore thee, all veiling their sight;
All laud we would render: O help us to see
‘Tis only the splendor of light hideth thee. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Rejoice Today with One Accord
lyrics: REJOICE today with one accord
Sing out with exultation
Rejoice and praise our mighty Lord
Whose arm hath brought salvation
His works of love proclaim
The greatness of His name
For He is God alone
Who hath His mercy shown
Let all His saints adore Him.
When in distress to Him we cried
He heard our sad complaining
oh trust in Him, whate’er betide
His love is all sustaining
Triumphant songs of praise
To Him our hearts shall raise
Now every voice shall say
O praise our God always
Let all His saints adore Him.
Rejoice to-day with one accord
Sing out With exultation
Rejoice and praise our mighty Lord
Whose arm hath brought salvation
His works of love proclaim
The greatness of His name
For He is God alone
Who hath His mercy shown
Let all His saints adore Him. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Lord Jesus Christ is my Blessed Saviour
lyrics: LORD Jesus Christ is my blessed Saviour
I shall never be in want
He maketh me to lie down peacefully
In green pastures of the Lord.
He leadeth me beside the 'still waters
And lo! still effect prevailed
And He restoreth my gentle soul
By the grace of His name.
Though I walk in valley of shadow of death
The valley where evil abound
No fear shall my gentle soul entertain
Because Thou art with my Soul.
Thy rod and Thy staff they shall comfort me
And my soul shall find relief
Thou preparest a table before me
In the presence of my foes.
Thy goodness and mercy shall follow me
From now and till eternity
And all my trust shall ever be in the Lord
From now and for ever more.
Glory be to our Holy Father above
Glory be to His Holy Son
And glory be to the Holy Spirit
Praises be to Trinity.
hymns.author: Cherubim & Seraphim Church
chorus: We offer Thee Thanks
Re-assuringly
For Thy saving grace upon our souls
In the Band of Seraphim.

hymns.title: Praise Him, Praise Him, Jesus our
lyrics: PRAISE Him, praise him, Jesus our
Blessed Redeemer
Sing, O earth, His wonderful Love proclaim
Hail Him! hail Him! highest arch angels in glory
Strength and honour give to His holy name
Like a shepherd, Jesus will guard His children
In His arms He carries them all day long
O ye saints that dwells on the mountain of Zion
Praise Him, praise Him, ever in joyful song.
Praise Him, praise Him, Jesus our blessed
Redeemer
For our sins He suffered and bled and died
He, our rock, our hope of eternal salvation
Hail Him! hail Him! Jesus the crucified
Loving Saviour, meekly enduring sorrow
Crowned with thorns that cruely pierced
His brow
Once for us rejected, despised and forsaken
Prince of Glory, ever triumphant now.
Praise Him, praise Him, Jesus our Blessed
Redeemer
Heavenly portal loud with hosanna ring
Jesus, Saviour, reigneth for ever and ever
Crown Him, crown Him, prophet and
Priest and King!
Death is vanquished! Tell it with joy ye, faithful
Where is now thy victory, boasting grave?
Jesus lives, no longer thy portals are cheerless
Jesus live, the mighty and strong to save. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Let us with a Gladsome Mind
lyrics: LET us with a gladsome mind
Praise the Lord for He is kind.
He with all commanding might
Fill'd the new-made world with light.
All things living He doth feed
His full hand supplies their need.
Let us, therefore, warble forth
His great majesty and worth.
Let us with of mortal mind
Praise the Lord for He is kind.
hymns.author: John Milton
chorus: For His mercy aye endure
Ever faithful, ever sure.

hymns.title: Praise the Saviour Ye who
lyrics: PRAISE the Saviour, ye who know Him
Who can tell how much we owe Him
Gladly let us render to Him
All we have and are.
Jesus is the name that charms us
He fore conflicts fits and arms us
Nothing moves and nothing harms us
When we trust in Him.
Trust in Him, ye saints forever
He is faithful, changing never
Neither force nor guile can sever
Those He loves from Him.
Keep us, Lord, oh, keep us cleaving
To Thyself and still believing
Till the hour of our receiving
Promised joys in heav'n.
Then, we shall be where we would be
Then we shall be what we should be
Things which are not now, nor could be
Then shall be our own. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Hark Creation's Alleluia
lyrics: HARK, creation's Alleluia
Rising from a thousand shores
Vibrates sweet as angel voices
Loud as many waters, roars
Blessing, glory, power, salvation
To our God upon the throne
Father, Son, and Holy Spirit
lnfinite supreme, alone.
On and on, from dawn to sunset
Bome on every changeful wind
From the myriad-minded people
Of the hoary climes of Ind,
From the ransom‘d sons of Afric
From Old Sinim's crowded lands
From the freeborn Wanderers roaming
Arab‘s unconquer‘d sands.
From the coasts of ice to regions
Where perpetual summer smiles
From the sunny-hearted children
Of the far Pacific isles
From the numbers without number
Of rejoicing Christendom
From the watchers for His advent
Who will soon to Zion come.
Gathering strength from every nation
Every kindred, tribe, and tongue
Hark, the everlasting anthem
Hark, that glorious tide of song
Floods the valley with its music
Echoes from the lasting hills
Onward, upward, till the temple
Of the living God it fills.
Hark, it mingles with the raptures
Of the armies of the sky
Who have pass’d through tribulation
Into perfect rest on high
Clothes in robes of spotless beauty
Palms of triumph in their hand
Harping on their harps Hosanna
As before His face they stand.
Glory unto Him who loved us
Him who wash'd us with His blood
Kings and priest henceforth for ever
To our Father and our God
Alleluia! saints and angels
Raise your loudest loftiest strains
Alleluia! hell is vanguished:
God the Lord Almighty reign. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Cherubim and Seraphim
lyrics: CHERUBIM and Seraphim
Sow pleasant seedlings on earth
To thee is the most clarion call
To all who shall rapture with the Lord.
O! ye Christians be awake
Forsake now all we our sins
Let the will of God be done
That we may find favour with our God .
Be prayerful ye Christians
With crystal clear conscience work
With all holiness be in fast
These the mission of Christ Jesus here.
Ye of earth make it fit to live
Ready for coming of our Lord
Lest sin and epidemic cease
Lest we be put into the abyss.
Fear the Lord all ye Christian
Agape love to brethren
Do not despise and anger not
God will grant all your supplications
Multiple temptations here abound
But the vilest of it all
Penury and all afflictions
Jah may these not be our portion.
hymns.author: Cherubim & Seraphim Church
chorus: Hark, Hark, hark call of
Seraphim above
Hark, Hark, hark call of
Cherubim above
Halleluyah, Halleluyah,
Halleluyah to our King.

hymns.title: Let us Offer Thanks Unto the Lord
lyrics: LET us offer thanks unto the Lord
For His mercies abundant
Let us in armour be ready
To fight and conquer Satan.
All of the earth rejoice and be glad
Cheerfulness now let us work
Let’s fight on now and to the end
Till we lay down all our sword.
We members of the Seraphim Band
Glory we give to our Lord
Who spread us and again we meet
All glory be to Thy name.
Those who are before victorious
Are watching as we fight on
In oneness they chorus to us
Brethren the time is now at hand.
We hail thee our spiritual head
And also the lieutenants
For the work of Holy Spirit
Pleasantries we all exchange.
Thanks we give to the Trinity
For dislodging satan‘s den
Halleluyah to God above
As Satan is put to shame.
hymns.author: anon
chorus: Satan has strength but can't
O 'ercome
By the power of Almight God
The promises made by our Lord
Shall endure for ever more.

hymns.title: All Members of Band of Seraphim
lyrics: ALL members of Band of Seraphim
And the Cherubim on earth
Rejoice with heals and dancing steps
Praises be to glorious King.
Amidst much trouble and more strife
And the snare of the devil
Amidst critics and slotful men
Doth Seraphim praise the Lord.
Omnipresent, Most Holy King
To Him all praise and thanks be
Let’s be not antagonistic
Stary crown we may adorn.
Glorious Father our sins forgive
This all we plead Holy Son
Shield and guard us Holy Spirit
That we all Thine heir will be.
hymns.author: anon
chorus: Give praises to God Band by Band
Individually praise the Lord
Almighty God is a Holy Lord
Oh my soul praise ye the Lord.

hymns.title: Let us Give Praises to our God
lyrics: LET us give praises to our God
Who dwellest in the firmament
Who unto all men He doth feed
For all creatures He doth care.
The firmament He broadly decked
He made the brighter sun and moon
His handiwork the shinning stars
Numerical value unknown.
The mortal form of man He made
And the breath of life He doth give
A perfect living soul He made
As befitting as all we be.
But man vilest and rotten be
From evil to evil they go
The recompense for sin they reap
ln trouble and also in death.
But let us praise and honour God
For He sent Christ Jesus to us
To seek for all the straying souls
Redemption from sinful pathways. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Praise the Lord who Ransoned Thee
lyrics: PRAISE the Lord who ransoned thee
Glorify His name for ever more
Faithful, He has been and true.
Oh what blessings He bestows
Glorify His name for ever more
How His grace from heaven flows.
Has He not been kind to you
Glorify His name forever more
What more could your Saviour do.
Was there ever love like this?
Glorify His name for ever more
Can the world bestow such peace?
Let my tongue unlooscd be
Glorify His name for ever more
Let me through eternity.
hymns.author: anon
chorus: Glorify His name, for ever more
Sing your Halleluias more and more
Magnify His name, Glory? His name
Sing and praise the Lord for ever more.

hymns.title: My Soul Give Praises Unto the Lord
lyrics: MY soul give praises unto the Lord
Wonderful King who sought and found me
Bell of praise I'll jingle round the world
Proclaimng the praise of Almighty.
Sort of love by which I Jesus called
Wonderful phenomenon it is
By what manner which I Jesus called
Wonderful manner it is to me.
What thanks can we ever bestow forth
Thou the King of the Seraphim Band
For Victory and protection on us
ForThy abundant mercies and grace
Thou who offering of Noah accept
All the offering we brought forth accept
Thou who offering of Abram accept
May not our offering be rejected.
Band of Cherubim and Seraphim
Chorus joyful song to King above
For His wonderful works amidst us
For divine immeasurable grace.
Joy to us today, and forever
Glory to Father and to the Son
Glory we give to Holy Spirit
Transcendental God our thanks accept.
hymns.author: Cherubim & Seraphim Church
chorus: O! Lord praises be unto Thee
For Thy grace by which I am so called
Lord Jesus uphold me to the end
That I may with you reign there above.

hymns.title: Through All the Changing Scenes of Life
lyrics: THROUGH all the changing scenes of life
In trouble and in joy
The praises of my God shall still
My heart and tongue employ.
Of His deliverance I will boast,
Till all that are distressed
From my example comfort take,
And charm their griefs to rest.
O magnify the Lord with me,
With me exalt His name;
When in distress to Him I called,
He to my rescue came.
The host of God encamp around
The dwellings of the just
Deliverance He afford to all
Who on His succour trust.
O make but trial of His love;
Experience will decide
How blest they are, and only they,
Who in His truth confide.
Fear Him, ye saints, and you will then
Have nothing else to fear;
Make you His service your delight,
He'll make your wants His care. Amen
hymns.author: Nahum Tate and Nicholas Brady

hymns.title: For Mercies Countless as the Sands
lyrics: FOR mercies countless as the sands
which daily I receive
From Jesus, my redeemer's hands
My soul, what can'st thou give.
Alas, from such a heart as mine
What can I bring Him forth
My best is slain‘d and dyed with sin
My all is nothing worth.
Yet this acknowledgement I''ll make
For all He has bestow'd
Salvation's sacred cup I’ll take
And call upon my God.
The host return for one like me
So wretched and so poor
Is from His gifts to draw a plea
And ask Hlm still for more.
I cannot serve Him as I ought
No works have l to boast
Yet would | glory in the thought
That I shall owe Him most. Amen
hymns.author: John Newton

hymns.title: Oh! for a Thousand Tongue to Sing
lyrics: OH! for a thousand tongue to sing
My dear redeemer's Praise
The glories of my God and King
The triumphs of His grace.
Jesus the name that charms our fears
That bids our sorrows cease
‘Tis music in the sinners ears
‘T'is life and health, and peace.
He breaks the power of cancelled sin
And sels the prisoner free
His blood can make the foulest clean
His blood availeth me.
He speaks and listening to His voice
New life the dead receive
The mournful broken hearts rejoice
The humble poor believe.
Hear Him ye dead, His praise ye dumb
Your loosened tongues employ
Ye blind behold your Saviour come
And leap ye lame for joy.
My gracious Master and my God
Assist me to proclaim
And spread through all the earth abroad
The honours of His Name. Amen
hymns.author: Charles Wesley

hymns.title: O Worship the King, All Glorious Above
lyrics: O worship the King, All glorious above;
O gratefully sing His power and His love,
Our shield and defender the ancient of days,
Pavillioned in splendour and girded with praise.
O tell of His might, O sing of His grace,
Whose robe is the light, whose canopy space;
His chariots of wrath the deep thunder-clouds form,
And dark is His path on the wings of the storm.
The earth Will its store of wonders untold,
Almighty! Thy power hath founded of old,
Hath established it fast by a changeless decree,
And round it hath cast, like a mantle, the sea.
The bountiful care what tongue can recite?
lt breathes in the air, it shines in the light,
It streams from the hills, it descends to the plain,
And sweetly distils in the dew and the rain.
Frail children of dust, and feeble as frail,
In Thee do we trust, nor find Thee to fail;
Thy mercies how tender how firm to the end,
Our Maker, Defender, Redeemer, and Friend.
O measureless Might! lneffable Love!
While angels delight to hymn Thee above,
The humbler creation, though feeble their lays,
With true adoration, shall lisp to Thy Praise. Amen
hymns.author: Robert Grant

hymns.title: Children of the Heavenly King
lyrics: CHILDREN of the heavenly King
As ye journey sweetly sing
Sing your saviours worthy praise
Glorious in His works and ways.
We are travelling home to God
In the way the Father tread
They are happy now, and we
Soon their happiness Shall see.
Sing ye little flock a blest
You on Jesus throne shall rest
There your seat is now prepared
There your Kingdom and reward.
Lift your eyes ye sons of light
Zions’ city is in sight
There our endless home shall be
There our Lord we soon shall see.
Let every kindren, and tribe,
On this terrestial ball
Him all majesty ascribe,
And to crown Him Lord of all
Oh with younger sacred throne
We all at His feet may fall
There join everlasting song
And there crown Him, Lord of All
Glory to Father we give
Glory to His Son we give
Glory to the Holy Ghost
Lead us to the blessed home.
hymns.author: John Cennick
chorus: We are travelling home to God
In the way the Father tread
They are happy now, and we
Soon their happiness Shall see.

hymns.title: All Hail the Power of Jesus Name
lyrics: ALL hail the power of Jesus Name!
Let angels prostrate fall:
Bring forth the royal diadem
And grown Him, Lord of All.
Crown Him, ye martyrs of our God,
Who from His altar call;
Exalt the stem of Jesse‘s rod,
And crown Him, Lord of all.
Ye seed of Israel’s chosen race,
Ye ransom’d of the fall,
Hail Him who saves you by His Grace
And crown Him, Lord of all.
Sinners, whose love can ne'er forget
The wormwood and the gall;
Go, spread your trophies at His feet
And crown Him, Lord of all.
Let every kindred, every tribe
On this terrestrial ball,
To Him all majesty ascribe
And crown Him, Lord of all.
Oh that with yonder sacred throng
We at His feet may fall
There join the everlasting song
And crown Him Lord of all. Amen
hymns.author: Edward Perronet

hymns.title: Awake my Soul to Joyful Days
lyrics: AWAKE, my soul, to joyful days
And sing thy great Redeemer's praise
He justly claims a song from me
His loving kindness, oh, how free.
He saw me done, ruined by the fall
Yet loved me not withstanding all
He saved me from my lost estate
His loving kindness, oh, how great!
Tho’ num'rous hosts of mighty foes
Tho' earth and hell my way oppose
He safely leads my soul along
His loving kindness, oh, how strong!
When trouble, like a gloomy cloud
Has gathered thick and thundered loud
He near my soul has always stood,
His loving kindness, o how good!
Often I feel my sinful heart
Prone from my Jesus to depart
And though I oft have Him forgot
His loving kindness changes not.
So when I pass death‘s gloomy vale
And life and mortal pow’rs shall fail
O may my last expiring breath
His loving kindness sing in death.
Now let me rise to heights above
Unto perpetual land of light
ln wondrous joy to sing His praise
His Ioving kindness, o‘er in Heaven. Amen
hymns.author: Samuel Medley

hymns.title: For the Name of God Most High
lyrics: FOR the name of God most high
Most powerful and hon’rable
The Lord God of everywhere
To be prais’d and glorified.
For the name of Christ the Lord
The Son of God that was born
Christ who created all things
Worthy of eternal praise.
For the name of Holy Ghost
Be eternal perfect praise
With the Father and the Son
One in name, One in glory.
This is our last song to Thee
And we shall for ever sing
The generation to come
Shall join to sing the Sweet Song. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Almighty God of Creation
lyrics: ALMIGHTY God of creation
Father, Son, Holy Ghost
Whose face no human eye can see
The invisible God.
Thou Father our Almighty God
We tremble before Thee
All nations here shall worship Thee
Before Thine altar, Lord.
Lord Jesus our own dear close friend
Redemption Thou has brought
Forsake us not, Saviour Divine
But save us to the end.
Oh Holy Ghost, Spirit Divine
Full of Heav’ns Grace, Thous art
Bestow Thy wisdom from above
To know that God is love.
The Three in One, yet One in Three
The Trinity Divine
The mystery, unsearchable God
The Trinity Divine. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: All People that on Earth do Dwell
lyrics: ALL people that on earth do dwell
Sing to the Lord with cheerful voice
Him serve with mirth, His praise forth tell,
Come ye before Him and rejoice.
The Lord, ye know, is God indeed,
Without our aid He did us make;
We are His Flock, He doth us feed;
And for His sheep He doth us take.
O enter then His gates with praise
Approach with joy His courts unto
Praise, laud and bless His name always
For it is seemly so to do.
For why? The Lord our God is good
His mercy is for ever sure
His truth at all times firmly stood
And shall from age to age endure. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Before Jehovah's Throne
lyrics: BEFORE Jehovah's throne
Ye nations, bow with sacred joy
Know that the Lord is God alone
He can create, and can destroy.
His sovereign power, without our aid
Made us of clay, and formed us men
And when like wandering sheep we strayed
He brought us to His fold again.
We’ll crowd Thy gates with thankful songs
High as the heavens our voices raise
And earth, with her ten thousand tongues
Shall fill Thy courts with sounding praise.
Me as the world is Thy command
Vast as eternity Thy love
Firm as a rock Thy truth shall stand
When rolling years shall cease to move. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Ye People of the Earth Below
lyrics: YE people of the earth below
Praises give to our Creator
Let people of all the nations
Sing praises unto the Saviour.
Lord Thy mercies abound for us
Thine truth endureth forever
Thine praise shall spread widely abroad
Till the sun rise and never set. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Oh Thou our Transcendental God
lyrics: OH Thou our transcendental God
We give our praise and heart to Thee
All Thy works on earth we praise Thee
We worship Thee our Saviour Lord.
Angelic hosts sing praise to Thee
The captain and the King of Kings
Loudly the Cherubim praise Thee
And Seraphs praises Trinity.
Oh God of our great grand Fathers
Host of prophets good tidings brought
Host of the Saints and Apostles
Dwells with joy and glory with Thee.
Head of witnesses of Thy death
Honestly rejoices in Thee
The congregation all chorus
ln praises and adoration.
Father of everlasting grace
Thine Is the power and love divine
We worship Thine only dear Son
Dwelling above in grace with Thee.
hymns.author: Cherubim & Seraphim Church
chorus: (Everlasting Father we plead
May our hearts bow before
Thy throne) 2ce

hymns.title: Thanks we Offer to God Creator
lyrics: THANKS we offer to God creator
Who feed and also nuture us
He‘s the Lord who really can bless us all
Let's jointly sing chorus to our creator.
Praise we give for calling us this way
Aboard the ship of salvation
Be of help that we may be in resemblance
Of the Holy Seraphim high above.
Thanks we give for perfect strength and health
Thou endowed we all Thine children
Thou the God who strengthens us lest we're weary
We offer thanks, we praise our Graceful God.
Thanks we offer for answered prayers
Through all the manners we call Thee
Even when on us the devil shot his darts
Shout halleluyah to Victorious God.
Thanks we give for peaceful mortal frame
Revealing Thineself unto us
That Thou art the only Omniscient God
We give thanks and praises to Graceful God.
Thanks we give for the Holy Spirit
When we Thy children astray led
With gentle voice Thou art called
us back to fold.
All we worship Thee Holy Trinity.
Thanks we give for we know Thine altar
‘Midst tribulations of this world
Thou makest us know Thee as our Father
Joy, joy, oh joy we have still our Father.
Thanks be unto Thee God Almighty
For Thy grace with which thou spares us
Thou doth feed and so nuture us everyday
Thanks, thanks and praise be to our
Graceful God.
Thanks we give unto our Creator
For His wonderful works ‘midst us
Not forsaking us for just a minute
Glory, honour, praise to our Creator.
God who establish the Seraphim
Of this earthen world below
Take our voice and put it to use everyday
May we sing chorus with Seraphs above. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: O Band of Seraphim Arise
lyrics: O! Band of Seraphim arise
Arise to war with the devil
Christ Jesus Saviour has triumphed
Work in the vineyard of the Lord.
O! Band of Cherubim arise
Many a soul are unconscious
Many souls had wandered away
Christ Jesus bids you come back home.
Band of prayerists be ready
To exalt the glory of Christ
Though witches and wizards may rage
Michael our captain is now here.
Patriarch Joshua worked and lives
Seraphim shall work and so live
Elijah also worked and lives
Cherubim shall work and so live.
Patriarch Shadrach worked and lives
Patriarch Meshack worked and lives
Abednego worked and he lives
Seraphim shall work and so live.
Patriarch Abraham worked and lives
Patriarch Isaac worked and lives
Patriarch Jacob worked and lives
The Band of prayerist shall live.
Thanks we give unto the Saviour
Who to the planet earth doth come
His loftly glory set aside
Suffered to earn us salvation.
Band of Cherubim, Seraphim
Give glory to Father above
Give glory to His only Son
And Glory to Holy Spirit.
hymns.author: Cherubim & Seraphim Church
chorus: O! work in the vinyard of the Lord
O! work O! work
O! work hard before harvest time.

hymns.title: The God of Abraham Praise
lyrics: THE God of Abraham praise
Who reign enthroned above
Ancient of everlasting days
And God of love
Jehovah Great I AM
BY earth and heaven confessed
I bow and bless the sacred name
For ever blessed.
The God of Abraham praise
At whose supreme command
From earth I rise, and seek the joys
At His right hand
I all on earth forsake
Its wisdom, fame and power
And Him my only portion make
My shiled and tower.
He by Himself hath sworn,
I on His oath depend
I shall, on eagles’ wings upborne
To heaven ascend;
I shall behold His face
I shall His power adore
And sing the wonders of His grace
For evermore. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Alleluia Song of Sweetness
lyrics: ALLELUIA, song of sweetness
Voice of joy that cannot die
Alleluia is the anthem
Ever dear to choirs on high
In the house of GOD abiding
Thus they sing eternally.
Alleluia, Church victorious
Thou may'st lift the joyful stream
Alleluia, songs of triumph
Well befit the ransom'd train
Faint and feeble are our praises
While in exalt we remain.
Alleluia may not always
Be our song while here below
Alleluia, our transgressions
Make us for a while forego
For the solemn time is coming
When our tears for sin must flow.
Therefore in our hymns we pray Thee
Grant us, Blessed TRlNlTY
At the last to keep Thine Easter
In our Home beyond the sky
There to Thee, for ever singing
Alleluia joyfully. Amin
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Let us Sing to the Son of God
lyrics: LET us sing to the Son of God
Lamb of God that was slain‘d
The Lord whom heav‘n and earth adore
Who is worthy to reign.
To Thee, all the angels adore
In the realms of the heav’n
Holy Holy Holy is God
Of glory and the hosts.
Thy Churches in the earth mix up
There, to call upon Thee
Brightly and majesty for God
Omnipotent Father.
We love to be in their midst Lord
To praise Thy holy name
Come forth and reign in heav'n and earth
O thou the Son of God. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Rejoice Ye Holy Angels of above
lyrics: REJOICE ye Holy Angels of above
Cherubim Seraphim raise up voices
Let us all shout Hosannah
And give homage to our God.
Holy Trinity above.
Glory be to God who ever long with us
Who make Holy Michael our Captain
Let us ever more rejoice
And give praises to Our God
Who saved us to see this day
Blessed sacred shepherd of Israel
Thou who slumber not and doth sleepeth not
Lead us with Thine gentle rod
All the sluggard souls within
Thus Thine love may ever glow.
Make us worthy Father to be Thy sheep
Hearkening unto Thy ever gentle voice
May we never go astray
From the heavenly pathway
Leading to life eternal.
Blessed beThou our Almighty Father
Who provide for the elders before us
Keep us always in this faith
Never from this road depart
Till we reach everlasting Joy.
hymns.author: Cherubim & Seraphim Church
chorus: Shout for joy (2ce)
‘Tis born the Saviour of Israel (2ce)
Shout for joy (2ce)
For the Lord has called us in
to the Band of Seraphim.

hymns.title: We are Never Never Weary
lyrics: WE are never, never weary of the
grand old song
Glory to God, Hulleluyah
We can sing it loud as ever,
with our faith more strong
Glory to God, Hallelujah.
We are lost amid the raptured of
redeeming love
Glory to God, Hallelujah!
We are rising on its opinions to
the hills above Glory to God, Hallelujah!
We are going to a palace that is built of
gold Glory to God, hallelujah!
Where the King in all His splendour
we shall soon behold
Glory to God, Hallelujah!
There we’ll shout redeeming mercy in
a glad new song
Glory to God, Halleluyah!
There we’ll sing the praise of Jesus
with the blood-wash‘d throng
Glory to God, Hallelujah!
hymns.author: Frances Jane (Fanny) Crosby
chorus: O the Children of the Lord have a
right to shout and sing
For the way is growing bright
and our souls are on the wing
We are going by and by to the
palace of the King
Glory to God, Hallelujah!

hymns.title: How Sweet the Name of Jesus Sounds
lyrics: HOW sweet the name of Jesus sounds
Blessed be the name of the Lord
It soothes my sorrows heals my wounds
Blessed be the name of the Lord.
It makes the wounded spirit whole
Blessed be the name of the Lord
‘Tis manna to the hungry soul
Blessed be the name of the Lord.
It soothes the troubled sinner's breast
Blessed be the name of the Lord
It gives the weary sweetest rest
Blessed be the name of the Lord.
Then will I tell the sinners round
Blessed be the name of the Lord
What a dear Saviour I have found
Blessed be the name of the Lord.
hymns.author: anon
chorus: Blessed be the name, blessed be the name
Blessed be the name of the Lord
Blessed be the name, blessed be the name
Blessed be the name of the Lord.

hymns.title: Sing Halleluyah to the King of Life
lyrics: SING halleluyah to the King of life
Who, our lives hath spar‘d to this glorious day
May Satan and sin, us not to ensnare,
In the holy way, the Lord hath made us to tread.
Trinity; Father, Son and Holy Ghost
Never forsake, our pray’rs not to ignore
Amid sacred Cherubim, Seraphim
May Thine blessings abundantly on us descend.
Ye members of Cherubim praise the Lord
And we bid thee mercy celebration
Be ye glad in the Lord, also rejoice
God in His mercies hath made us this day to see.
Ye members of Cherubim, Seraphim
Be in readiness and share love with all
May divine love, by God to thee endure
To fervently work on earth as in high above.
hymns.author: Cherubim & Seraphim Church
chorus: Praise glorious King, Cherubim
And scared Seraphim chosen by God
May divine chorus and pray’rs fill our tongue
Jesus shall lead us to sacred throne
O! rejoice.

hymns.title: Blessed be Thine Name Oh Lord
lyrics: BLESSED be Thine name Oh Lord
Let all my heart and soul
And my tongue sing praises to Thee
For all His grace and gifts.
Blessed be Thine name Lord
Forget not oh my soul
To offer thanks and offer praise
For His mercies so great.
Thine sins He forgiveth
Thine pains taketh away
All thine sickness He wholly heal
And makest thee reborn.
The hungered He doth feed
Rest He gaveth laboured
Righteously He shall judge the proud
For the Just He shall fight.
His works He doth reveal
By Moses His own priest
But His Truth and grace He revealed
To Christ Jesus His Son. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: In the Name of Jesus
lyrics: IN the Name of Jesus
Every knee shall bow
Every tongue confess Him
King of Glory now
‘Tis the Father’s pleasure
We should call Him Lord
Who from the beginning
Was the mighty word.
Humbled for a season
To receive a name
From the lips of sinners
Unto whom He came
Faithfully He bore it
Spotless to the last
Brought it back victorious
When form death Separate.
Name Him, brothers, name Him,
With love strong as death
But with awe and wonder
And with bated breath
He is Christ the Lord
Ever to be worshipped
Trusted, and adored.
In your hearts enthrone Him
There let Him subdue
All that is not holy
All that is not true
Crown Him as your Captain
ln temptation‘s hour
Let His will enfold you
In its light and power.
Brothers, this Lord Jesus
Shall return again
With His Father‘s glory
With His angelic train
For all wreaths of empire
Meet upon His brow
And our hearts confess Him
King of Glory now. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: If not God on our Side
lyrics: IF not God on our side
Had been the Lord of Host
Let we all now proclaim
When against us rose evil force.
With all their evil strength
Would have encompassed us
Thanks we give unto God
Who frustrated all evil plans.
From snare of the fowlers
Our soul as bird escaped
Snare broke while we escape
Rejoice Jesus has set us free.
Your grace O Lord our God
Hath saved us now again
From all our enemies
However they may be on us.
Brethren rest all your minds
With Jehovah our God
Howbeit all evil works
ls nothing before Jesus Lord.
In the name of the Lord
Our help ever remain
Creator earth and heaven
The King of all the Holy Saints.
Glory to Father be
Glory to Son we give
Glory to Holy Ghost
The Trinity Hark unto us.
hymns.author: Cherubim & Seraphim Church
chorus: Thanks we give unto God
The merciful father
Loud Hossanah to His name
We give Thanks to Jehovah
Who from evil snare saved us
Thanks be to Thee O Lord.

hymns.title: Cherubim Chorus for Joy
lyrics: CHERUBIM chorus for joy
Let‘s offer thanks to our God
For sparing our lives till now
Praises be to Holy Trinity.
Oh Lord our offerings accept
For our anniversary now
On us all Thy blessings send
Let our hearts with joy be filled
Praise be to our Father God
Lift up thine voices in praise
For His love daily endowed
Fountain of joy to all men.
Provide for our daily bread
And clothing befitting us
May we Thy children never lack
Bless our sojourn here on earth.
All ye Band of Prayerist
ln prayer be persistent
Songs of Victory shall rend
By the power of the Triune God
Holy Jehovah we plead
Firmly establish our Band
Jehovah Nissi Father
May we serve Thee to the end.
hymns.author: Cherubim & Seraphim Church
chorus: Shout for joy, Cherubim chorus sing
Shout for joy, Seraphim chorus sing
Halleluyah, halleluyah,
HalIeluyah to our Holy King.

hymns.title: Ye Members of Seraphim
lyrics: YE members of Seraphim
And ye of Cherubim
Let's offer thanks unto our God
Let’s offer thanks unto our God
Who made us witnesses of this
special day.
A host of members of our fold
This day but can not see
A host had wandered far away
Others walloweth in trouble
Many others had passedon
To eternity.
Members of prayerist band
Be persistent in prayer
Lift up the sword of victory
The Lord with us we shall conquer
Though the devil wage war
But nay he can't prevail.
During this calendar year
The barren will be blessed
All the sick shall be wholly healed
No epidemic in our homes
The broken hearted
Shall sweet comfort receive.
To all those who do lack
Father above shall provide
The hungerud shall be fully fed
The debtors fully be redeemed
Penury shall cease and
Joy shall fill our hearts.
Love is the greatest command
Father bestow we plead
Let elders share love with the young
Amongst malefolks and femalefolks
In love host of Angels
keep praising Father above.
The book of prophet Joel
ln the second chapter
ln the verse of one score and eight
The word fulfilled to Cherubim
And Band of Seraphim all
within ourfold.
Glory unto Father be
Glory to Son we give
Glory be to Holy Spirit
And glory to Almighty be
Thou the focus of Seraphim
Save us from shame.
hymns.author: Cherubim & Seraphim Church
chorus: Let us all join chorus
Let us all shout halleluyah
Praises to Jehovah is due
Graceful, generous King.

hymns.title: Thanks Gave L to the Lord
lyrics: THANKS gave l in the Lord
My tongues, Christ Jesus praise
That we have not to read Thy word
Right from when we are babes.
Though my sin increaseth
Desctruction and horror
Burden of sin by the nature
The Holy Bible teach.
The Bible teaches thus
E‘en though we’re innocent
Whereforce will the sinner access
From destruction escape.
Thine divine Holy Book
Jesus my Saviour Lord
The way of salvation direct
And goodwill it doth teach.
There-in I rightly learn
How Christ the Son of God
Our great burden and grief He bore
And in our stead doth die.
In heaven He doth reign
His spirit He doth send
His greatest love to manifest
And statutes of goodwill.
Holy Spirit doth teach
That my heart will receive
And believe all Thy spoken Word
As then all that are Thine.
There and then oh my Lord
My soul of praise shall rise
‘Cos I am taught to read Thy Word
Holy Bible divine. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Praise the King of Glory, he is God Alone
lyrics: Praise the King of Glory, He is God alone
Praise Him for the wonders, He to us
hath shown
For His promised presence, All the
pilgrim way
For the flaming pillar and the cloud by day.
Praise Him for redemption, free to every soul
Praise Him for the Fountain that
can make us whole
For His gifts of kindness and His loving care
For the blest assurance that He answer prayers
Praise Him for the trials sent as cords of love
Binding us more closely to the things above
For the faith that conquers, hope
that naught can dim
For the land where loved ones gather unto Him.
hymns.author: anon
chorus: Praise..Him, shinning angels
Strike..your harps of gold
All... His hosts adore Him
Who... His face behold
Through...His great dominion
While..the ages roll
All His works shall praise Him. 3ce
Bless the Lord, my soul!

hymns.title: All Christian Churches of the World
lyrics: ALL Christian Churches of the world
Be ye ever draw nigh
To learn the true way of the Lord
In the Band of Seraphim.
There is no band like Seraphim
In all the world we know
Whose Captain is Holy Michael
Like Cherubim Scraphim.
Our guide is the Holy Spirit
That no one ever knows
Only the Visioners of God
Can testify to it.
The Brothers and all our sisters
In this our glorious Band
The Christian Army of this world
Let sing the glorious song.
The witches and all the wizards
Have no power on this Band
Our Captain Holy Saint Michael
Guide us in every hour.
lncomprehensible Thy works
That none can apprehend
ln earth nor in heaven above
No one can know His ways.
The sick and all the feeble ones
Even in this our Band
Confess the glory of His works
In all their daily life.
Cherubim and Seraphim above
Hail unto us below
To do our best to join their Band
When life below is end.
True, Holy Cherubim Seraphim
Jesus, The Christ our Lord
Glorious Light shinning from heaven
The Shinning Morning Star.
Holy, Holy, Holy Holy
Jehovah Jireh God
Jehovah Ruphy Be our Guide
Throughout our earthly life.
hymns.author: Cherubim & Seraphim Church
chorus: Join us shout Hallelujah
To the Al-Almighty God
We give thanks and praise to Him
Who has called us to this band.

hymns.title: Give Thanks All Unto our Holy God
lyrics: GIVE thanks all unto our Holy God
All ye Band of Seraphim
For His blessings bestowed on us
Victorious over our foes.
Amidst all foes amidst the critics
There we walk all day and night
But Jesus saved us from falling
Lest we be mocked by our foes.
Many are dead and buried beneath
Forgotten by living folks
Thus members of Seraphim Band
Be thankful unto God.
All ye members of Seraphim
From around and wide abroad
We wish you many happy returns
Jesus Christ shall be our guide.
Minute, Band of Seraph may be
Just like unto Nazareth
The foes may mock and critics may say
Whereforth is the Seraphim.
Can one good thing ever emanate
Forth from little Nazareth
But Jesus bids all critics now
Come forth, behold it. assured.
Give glory to our Father above
And give glory to the Son
Give glory unto Holy Spirit
EverGlorious Trinity.
hymns.author: Cherubim & Seraphim Church
chorus: Eternal revivals is come
Jesus make us fit for that day
That we may all sing Halleluyah
To the God of Trinity.

hymns.title: Great the Day of Holy Michael
lyrics: Great the day of Holy Michael
We hallow Thee God of Cherubim
All creatures come along
We hallow Thee God of Cherubim
All ye Hosts of Heaven shout
We hallow Thee God of Cherubim
Mighty one is here with us
We hallow Thee God of Cherubim.
Ye All World and ye of Heaven
We hallow Thee God of Cherubim
Bring your go‘den harps of song
We hallow Thee God of Cherubim
We together sing the song
Songs of Halle-Halle‐Luyah
Cherubim is praising Lord
We hallow Thee God of Cherubim.
Go away all bad spirit
We hallow Thee God of Cherubim
Witches, wizard will not see us
We hallow Thee God of Cherubim
Enemies to Almighty God
We hallow Thee God of Cherubim
Holy Michael conquers them
We hallow Thee God of Cherubim.
All the poor ye come and state
We hallow Thee God of Cherubim
What you need from Trinity
We hallow Thee God of Cherubim
All poverty shall remove
We hallow Thee God of Cherubim
In the name of Trinity
We hallow Thee God of Cherubim.
All the hand of Seraphim
We hallow Thee God of Cherubim
Do not mourn and be not afraid
We hallow Thee God of Cherubim
In pairs ye were selected
We hallow Thee God of Cherubim
Cherubim and Seraphim
We hallow Thee God of Cherubim.
Ye praying Band be prepared
We hallow Thee God of Cherubim
Be always in one spirit
We hallow Thee God of Cherubim
Remember your messages
We hallow Thee God of Cherubim
The fourth Chapter of St.James
We hallow Thee God of Cherubim.
Bible Class be Ye prepared
We hallow Thee God of Cherubim
Show yourselves the Christian love
We hallow Thee God of Cherubim
Wonderful is our God’s name
We hallow Thee God of Cherubim
Wonderful lesson shall be learnt
We hallow Thee God of Cherubim.
Jah Jehovah is our God
We hallow Thee God of Cherubim
He is everlasting God
We hallow Thee God of Cherubim
The Alpha and Omega
We hallow Thee God of Cherubim
Sing Halle Halleluyah
We hallow Thee God of Cherubim.
Seraphim calling Cherubim
We hallow Thee God of Cherubim
Cherubim calling Seraphim
We hallow Thee God of Cherubim
Praises to Father on high
We hallow Thee God of Cherubim
Praises to Holy Trinity
We hallow Thee God of Cherubim. Amen
hymns.author: Cherubim & Seraphim Church

hymns.title: Creator of Universe
lyrics: CREATOR of Universe
In Thy holy name
We assemble this day to
Praise thy holy name.
Protect us heavenly father
Amidst sinful world,
Keep usfeed thy children
Provide for our needs.
Cherubim and Scraphim
Be ye strong in faith:
Our Great father on high,
Knows all things we need.
Cherubim and Seruphim
Tie thy girdle firm,
Guard against temptation,
Satan and his works.
All ye Elders and leaders,
Be ye strong in God,
The Great God of Universe
Shall abide with thee.
Ye all Aladuras,
Be prayerful always
Trinity shall hear your prayers
And conquer for you.
Those of you who are barren
Father will provide;
All mothers in our band
Your children will besaved.
Those of you who are pregnant
Jah will protect you:
All ye that are without job
Father will provide.
hymns.author: Cherubim & Seraphim Church
chorus: Glory be unto thee.
Thou great God of Grace,
Let thy heavenly blessings,
On us all descend.

hymns.title: Hark! Hark! the Song the Ransomed Sing
lyrics: HARK! Hark! the song the ransomed sing,
A new-made song of praise
The Lord the Lamb they glorify
And these the strains they raise.
Made white by His redeeming blood
Our heavenly garments shine
Our minds by him enlightened prove,
The power of truth divine.
By Jesus blood we overcame
When Satan's host assailed
Was by the power of truth divine
Our feeble arms prevailed.
‘Then be the Lamb of God adored
The Lord of light and life
To Him be glory, honour and power
Andn majesty and might.
hymns.author: Words arr.
chorus: Glory to Him, who loved us
And washed us in his blood
Who cleansed our soul from guilt and sin
By that pure, living blood!

hymns.title: Sometimes a Light Surprises
lyrics: SOMETIMES a light surprises
The Christians while he sings;
It is the Lord who rises
With healing in his wings;
When comforts are declining
He grants the soul again
A season of clear shining
To cheer it after rain.
ln holy contemplation
We sweetly then pursue
The theme of God's salvation,
And find it ever never
Set free from present sorrow,
We cheerfully can say,
E’en let the unknown to-morrow
Bring with it what it may.
lt can bring with it nothing
But He will hear us through
Who gives the lilies clothing
Will clothes His people too
Beneath the spreading heavens
No creature but is fed,
And He who feeds the ravens
Will give His children bread.
Though vine nor fig-tree neither
Their wanted fruit should bear
Though all the field should wither
Nor flocks nor herds be there
Yet, God the same abiding
His praise shall tune my voice;
For while in Him confiding
I cannot but rejoice. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Our Father and our God
lyrics: OUR Father and our God
Accept our songs of praise
On earth and heav’n above
The God who reigns in love,
To Thee is due all praise and thanks
And majesty for ever more.
External Son of God
Who shed His blood for us
Who rose up from the dead
And up to heav’n ascend
To Thee is due all praise and thanks
And majesty for ever more.
To Thee the Holy Ghost
We raise our songs of praise
Thou who has shed the light
Of life into our hearts
To Thee is due all praise and thanks
And majesty for ever more.
Our Holy Triune God
We praise the Three-in‐One
On earth and heav’n above,
We raise our songs of praise
To Thee is due all praise and thanks
And majesty for ever more. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Wonderful Thoughts of the Lord
lyrics: WONDERFUL thoughts of the Lord
Never is revealed unto men. x4
Benevolence of the Lord
Testify of it unto men. x4
Benevolence of the Lord
Testify of it unto men. x4
Fruit of the womb thou received
Testify of it unto men. x4
Earthly mansion thou received
Testify of it unto men. x4
Benevolence of the Lord
Messiah, praise and glorify. x4
hymns.author: Cherubim & Seraphim Church
chorus: Very important multitude all are dead
Many men of eminence all are gone
Priviledged living men on earth
Offer praises to Almighty x3
Priviledged living men on earth
Offer praises to Almighty.

hymns.title: Awake and Sing the Song
lyrics: AWAKE, and sing the song
Of Moses and the Lamb
Wake every heart and every tongue
To praise the Saviour‘s name.
Sing of His dying love
Sing of His rising power
Sing how He intercedes above
For those whose sins He bore.
Sing on your heavenly way
Ye ransom’d sinners, sing
Sing on, rejoicing every day
In Christ, the eternal King.
Soon shall ye hear Him say
‘Ye blessed children, come
Soon will He call you hence away
And take the wanderers home.
There shall our raptured tongue
His endless praise proclaim
And sweeter voices swell the song
Of Moses and the Lamb. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: O Thou our Priceless Redeemer
lyrics: O! Thou our priceless redeemer
Thine voice we long to hark
None the song as sweet as Thy name
None as Thine protection.
Oh Thine Holy voice may we hark
In mercy speak we plead
In Christ our High Priest shall rejoice
Melchizedech The Great.
Christ Jesus, our song Thou shall be
All our days here on earth
We shall rend hymns of Jesus love
When gone all things amiss.
When above there we shall appear
In company of Thine own
Loudly then our songs we shall rend
Christ all our songs shall be. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Who is he That's Knocking at the Door
lyrics: WHO is he that's knocking at the door
of my heart?
Who is He that's knocking at the door
of my hear?
Jesus Christ, the son of God, He is
Keep the door open; let Him in.
Who is he that's knocking at the door
of my heart?
Who is he that's knocking at the door
of my heart?
Holy Spirit the Dove of Heaven, He is
Keep the door open: let Him in.
Who is He that‘s knocking at the door
of my heart?
Who is he that's knocking at the door
of my heart?
God of Provision King of kings, He is
Keep the door open, let Him in.
Who is He that‘s knocking at the door
of my heart?
Who is he that's knocking at the door
of my heart?
Our Saviour King of Univcrse He is
Keep the door open, let Him in.
Who is He that‘s knocking at the door
of my heart?
Who is he that's knocking at the door
of my heart?
God of victory and God of protection
Keep the door open, let Him in
Who is He that‘s knocking at the door
of my heart?
Who is he that's knocking at the door
of my heart?
Jesus Christ the Doctor of the sick He is
Keep the door open, let Him in.
Who is He that‘s knocking at the door
of my heart?
Who is he that's knocking at the door
of my heart?
Holy Spirit the Dove of Heaven, He is
Keep the door open. let Him in.
Who is He that‘s knocking at the door
of my heart?
Who is he that's knocking at the door
of my heart?
Jesus Christ, the Son of God, He is
Keep the door open, let Him in. Amen
hymns.author: Cherubim & Seraphim Church

hymns.title: Only the Holy Spirit Can Make a Living Soul
lyrics: Only the Holy Spirit can make a living soul
Make a living Soul (2ce)
Only the Holy Spirit can make a living soul
Without the Holy Spirit man is vanity (2ce)
Only the Holy Spirit can make a living soul.
He who has got Jesus. has in Him everything
Has every thing (2ce)
He who has got Jesus, has in Him everything
'Jesus Christ is the head of everything (2ce)
He who has got Jesus, has in Him everything.
A lot of blessings prayer bring forth in life
Brings forth in life (2ce)
A lot of blessings prayer brings forth in life
Without seeking Thee we are but vanity (2ce)
A lot of blessings prayer brings forth in life. Amen
hymns.author: Cherubim & Seraphim Church

hymns.title: Ho Reapers in the Whitened Harvest
lyrics: HO reapers in the whitened harvest
Oft feeble, faint and new
Come, wait upon the blessed Master
Our strength He will renew
Too often weary and discouraged
We pour a sad complaint
Believing in a living Saviour,
Why should we ever faint.
Rejoice! for He is with us always
Lo, even to the end,
Look up take courage and go forward
All needed grace He'll send.
hymns.author: anon
chorus: For they that wait upon the Lord
Shall renew theri strength again
They shall mount with wings
They shall mount with wings as eagles
They shall run and not be weary (3ce)
They shall work and not faint; (3ce)

hymns.title: To Thee the Comforter of Heaven
lyrics: TO Thee the Comforter of Heaven
For all goodness and Power Possessed,
To Thee whose love ever abide
In God's Holy Testimony.
To Thee whose voice ever calling
The sinner from his sinfulness.
To Thee Whose almighty Power
Can cleanse and redeem us from sin.
To Thee Whose faithfulness has made
His promises ever fulfilled.
To Thee Our Teacher and Our friend
Our True guide to the end of Days.
To Whom Christ's Glorious crown was set
And His blessings in abundance.
To Thee who is one Always with
The Father and His Son Divine.
hymns.author: Frances R. Havergal
chorus: We shout! We shout!
We shout! Hallelujah.

hymns.title: Be Ye Strong in the Lord
lyrics: BE ye strong in the Lord!
And the power of His might!
Firmly standing for the truth of His word
He shall lead you safely through
The thickest of the fight,
You shall conquer in the name of the Lord.
Be ye strong in the Lord
And the power of His might!
Never turning from the face of the foe
He will surely stand by you,
As you battle for the right
In the power of His might onward go.
Be ye strong in the Lord.
And the power of His might!
For His promises shall never never fail,
He will hold thy right hand
While you battling for the right
Trusting Him thou shalt forever more prevail.
hymns.author: El Nathan (D. W. Whittle), 1840-1901
chorus: Firmly stand firmly stand
For right-for the right
0n the victory at the Kings command
For the honour of the Lord,
And, the triumph of His word
In the strength of the Lord firmly stand.

hymns.title: Give me your Holy Spirit
lyrics: GIVE me your Holy Spirit
Your Holy Spirit (Father)
This is what I'm requesting
Give me your Holy Spirit
That I can use in your fold
Till the coming of Jesus.
Give me your Spirit might
Your Spiritual might (Father)
This is what I’m requesting
Give me your Spirit might
That I can use in your fold
Till the coming of Jesus.
Give me oil in my lamb
All in my lamp (Father)
This is what l’m requesting
Give me your spiritual might
That I can use in your fold
Till the coming of Jesus. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: There is a Stranger at the Door
lyrics: THERE's a stranger at the door
Let Him in.
He has been there oft before
Let Him in.
Let Him in are He is gone
Let Him in the Holy One'
Jesus Christ, The Father's Son
Let Him in [Let the Saviour in].
Open now to Him your heart
Let Him in!
If you wait He will depart
Let Him in!
Let Him in He is your Friend
He your soul will surely defend;
He will keep you to the end
Let Him in! [Let the Saviour in].
Hear you now His loving voice?
Let Him in!
Now, oh, now make Him your choice
Let Him in!
He is standing at the door’
Joy to you He will restore,
And his name you will adore;
Let Him in!
Now admit the heavenly Guest,
Let Him in!
He will make for you a feast
Let Him in!
He will speak your sins forgiven:
And when earth-ties all are riven
He will take you home to heaven;
Let Him in! Amen
hymns.author: Jonathan Bush Atchinson

hymns.title: Lord God the Holy Ghost
lyrics: LORD God the Holy Ghost
In this accepted hour
As on the day of Pentecost
Descend in all Thy power
We meet in one accord
In our appointed place
And wait the promise of our Lord
The Spirit of all grace.
Like mighty rushing wind
Upon the waves beneath,
Move with one impulse every mind
One soul, one feeling, breathe
The young, the old, inspire
With wisdom from above,
And give us hearts and tongues of fire
To pray, and praise, and love.
Spirit of light, explore
And chase our gloom away
With lustre shining more and more
Unto the perfect day;
Spirit of truth, be Thou
In life and death our Guide
