Saviour, make us hear Thy call,
Give our hearts to Thine obedience,
Serve and love The best of all. Amen
hymns.author: Cecil Frances Alexander

hymns.title: Heavenly Father L Want to be
lyrics: HEAV'NLY Father l want to be
In holiness and In truth
But the love of flesh attacks me
Deceiving me everyday.
I am but a feeble creature
In my spirit and body
All my frequent sins committed
Now a burden press’d me down.
There is one command in my heart
Which Thou inserted in me
For this reason I will follow
Thy love and Thy holy laws.
Even if I want to be good
I will stray immediately
Thy word is always good to me
But evil, I do always.
Many times I permit my soul
To satan for temptation
Even though Thy word has warn'd me
To depart from all my sins.
Father above, Thou and Just Thou
My salvation, Thy arm art
Blessed Saviour hath Thou sendeth
To Him alone l' eleaveth.
Lead Thou me with Holy Spirit
To the new and wholesome path
Teach me, watch me and lead me on
Thou Spirit of Most High God. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: According to thy Gracious Word
lyrics: ACCORDING to thy gracious word,
In meek humility
This will I do, my dying Lord,
I will remember thee.
Thy body, broken for my sake
O! bread from heaven shall be
Thy testamental cup l take
And thus remember thee.
Gethsemane can I forget?
O! there thy conflict see
Thine agony and bloody sweat
And not remember thee?
Remember Thee, and all thy pains
And all thy love to me
Yea, while a breath, a pulse remains
Will I remember thee.
And when these failing lips grow dumb
And mind and mem’ry flee,
When thou shall in thy Kingdom come,
Jesus, remember me. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Jesus Thou Joy of Loving Heart
lyrics: JESUS, Thou Joy of loving heart,
Thou Fount of life, Thou Light of men
From the best bliss that earth imparts
We turn unfilled to Thee again.
Thy truth unchanged hath ever stood
Thou savest those that on Thee call
To them that seek Thee Thou an good
To them that find Thee, all in all.
We taste Thee, O Thou Living Bread,
And long to feast uponThee still
We drink of Thee, the Fountain-head,
And thirst our soul from Thee to fill.
Our restless spirit yearn for Thee
Where'er our changeful lot is cast
Glad when Thy gracious smile we see
Blest when our faith can hold Thee fast.
O Jesus, ever with us stay
Make all our moments calm and bright
Chase the dark night of sin away;
Shed O'er the world Thy holy light. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: All the Night at the Dusk of Woe
lyrics: ALL the night, at the dusk of woe
When hade erupteth in its strength
Unto Wonderful, Son of God
Gift of victory against His foe.
Ere commence His passton and strife
The bread He offereth, art though blessed
Thou who Thine work in all art love
Hark His word spoken art of grace.
His sacred flesh offered for sin
Partake, oh, bread of life it be
The sacred wine He gavest thee
This art my covenant, my blood.
This He commandeth do till aye
In mem’ry of thy sacred friend
Whence thou shall meet, recall to thee
Thy departed God is but love.
Christ Jesus Thy commands our Joy
Thine redemptive death, hymns reveal
Ere Thou cometh hither below
Supper we shall with Thee partake. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Oh Blessed Lamb Divine of God
lyrics: OH blessed lamb divine of God
Cleanse me with Thine blood Lord I plead
Let me alone Thine will to know
Pain is sweet and death hath reward.
Lift up my soul from earth away
Let it be Thine for ever Lord
Fill into my heart Lord Thine seal
The seal of life for ever more.
Ah! How great is their joy Oh Lord
Whose refuge is Thine riven side
In thee hath they, their power and strength
In Thee Oh Lord they dine and wine.
It is of great surprise oh God
That by grace Thine glory we earn
By Thine adoption we are crowned
To wallow in eternal bliss.
Father we plead, may we rethink
Thine wonderous works to appreciate
At liberty, our tongues to set
May we speak often of Thine love.
Christ Jesus Lord Thou art our head
To Thee shall we reverendly bow
To Thee shall we render our soul
In death, in life let us be Thine. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: O Ye Friends and All our Neighbours
lyrics: O ye friends and all our neighbours
Come in before the house of joy is full
All mankind Christ hail thee to quickly come
Come join this Band of Salvation before its full.
All ye the band of Church of God on earth
Heathens, Muslims and Idol worshippers
All mankind Christ Hail to quickly come
Come join this band of salvation before its full.
African church and all (the) foreign churches
All worshippers of God in Christian Way
Jesus our Lord is loudly calling you
Come join this band of salvation before it's full.
The God of Shedrack loudly calling you
The God of Meshack loudly calling you
The God of Abednigo calling you
Come join this Band of salvation before it‘s full.
The God of Abraham loudly calling you
The God of Isaac loudly calling you
The God of Jacob loudly calling you
Come join this Band of salvation before it’s full.
The God of David loudly calling you
The God of Daniel loudly calling you
God of, Bathimeaus loudly calling you
Come join this band of salvation before it‘s full.
The God of Mary loudly calling you
The God of Martha loudly calling you
The God of Esther loudly calling you
Come join this Band of salvation before it's full.
Cherub Seraphim loudly calling you
The God of Israel loudly calling you
Angels of Heaven loudly calling you
Come join this Band of salvation before it‘s full.
hymns.author: Cherubim & Seraphim Church
chorus: Came quickly, come enter)
Christ loudly hail on thee). 3ce
Come in before the Noah’s Ark
to brim is fill’d.

hymns.title: Come Holy Ghost Descend from High
lyrics: COME holy ghost descend from high
Baptizer of our soul art Thou
The sacramental seal apply
And witness with the water now.
Pour faith thy energy divine
And sprinkle the atoning blood
May Father, Son and Spirit join
To seal this child a Son of God. Amen
hymns.author: st. 1 Charles Wesley, 1749; st. 2 Augustus Montague Toplady

hymns.title: Almighty Father Hear our Cry
lyrics: ALMIGHTY Father, hear our cry
As o‘er the traekless deep we roam
Be Thou our haven always nigh
On homeless waters Thou our home.
O Jesus, Saviour, at Whose Voice
The tempest sank to perfect rest
Bid Thou the mourner’s heart rejoice
And cleanse and calm the troubl’d breast.
O Holy Ghost, beneath, Whose pow-'r
The ocean woke to life and light
Command Thy blessing in this hour
Thy fost‘ring warmth, Thy quick’ning night.
Great God, Truine Jehovah, Thee
We love, we worship, we adore
Our Refuge on time’s changeful sea
Our Joy on Heav‘n Eternal shore. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Band of Seraph Look to the Flag
lyrics: BAND of Seraph look to the flag,
Triumphantly fly
Jesus Army will soon be here
We shall soon conquer.
Lo! satan with host approaching
Michael, them dislodged
The vailent ones are all fallen
Seraph stifle them.
Jesus Saviour speaketh to us
Lo! behold I come
Gladly we flash a response down
Rise up and conquer.
When the fight is fierce and dangerous
He says do not fear
Holy Michael valiant Captain
His sword straightly drawn.
See the flag of Jesus flying
Trumpet loudly sounds
All our foes will Moses conquer
By The Name of Christ.
hymns.author: Cherubim & Seraphim Church
chorus: Rise The Praying Father Rise up
Jesus select thee
We thy children ever ready
We shall never fear.

hymns.title: Jesus Still Lead on
lyrics: JESUS, still lead on
Till our rest be won
And, although the way be cheerless
We will follow calm and fearless,
Guide us by the hand
To our Fatherland.
If the way be drear
If the foes be near
Let not faithless fears o’ertake us
Let not faith and hope forsake us
For through many a foe
To our home we go.
When we seek relief
From a long-felt grief
When oppress’d by new temptations
Lord, increase and perfect patience
Show us that bright shore
Where we weep no more.
Jesus, still lead on
Till our rest be won
Heavenly Leader, still direct us
Still support, console, protect us,
Till we safely stand
In our Fatherland. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Jesus is Head of Seraph Band
lyrics: JESUS is Head of Seraph Band
We need not be affrightened
He captains the boat of our lives
We need not be affrightened.
All we in boat of Christ Jesus
Look unto Saviour only,
Respose implicit faith in Him
He shall land us in safety.
Lord Jesus Saviour whose command
Quietened the waves of sea
Thou who traversed over the sea,
And slept as if unconcerned.
What is the cause of all your fears?
Ye, Army of Christ Jesus
Jesus who dwellest in our boat
Shall make us laugh at all waves.
When waves of troubled world shall come
All over sea and on land
There is an assuring shelter
That cometh from Christ Jesus.
From the world's lions and leopards,
From claws of wild enemies
Christ Jesus shall keep his elects,
Jesus shall protect his own.
God, the Three in one, one in Three
Trinity, shelter us all;
On all troubles and temptations
Make us shout Hallelujah.
Glory to Our Holy Father
Glory to His Holy Son
Glory be to Holy Spirit
All praises to Trinity.
hymns.author: Cherubim & Seraphim Church
chorus: We need not fear
But filled with joy
For Jesus shall captain our boat
How serious condition may be
We shall safely land unhurt.

hymns.title: Guide me O Thou Great Jehovah
lyrics: GUIDE me, O Thou Great Jehovah
Pilgrim through this barren land:
I am weak, but Thou art mighty
Hold me with Thy powerful hand;
Bread of heaven, (2ce)
Feed me till I want no more.
Open now the crystal fountain
Whence the healing stream doth flow
Let Thy fire and cloudy pillar
Lead me all my journey through
Strong deliverer, (2ce)
BeThou still my strength and shield.
When I tread the verge of Jordan
Bid my anxious fear subside
Death of deaths and hell’s destruction
Land me safe on Zion side
Songs of praises (2ce)
I will ever give to Thee. Amen
hymns.author: William Williams

hymns.title: We are the Light of the World
lyrics: WE are the light of the world
Cherubim Seraphim
The city set on the rock
How can it for ever be hidden.
Listen attentively now
Jesus love words to you
Asking you in aloud voice
Oh my son tell me if thou lovedst me.
Cherubim and Seraphim
Go ye to all the world
Preach ye the Holy Gospel
All who ever hear will be redeemed.
Oh friends and all our neighbors
Join ye this Holy Band
Sent down to us by our God
Come ye quickly before its too late.
Remember ye Noah’s day
When man was deep in pleasures
That only beast join the Ark
Leaving the Son of mankind in regret.
Wordly pleasure will vanish
Lot's wife a lesson be
Seek Salvation of your soul
And shall ye regret at the end.
Father, of help be to us
Thine will may be observe
At the end, the voice may sound
Cherubim Seraphim dorn the crown.
hymns.author: Cherubim & Seraphim Church
chorus: Let's do God's work
Let's do God's work
Let's do God's work
To receive salvation at the end.

hymns.title: Thanks we Offer Unto the Lord
lyrics: THANKS we offer unto the Lord
Fe‐li‐cita-te with me
For journey mercies I received
Thanks be to Thee oh Lord.
Cherubim and the Seraphim
Glory give to His name
To Him who this Band established
King of glory He is.
Rejoice and chorus glorious hymns
To Jesus glorious King
His name is spread all o’er the earth
He took me to and fro.
Thanks is due unto Thee oh Lord
Thine protection on me
Through and around the universe
To Thine name glory be.
Proclaim Him all around the world
Come-on come-on my Lord
Our Holy and Eternal King
The sacred Trinity.
Rend to Him glorious holy songs
Thanks be unto the Lord
In peace we journeyed to and fro
I give thanks Lord to Thee.
Shout unto Him Halleluyah
To God of Cherubim
Shout unto Him Halleluyah
To God of Seraphim. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Christian Seek not yet Repose
lyrics: CHRISTIAN seek not yet repose
Hear Thy guardian angels say
Thou an in the midst of foes
“Watch and pray".
Principalities and power
Mustering their unseen array
Wait for thy unguarded hours
“Watch and pray”.
Gird thy heavenly armour on,
Wear it every night and day
Ambush'd lies the evil one
“Watch and pray”.
Hear the victors who o‘ercame
Still they mark each warrior’s way
All with one sweet voice exclaim
“Watch and pray".
Hear above all, hear thy Lord
Him thou lovest to obey,
Hide within thy heart His word
“Watch and pray”.
Watch as if on that alone
Hung the issue of the day
Pray that help be descend down
“Watch and pray". Amen
hymns.author: Charlotte Elliott

hymns.title: I Am a Stranger here
lyrics: I am a stranger here
Heav’n is my Home
Earth is a desert drear
Heav’n is my Home
Danger and sorrow stand
Round me on every hand
Heav’n is my Fatherland
Heav'n is my Home.
What though the tempest rage
Heav’n is my Home
Short is my pilgrimage
Heav’n is my Home
And time’s wild wintry blast
Soon will be over passed
I shall reach Home at last
Heav‘n is my Home.
There at my Saviour’s side
Heav’n is my Home
I shall be glorified
Heav’n is my Home
There are the good and blest
Those I love most and best
And there I too shall rest
Heav’n is my Home.
Therefore I murmur not
Heav’n is my Home
Whate’er my earthly lot
Heav’n is my Home
And I shall surely stand
There at my Lord's right Hand
Heav’n is my Fatherland
Heav’n is my Home. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Lead us Heav’nly Father Lead us
lyrics: LEAD us, heav’nly Father, lead us
O’er the world’s tempestuous sea
Guard us, guide us, keep us, feed us
For we have no help but Thee
Yet possessing every blessing
If our God our Father be.
Saviour, breathe forgiveness o'er us
All our weakness Thou dost know
Thou didst tread this earth before us
Thou didst feel its keenest woe
Lone and dreary, faint and weary
Through the desert Thou didst go.
Spirit of our God, descending
Fill our hearts with heavenly joy
Love with every passion blending
Pleasure that can never cloy
This provided, pardon’d guided,
Nothing can our peace destroy. Amen
hymns.author: James Edmeston

hymns.title: Oft in Danger Oft in Woe
lyrics: OFT in danger, oft in woe
Onward, Christians, onward go
Fight the fight, maintain the strife
Strengthened with the bread of Life.
Shrink not, Christian: will ye yield?
Will ye quit the painful field?
Will ye flee in danger's hour?
Know ye not your Captain's pow'r?
Let your dropping hearts be glad;
March in heavenly armour clad
Fight, nor think the battle long
Soon shall vict’ry tune your song.
Let not sorrow dim your eye
Soon shall every tear be dry
Let not fear your course impede
Great your strength if great your need.
Onward then to glory move
More than conquerors ye shall prove,
Though oppos’d by many a foe
Christian soldiers, onward go. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Why Should I Fear the Darkest Hour
lyrics: WHY should I fear the darkest hour
Or tremble at the tempter's power?
Jesus vouch safes to be my tower.
Though hot the fight, why quit the field
Why must I either fly or yield Since
Jesus is my mighty shield?
I know not what may soon betide
Or how my wants shall be supplied
But Jesus knows, and will provide.
Though sin would fill me with distress
The throne of grace l dare address
For Jesus is my righteousness.
Though faint my prayers, and cold my way
My steadfast hope shall not remove
While Jesus intereedes above.
Against me earth and hell combine
But on my side is power divine
Jesus is all, and He is mine. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Shepherd Christ Jesus Will Provide
lyrics: SHEPHERD Christ Jesus will provide
Witht green pastures He shall feed me
His blessed hands shall profer help
His eyes shall watch all over me
At dawn shall follow me about
And shall protect me through the dusk.
Whilst l was wandering all about
In all my wilderness journey
To the peaceful plain, I He brought
My feet He led to the pathway
Beside the peaceful flowing stream
In the midst of greener pastures.
E’en though I trod through the path way
In the dreadful valley of death
I will never fear nor be fraught
For Thou an ever with me be
Thine rod and staff shall aid me to
Trod the valley of death unhurt.
Aftermath weariness of strife
Thou set a table before me
Thine goodness and mercy I found
Mine cup filleth, over runeth
Heavenly hope offer me Thou
My eternal mansion above. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Onward Christian Soldiers
lyrics: ONWARD, Christian Soldiers,
Marching as to war
With the cross of Jesus going on before
Christ the royal meter leads against the foe,
Forward into battle see, His barriers go onward.
At the name of Jesus, Satan’s host doth flee,
On then Christian, soldier on the victory march
Hell’s foundation, quiver at the shout of praise
Brothers lift your voices high and loud
your anthems raise.
Like a mighty army, moves the Church of God
Brothers we are treading where the saint
have trod
We are not divided all one body we,
One in hope and one in doctrine one in charity.
Crowns and throne may perish
Kingdoms rise and wane:
But the Church of Jesus constant will remain
Gates of hell can never ‘gainst the church prevail
We have Christ's own promise and this
cannot ever fail.
Onward, then ye people join our happy throng
Blend with ours your voices in the triumph song
Glory, praise and honour unto Christ the King
This through countless ages men and Angels
ever sing.
hymns.author: Sabine Baring-Gould
chorus: Onward Christian Soldiers, marching as to war
With the cross of Jesus going on before.

hymns.title: Leader of Faithful Souls and Guide
lyrics: LEADER of faithful souls and guide
Of all that travel to the sky
Come, and with us, e’en us abide
Who would on Thee alone rely
On Thee alone our spirits stay
While held in life’s uneven way.
Stangers and pilgrims here below
This earth, we know, is not our place
But hasten through the vale of woe
And, restless to behold Thy face
Swift to our heavenly country move
Our everlasting home above.
Through Thee, who all our sins hast borne
Freely and graciously forgiven
With songs to Zion we return
Contending for our native heaven
That palace of our glorious King
We find it nearer while we sing.
Raised by the breath of love divine
We urge our way with strength renew’d
The church of the first-born to join
We travel to the mount of God
With joy upon our heads arise
And meet our Captain in the skies. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Why those Fears Behold Tis Jesus
lyrics: WHY those fears? Behold, tis Jesus
Holds the helm and guides the ship
Spread the sails and catch the breezes
Sent to wraft us through the deep
To the regions - 2ce
Where the mouners cease to weep.
Though the shore we hope to land on
Only by report is known
Yet we freely all abandon
Led by that report alone
And with Jesus - 2ce
Through the treckless deep move on.
Led by that, we brave the ocean
Led by that, the storms defy
Calm amidst tumultuous motion
Knowing that our Lord is nigh
Waves obey Him - 2ce
And the storm before Him fly.
Oh what pleasures there await us
There the tempests cease to roar
There it is that those who hate us
Can molest our peace no more
Trouble ceases - 2ce
On that tranquil happy shore. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Oh for a Closer Walk with God
lyrics: OH! for a closer walk with God
A calm and heavenly frame
A light to shine upon the road
That leads me to the Lamb!
Where is the wholesomeness I know
When first I saw the Lord?
Where is the soul-refreshing view
Of Jesus and his word?
What peaceful hour I once enjoyed
How sweet their memory still
But they have left an aching void
The world can never fill.
Return O holy dove, return
Sweet messenger of rest
I hate the sins that made thee mourn
And drove Thee from my breast.
The dearest I do I have kown
Whate'er that idol be
Help me to tear it from Thy throne
And worship only Thee.
So shall my walk be close with God
Calm and Serene my frame;
So purer light shall mark the road
That leads me to the Lamb. Amen
hymns.author: William Cowper

hymns.title: O Holy Spirit Friend Unseen
lyrics: O Holy Spirit, Friend unseen
The faint, the weak on Thee may lean
Help me, throughout life‘s varying scene
By faith to cling to Thee.
Blest with communion so divine
Take what Thou wilt, shall I repine
When, as the branches to the vine
My soul may cling to Thee.
Far from her home, fatigued, opprest,
Here she has found a place of rest
An exile still, yet not unblessed
While she can cling to Thee.
What though the world deceitful prove,
And earthly friends and joy's remove
With patient uncomplaining love
Still would I cling to Thee.
Oft when I seem to trend alone
Some barren waste with throne o'er grown
A Voice of love in gentlest tone
Whispers, “Still cling to Me".
Though faith and hope awhile be tried
I ask not, need not, aught besides
How safe, how clam, how satisfied
The souls that cling to Thee!
They fear not life's rough storms to brave
Since Thou art near and strong to save,
Nor shudder e'en at death's dark wave
Because they cling to Thee.
Blest is my lot, whate’er befall
What can disturb me, who appeal
While, as my strength, my rock, my all,
Saviour, I cling to Thee? Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Rest of the Weary Joy of the Sad
lyrics: REST of the weary, joy of the sad
Hope of the dreary, light of the glad
Home of the stranger, strength to the end
Refuge from danger, Saviour and friend.
Pillow, where lying, love rests its head
Peace of the dying, life of the dead
Path of the lowly, prize at the end
Breath of the holy, Saviour and friend.
When my feet stumble to Thee I‘ll cry
Crown of the humble, cross of the high
When my steps wander, over me bend
Truer and fender, Saviour and Friend.
Ever confessing Thee, I will raise
Unto Thee blessing, glory, and praise
All my endeavour, world without end
Thine to be ever, Saviour and Friend. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Brightly Gleams our Banner
lyrics: BRIGHTLY gleams our banner
pointing to the sky
Waving on Christ’s soldiers
To their home on high
Marching through the desert,
Gladly thus we pray
Still with beans united
Singing on our way.
Jesus, Lord and master
At Thy sacred feet
Here, with hearts rejoicing
See Thy children meet
Often have we left Thee
ofien gone astray
Keep us, mighty Saviour
In the narrow way.
All our days direct us
In the way we go
Lead us on victorious
Over every foe;
Bid Thine angels shield us
When the storm-clouds lower
Pardon Lord and save us
In the last dread hour.
Then with saints and angels
May we join above
offring pray’rs and praises
At Thy throne of love
When the march is over
Then come rest and peace
Jesus in His beauty
Songs that never cease.
hymns.author: anon
chorus: Brightly gleams our banner
Pointing to the sky
Waving on Christ's soldiers
To their home on high.

hymns.title: Ye Mammoth Crowd Where Goeth Thou
lyrics: YE mammoth crowd where goeth thou?
While in thine hand banners waving
We’ goeth the earthly pathway
The Gospel to proclaim and spread.
Ye elders and youth fellowship
Come join us rend the Gospel hymns
And the malefolks and femalefolks
In fellowship let's worship Him.
Ye members of the faithful Band
Spread all over the universe
Let us shun anta-go-ni‐sm
Let us shew love to our neighbours.
Let us in fellowship march on
Into the Band of Seraphim
Oh come along, oh come along
Christ Jesus calling on us all.
hymns.author: anon
chorus: We members of Cherubim,
Seraphim Raiseth up by the Lord
We are dancing and rejoicing
For Thine grace freely receiveth.

hymns.title: Oh my Comrades Behold the Flag
lyrics: OH! my comrades behold the flag
Flying in the sky
Host of Jesus army is come
Our victory is nigh.
Opposing armies approaching
By satan is led
Mighty men round us are falling
Courage almost lost.
Behold Jesus‘ banner flying
Hark the trumpet sound
Our enemies we shall conquer
By the name of Christ.
Pierce and tense the battle rages
Divine help is nigh
Our Captain is fast approaching
Cheer! O! comrades, cheer!
hymns.author: Philip P. Bliss
chorus: Hold to fort, Lo! I am coming
Thus Christ Jesus speak
Flash a response unto heaven
We shall hold to fort.

hymns.title: Nay no Abode for us on Earth
lyrics: NAY! no abode for us on earth
This of woe unto sinners be
No passion for The holy saints
They desire heavenly rest.
Nay! no abode for us on earth
What a woe! if our home is here
May our thought pleasant moment brought
All our hope the city to come.
Nay! no abode for us on earth
The great city, sought but not seen
Zion the city of our Lord
Ever shine ever gleaming light.
Lord who art the abode of love
Where the pilgrims their rest observe
E’en though wings I have like the dove
Unto Thee I shall fly and rest.
Be still and not enraged my soul
Wait for the season of the Lord
Mine; Thine will alone to obey
Thine; Me with Thy glory endow. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Stand up Stand up for Jesus
lyrics: STAND up stand up for Jesus
Ye soldiers of the cross
Lift high His royal banner
It must not suffer loss
Form victory unto victory
His army shall He lead
Till every foe is vanquished
And Christ is Lord indeed.
Stand up stand up for Jesus
The trumpet call obey
Forth to the mighty conflict
In this His glorious day
Ye valiant men now serve Him
Against unnumbered foes
Your courage rise with danger
And strength to strength oppose.
Stand up stand up for Jesus
Stand in His strength alone
The arm of flesh will fail you
Ye dare not trust your own
Put on the gospel amour
And watching unto prayer
When duty calls or danger
Be never wanting there.
Stand up stand up for Jesus
The strife will not belong
This day the noise of battle
The next the Victor’s song
To him that overcometh
Crown of life shall he adorn
He with the King of glory
Shall reign eternally. Amen
hymns.author: George Duffield

hymns.title: Soldiers of Christ Arise
lyrics: SOLDIERS of Christ arise
And put your armour on
Strong in the strength which God supplies
Through His eternal Son.
Strong in the Lord of Hosts
And in His mighty power
Who in the strenght of Jesus trusts
Is more than conqueror.
Stand then in His great might
With all His strenght endued
But take, to arm you for the fight
The panoply of God.
From strength to strength go on
Wrestle, and fight, and pray
Tread all the powers of darkness down
And win the well-fought day.
That, having all things done
And all the conflicts past
Ye may o’ercome through Christ alone
And stand entire at last. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: The Son of God Goes Forth to War
lyrics: THE Son of God goes forth to war
A kingly crown to gain
His blood-red banner streams afar
Who follows in His train?
Who best can drink his cup of woes
Triumphant over pain
Who patient bears his cross below
He follows in His train.
The martyr first, whose eagle eye
Could pierce beyond the grave
Who saw his Master in the sky
And call'd on Him to save.
Like Him, with pardon on his tongue
In midst of mortal pain
He pray’d for them that did the wrong
Who follows in his train?
A glorious band, the chosen few
On whom the Spirit came
Twelve valiant saints, their hope they knew
And mock‘d the cross and flame.
The met the tyrant’s brandish’d steel
The lion's glory name
They bowed their necks the death to feel
Who follows in their train.
A noble army, men and boys
The matron and the maid
Around the Saviour’s throne rejoice
In robes of light arrayed.
They climbed the steep ascent of heav‘n
Through peril, toil, and pain
O God, to us may grace be giv‘n
To follow in their train. Amen
hymns.author: Reginald Heber

hymns.title: My God my Father while I Stray
lyrics: MY God, my Father, while I stray
Far from my home on life rough way
Oh teach me from my heart to say
Thy will be done.
Though dark my path and sad my lot
Let me be still and murmur not;
Oh breathe the prayer divinely taught,
Thy will be done.
What though in lonely grief
l sigh For friends beloved no longer nigh
Submissive still would I reply
Thy will do done.
If thou shouldst call me to resign
What most I prize, it ne’er was mine:
I only yield Thee what isThine
Thy will be done.
Let but my fainting heart be blessed
With thy sweet Spirit for its guest,
My God, to thee I leave the rest
Thy Will be done.
Renew my will from day to day
Blend it with Thine, and take away
All that now makes it hard to say
Thy will be done.
Then, when on earth! breathe no more
The prayer: oft mix'd with tears before
I'll sing upon a happier shore
Thy will be done. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Through the Night of Doubt and Sorrow
lyrics: THROUGH the night of doubt and sorrow
Onward goes the pilgrims band
Singing songs of expectation
Marching to the promised land.
Clear before us through the darkness
Gleams and burns the guiding light
Brother clasps the hand of brother
Stepping fearless through the night.
One the light of God’s own presence
O'er His ransonmed people shed
Chasing far the gloom and terror
Brightening all the path we tread.
One the object of our journey
One the faith which never tires
One the earnest looking forward
One the hope our God inspires.
One the strain that lips of thousand
Lift as from the heart of one
One the conflict, one the peril
One the march in God begun.
One the gladness of rejoicing
On the far eternal shore
Where the one almighty Father
Reigns in love for evermore.
Onward therefore, pilgrim brothers
Onward with the Cross our aid!
Bear its shame, and fight its battle
Till we rest beneath its shade.
Soon shall come the great awaking
Soon the tending of the tomb
Then the scattering of all shadows
And the end of toil and gloom. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: My Soul is Happy in Christ Jesus
lyrics: MY soul is happy in Christ Jesus
For He is so precious to me
His voice it is music to hear it
His face it is heaven to see.
He sought me so long ere I knew Him
When wand’ring afar from the fold
Safe home in His arms He hath brought me
To where there are pleasure untold.
His love and His mercy surround me
His grace like a river doth flow
His spirit, to guide and to comfort
Is with me wherever I go.
The day, I shall someday be like
Him My cross and my burden lay down
Till then I will ever be faithful
In gathering rare gems for His crown.
hymns.author: Edwin Othello Excell
chorus: I am happy in Him
I am so happy in Him
My soul with delight doth
He fill day and night
For I am so happy in Him.

hymns.title: Onward Seraphim Band, Marching as to War
lyrics: ONWARD Seraphim Band, marching as to war
Lift on high victory sword, ‘gainst satan and sin
Almighty conqueror, hath conquered for us
Amidst num‐ber-less foes, be not afrightened
Do the will of the Lord, like the saints of old
God who hark to Abrah'm
Shall hark to our plea.
Onward Cherubim Band, marching as to war
Walls of Jericho fell, for the sacred songs
Marching from strength to strength,
spoils of war to stock
Onward! marching-onward ever
amidst countless scuffs
Do the will of the Lord, like the saints of old
God who hark to Moses, shall hark to our plea.
Forget not His powers on Pharaoh the King
Forget not His victory amidst the red sea
Cloudly pillar at the dawn, beam of fire at dusk
To defend and shield them away from effects
of foes
Do the will of the Lord, like the Saints of old
God who hark to Joshua, shall hark to our plea.
Father, God, Provider, shall our needs provide
Forget not His mercies in the wilderness
Water for the thirsty, sourceth from the Rock
Meat for the hungered provi‐deth all
manna and Quails
Do the will of the Lord, like the Saints of old
God who hark to Daniel, shall hark to our plea.
Forward ever marching, amidst temptations
Ceaselessly praying on, thou shall victory earn
Our protection repose on the strength of God
Forget not Saints Shadrack, Meshach
and Abednego
Do the will of the Lord, like the Saints of old
God who heard Elijah, shall hark to our plea.
Seraphim here below, fe-li-ci-ta-ting
Cherubim here below, fe-li-ci-ta-ting
Feast of God in heaven above we shall all partake
Won in fellowship with the martyrs
Praising God above
Do the will of the Lord, like the Saints of old
The Holy Trinity, shall hark to our plea. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: With the Sweet Word of Peace
lyrics: WITH the sweet word of peace
We bid our brethren go
Peace, as a river, to increase
And ceaseless flow.
With the calm word of pray‘r
We earnestly commend
Our brethren to Thy watchful care
Eternal Friend.
With the dear word of love
We give our brief farewell
Our love below, and Thine above
With them shall dwell.
With the strong word of faith
We stay oursleves on Thee
That Thou, O Lord, in life and death
Their help shall be.
Then the bright word of hope
Shall on our parting gleam
And tell of joys beyond the scope
Of earth-born dream.
Farewell; in hope and love
In faith, and peace, and prayer
Till He whose home is ours above
Unite us there. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Ye Servant of the Lord
lyrics: YE servant of the Lord,
Each in his office wait
Observant of His heav’nly word
And watchful at His gate.
Let all your lamps be bright
And trim the golden flame
Gird up your loins, as in His sight
For awful is His name.
Watch ‘tis your Lord’s command
And while we speak, He’s near
Mark the first signal of His hand
And ready all appear.
Oh, happy servant he,
In such a posture found
He shall his Lord with rapture see,
And be with honour crown’d.
Christ shall the banquet spread
With His own royal hand
And raise that faithful servant‘s head
Amid (the) angelic band. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Jesus I Rest on Thee
lyrics: JESUS, I rest on Thee
In Thee myself I hide
Laden with guilt and misery
Where can I rest beside?
‘Tis on Thy meek and lowly breast
My weary soul alone can rest.
Thou Holy One of God
The Father rests in Thee
The voice of Thy atoning blood
Pleads evermore for me.
The curse is gone: through Thee I’m blest
God rest in thee, in Thee I rest.
The slave of sin and fear
Thy truth my bondage broke
And now my spirit loves to wear
Thy light and easy yoke
The love which fills my grateful breast
Makes duty joy labour rest.
Soon the bright glorious day
The rest of God, shall come
Sorrow and sin shall pass away
And I shall reach my home
Then of the promised land possess’d
My soul shall know eternal rest. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Take my Life and Let it be
lyrics: TAKE my life, and let it be
Consecrated, Lord, to Thee
Take my moments and my days
Let them flow in ceaseless praise.
Take my hands, and let them move
At the impulse of Thy love,
Take my feet, and let them be
Swift and beautiful for Thee.
Take my voice, and let me sing
Always, only for my King
Take my lips, and let them be
Filled with messages from Thee.
Take my silver and my gold
Not a mite would I withhold
Take my intellect, and use
Every pow’r as Thou shalt choose.
Take my will, and make it Thine
It shall be no longer mine
Take my heart it is Thine own
It shall be Thy royal throne.
Take my love, my Lord, I pour
At Thy feet its treasure-store
Take myself, and I will be
Ever, only all for Thee! Amen
hymns.author: Frances Ridley Havergal

hymns.title: Trusting in the Lord thy God
lyrics: TRUSTING in the Lord thy God
Onward go! onward go!
Holding fast His promised word
Onward go!
Ne’er deny His worthy name
Though it bring reproach and shame
Spreading still His wondrous fame
Onwardgo!
Has He called thee to the plough
Onward go! onward go!
Night is coming serve Him now
Onward go!
Faith and love in service blend
On His mighty arm depend
Standing fast until the end
Onward go!
Has He give thee golden grain
Onward go! Onward go!
Sow, and thou shalt reap again
Onward go!
To thy Master’s gate repair
Watching be and wanting there
He will hear and answer prayer
Onward go!
Has he said the end is near
Onward go! onward go
Serving Him with holy fear
Onward go!
Christ thy portion, Christ thy stay
Heav’nly bread upon the way
Leading on to glorious day
Onward go!
In this little moment then
Onward go! Onward go!
In thy ways acknowledge Him
Onward go!
Let His mind be found in thee
Let His will thy pleasure be
Thus in life and liberty
Onward go! Amen
hymns.author: Ellen Bibby

hymns.title: Work for the Night is Coming
lyrics: WORK, for the night is coming
Work, through the morning hours
Work, while the dew is sparkling
Work, Mid springing flowers
Work when the day grows brighter
Work in the glowing sun
Work for the night is coming
When man's work is done.
Work for the night is coming
Work through the sunny noon
Fill brightest hours with labour
Rest comes sure and soon
Give every flying minute
Something to keep in stores
Work for the night is coming
When man work no more.
Work for the night is coming
Under the sunset skies
While their bright tints are glowing
Work, for daylight flies
Work till the last beam fadeth
Fadeth to shine no more
Work while the night is darkening
When man’s work is O‘er. Amen
hymns.author: Annie Louisa Walker (Coghill)

hymns.title: To the Work to the Work
lyrics: TO the work, to the work!
We are servants of God
Let us follow the path that our
master has trod
With the balm of His counsel our
Strength to renew
Let us do with our might what our
Hands find to do:
To the work, to the work, let the
hungry, be fed
To the fountain of life let the
weary be led
In the cross and its banner our
glory shall be
While we herald the tidings
salvation is free.
To the work, to the work!
There is labour for all
For the kingdom of darkness and
error shall fall
And the name of Jehovah exalted
shall be
in the loud-swelling chorus,
salvation is free.
To the work, to the work
In the strength of the Lord
And a robe and a crown shall our
labour renew
When the home of the faithful
Our dwelling shall be
And we shout with the ransom'd
Salvation is free.
hymns.author: anon
chorus: Toilling on (4 times)
Let us hope, let us watch
And labour till the Master comes.

hymns.title: I Gave my Life for Thee
lyrics: I gave my life for thee
My precious blood I shed
That thou might ransom'd be
And quicken‘d from the death
I gave my life for thee
What has thou given for me?
I spent long years for thee
In weariness and woe
That an eternity
Of joy thou mightest know
I spent long years for thee
Hast thou spent one for me.
My father's home of light
My rain bow-circled throne
I left for earthly night
For wanderings sad and lone
I left it all for thee
Hast thou left ought for me?
I suffered much for thee
More than thy tongue can tell
Of bitterest agony,
To rescue thee from hell
l suffer’d much for thee
What canst thou bear for me.
And I have brought to thee
Down from my home above
Salvation full and free
My pardon and my love
Great gifts I brought to thee
What hast thou brought to me.
Oh let thy life be given
Thy years for me be spent
World-fetters all be riven
And joy with suffering blent
I gave myself for thee,
Give thou Thyself to me. Amen
hymns.author: Frances Ridley Havergal, 1836-79

hymns.title: Take up thy Cross the Saviour Said
lyrics: TAKE up thy cross, the saviour said
If thou wouldest disciple be
Deny thyself, the world forsake
And humbly follow after Me.
Take up thy cross, let not its weight
Fill thy weak spirit with alarm
His str’ngth shall bear thy spirit up
And brace thy heart, and nerve thine arm.
Take up thy cross, nor heed the shame
Nor let thy foolish pride rebel
‘Twill guide thee to a better home
And lead to victory o’er the grave.
Take up thy cross, and follow
Christ Nor think till death to lay it down
For only he who bears the cross
May hope to wear the glorious crown.
To Thee, Great Lord, the One in Three
All praise for evermore ascend
O grant us in our Hope to see
The heav’nly life that knows no end. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Shine Thou upon us Lord
lyrics: SHINE Thou upon us, Lord
True Light of men, to-day
And through the written word
Thy very self display
That so, from hearts which burn
With gazing on Thy face
The little ones may learn
The wonders of Thy grace.
Breathe Thou upon us, Lord
Thy Spirit's living flame
That so with one accord
Our lips may tell Thy name
Give Thou the hearing ear
Fix Thou the wandering thought
That those we teach may hear
The great things Thou has wrought.
Speak Thou for us, O Lord
In all we say of Thee
According to Thy word
Let all our teaching be
That so Thy lambs may know
Their own true Shepherd's voice
Where'er He leads them go
And in His love rejoice.
Live Thou within us, Lord
Thy mind and will be ours
Be Thou belov'd, adored
And served, with all our pow‘rs
That so our lives may teach
Thy children what Thou art,
And plead, by more than speech,
For Thee with every heart. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Come Labour on who Dares Stand Idle
lyrics: COME Labour on who dares stand idle
on the harvest plain
While all around Him wave the golden
grains
And to each servant do the master say
Go work today.
Come Labour on
Claim the high calling Angels cannot shame
To young and old the Gospel gladness bear
Redeem the time, its hours too swiftly fly
The night draws nigh.
Come Labour on The labourer are few
and the field is wide
New stations must be filled and blanks
supplied
From voices distant far, or near at home
The call is “come.”
Come Labour on
Away with gloomy doubts and faithless fear
No arm so weak but may do service here
By feeblest agents can our God fulfil
His righteous will.
Come Labour on
No time to rest, till glows the western sky
While the long shadows O‘er our path way lie
And a glad sound comes with the setting sun
Servant well done.
Come Labour on The toil is pleasant,
the reward is due
Blessed are those who to the end endure
How full their joy, how deep their rest
shall be O Lord with Thee. Amen
hymns.author: Jane Laurie Borthwick, 1859; rev. 1863

hymns.title: O Saviour, May we Never Rest
lyrics: O Saviour, may we never rest
Till Thou art formed within
Till Thou hast clamed our troubl’d breast
And crus’d the pow’r of sin.
O may we gaze upon Thy Cross
Until the wondrous sight
Makes eartly treasures seems but dross
And earthly sorrows light.
Until releas’d from carnal ties
Our spirit upward springs
And sees true peace above the skies
True joy in heav’nly things.
There as we gaze, may we become
United, Lord, to Thee
And in fairer, happier home
Thy perfect beauty see. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Lord, Speak to Me, that I May Speak
lyrics: LORD, speak to me, that I may speak
In living echoes to Thy tone
As Thou has sought so let me seek
Thy erring children lost and lone.
Oh, lead me, Lord, that I may lead
The wand‘ring and the wav’ring feet
O, feed me Lord, that I may feed
Thy hung’ring ones with manna sweet.
Oh, strengthen me, that while I stand
Firm on the Rock, and strong in Thee
I may stretch out a loving hand
To wrestlers with the troubl’d sea.
Oh, teach me, Lord, that I may teach
The precious things Thou dost impart
And wing my words that they may reach
The hidden depths of many hearts.
Oh, give Thine own sweet rest to me,
That I may speak with soothing pow‘r
A word in season, as from Thee
To weary ones in needful hour.
Oh, fill me with Thy fullness, Lord
Until my very heart o'erflow
In kindling thought, and glowing word
Thy love to tell, Thy praise to show.
Oh, use me, Lord, use even me
Just as Thou wilt, and how, and where
Until Thy blessed face I see
Thy rest, Thy joy, Thy glory share. Amin
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Sow in the Morn thy Seed
lyrics: SOW in the morn thy seed,
At eve hold not thine hand
To doubt and fear give thou no heed
Broadcast it o‘er the land.
Thou know'st not which may thrive
The late or early sown
Grace keeps the chosen germ alive
When and where ever strown.
And duly shall appear
In verdue, beauty, strength
The tender blade, the stalk, the ear
And the full corn at length.
Thou canst not toil in vain
Cold, heat, and moist, and dry
Shall foster and mature the grain
For gamers in the sky.
Thence, when the glorious end
The day of God is come
The angel reapers shall descend
And heav’n cry: Harvest home! Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Keep Working on Cast Laziness Away
lyrics: KEEP working on, cast laziness away
Ye Cherubim and Seraphim;
There’s harvest (3) workers not suffice
We shall all (3) receive the reward.
Keep working on cast laziness away
Ye Cherubim and Seraphim;
Go ye out (3) to streets of the world
We shall all ( 3 ) receive the reward.
Keep working on, cast laziness away
Keep on the spiritual light glowing;
Our brethren (3) spiritually hungered
We shall all (3) receive the reward.
Keep working on, cast laziness away
Put on Holy armour of Christ;
Cast away (3) pride and back-biting
We shall all (3) receive the reward.
Keep working on, cast laziness away
We shall all sing Hallelujah;
Song of Ha (3) le Hallelujah;
When we see (3) Lord God Almighty. Amen
hymns.author: Cherubim & Seraphim Church

hymns.title: Jehovah Ruphi Father
lyrics: JEHOVAH Ruphi, Father
Sound health is all we plead
In one accord, praising our God
All as sacred Saints above.
Praise Jesus, all ye of earth
Worthy Phenomenon’s here
Give praises to Father above
Who, this band hath established.
Faithful con-gre-gations
Righteous Sun now here arise
The voice of God is sounding out
Let ushark the Godly voice.
Jehovah Nissi, Father
Adopt us to be Thine
Holy Spirit the Sacred Dove
Lead us through the righteous path.
Nay of woe, not decline
Amidst Seraphim Band
Great provider, and Great Saviour
Never thee e’er forsake.
All ye Angelic Hosts
Mi-nis-tering to the world
Never thee, the earth forsaken
Earthly characters, ignore.
Michael, Holy Angel
Hoovering us around
Cherubims with their valiant hosts
Giving sight to the blind.
On the great judgement day
May we not be ashamed
When all the races shall gather
Before our Father above.
Help us Jesuswe plead
Never, us to forsake
When against us trials
Jesus make us to o’ercome.
No friend like Jesus Christ
Unto whom shall I call
Gazing around, around I gaze
No counsellor found around.
Satan thou hath forsook
And all his evil works
Curseth art thou, if retreateth
To the fold of satan.
Glory to Father above
Glory unto His Son
Glory be to Holy Spirit
Eternal trinity.
hymns.author: anon
chorus: Come and worship Christ Jesus
The trumpet sounds, oh now repent
Come and worship Christ Jesus.

hymns.title: O Weary Heart there is a Home
lyrics: O weary heart, there is a home
Beyond the reach of toil and care
A home where changes never come
Who would not fain be resting there.
Yet when bowed down beneath the load
By heaven allowed, thine earthly lot
Look up! Thou’lt reach that blest abode
Wait, meekly wait and murmur not.
If in thy part some thorns are found
Oh think who bore them on His brow
lf grief thy sorrowing heart has found
It hath reached earlier one than thou.
Toil on nor deem, thought sore it be
One sigh unheard, one forgotten
The day of rest will dawn for thee
Wait meekly wait and murmur not.
hymns.author: William Henry Bellamy, 1800-1866
chorus: Oh wait, meekly wait and murmur not (2ce)
Oh wait, Oh wait, Oh meekly wait
and murmur not.

hymns.title: When we Walk with the Lord
lyrics: WHEN we walk with the Lord
In the light of His word
What a glory He sheds on our way
While we do His good will
He abides with us still
And with all who will trust and obey.
Not a shadow can rise
Not a cloud in the skies
But His smile quickly drives it away
Not a doubt nor a fear
Not a sigh nor a tear
Can abide while we trust and obey.
Not a burden we bear
Not a sorrow we share
But our toil He doth richly repay
Not a grief nor a loss,
Not a frown nor a cross
But is blest if we trust and obey.
But we never can prove
The delights of His love
Until all on the altar we lay
For the favour He shows
And the joy He bestows
Are for them who will trust and obey.
Then in fellowship sweet
We will sit at His feet
Or we’ll walk by His side in the way
What He says we will do
Where He sends we will go
Never fear, only trust and obey.
hymns.author: John Henry Sammis
chorus: Trust and obey!
For there is no other way
To be happy in jesus
But to trust and obey.

hymns.title: All Ye the Holy Saints of God
lyrics: ALL ye the holy saints of God
Darkness overwhelmed the earth
Spread the good tidings of Jesus
All over the universe.
Shy not to spread His good tidings
It’s the Mightiness of God
The city, first Christ is proclaimed
To all captives deliverance.
World and satan may conspire
‘Gainst the work of our Saviour
Courageously work on for Him
Do not be frightened of men.
When perilous season shall come
Thou, Christ Jesus will protect
Amidst all foes and the strangers
Jesus ever thine friend be.
hymns.author: anon
chorus: Oh! good tidings, oh! good tidings
Of the Saviour, Jesus Christ.

hymns.title: Rescue the Perishing, Care for the Dying
lyrics: RESCUE the perishing, care for the dying
Snatch them in pity from sin and the grave
Weep o‘er the erring ones
Lift up the fallen
Tell them of Jesus the Mighty to save.
Though they are slighting Him
Still He is waiting
Waiting the penitent child to receive
Plead with them earnestly,
Plead with them gently
He will forgive if thy only believe.
Rescue the perishin, duty demands it
Strength for thy labour the Lord will provide
Back to the narrow way
Patiently win them
Tell the poor wand‘rer a Saviour had died.
hymns.author: Fanny J. Crosby
chorus: Rescue the perishing,
care for the dying
Jesus is merciful,
Jesus will save.

hymns.title: What Means this Eager Anxious Throng
lyrics: WHAT means this eager anxious throng
Which moves with busy haste along
These wondrous gatherings day by day
What means this strange commotion,
Pray
In accents hushed the throng reply
Jesus of Nazareth passeth by.
Who is this Jesus? Why should He
The city move so mightily
A passing stranger, has he skill
Why move the multitude at will?
Again the stirring tones reply
Jesus of Nazareth passeth by.
Jesus! ‘tis He who once below
Man’s pathway trod ‘mid pain and woe
And burdened ones, where‘er he came
Brought out their sick, and deaf, and lame
The blind rejoiced to hear the cry
Jesus of Nazareth passeth by.
Again He comes! from place to place
His holy footprints we can trace
He pauseth at our threshold-nay
He enter-condescends to stay
Shall we not gladly raise the cry?
Jesus of nazaret passeth by.
Ho! all ye have laden, come
Here’s pardon, comfort, rest, and
home
Ye wanderers from a Father’s face
Return, accept His proffered grace
Ye tempted ones, there’s refuge nigh
Jesus of Nazareth passeth by.
But if you still His call refuse
And all His wondrous love abuse
Soon will He sadly from you turn
Your bitter prayer for pardon spurn
‘Too late! too late! ‘will be the cry
Jesus of Nazareth has passed by. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Stand up Army of Salvation
lyrics: STAND up army of Salvation
That cling to the Head of Band
Stand up, ye, dwellers of the world
Before friends enter Zion.
Receive the water of Salvation
Ye all people of the world
Come and take Salvation freely
Which the Lord has provided.
Forty years Jesus supplicated
For founding this Seraph Band,
To redeem the people of world
From sins and woe and weeping.
Glory be to Father and Son,
Holy trinity has come;
We beseech Thee Lord to cleanse us
From all sins and wickedness.
hymns.author: anon
chorus: Sing, 0h! sing and sing
the sweet song;
Sing, oh sing and sing
the sweet song,
As the voice of much water
By the blood of our Lord Jesus
We are more than conquerors,
We are more than conquerors,
We are more than conquerors,
By the blood of our Lord Jesus
We are more than conquerors.

hymns.title: Come and Drink All Ye Thirsty Souls
lyrics: COME and drink, all ye thirsty souls
Water of life so freely
From Christ‘s cistern without a fee
The spring of life so sure.
For how long be it thou partook
False and vagueries of life
Toilling and labouring all in vain
In all perishing stock.
Behold my treasures Jesus saith
For aye un‐ending be
Enduring health and physique strong
To all who Christ obey. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: I Always Go to Jesus
lyrics: I always go to Jesus
When troubled or distressed
I always found a refuge
Upon His loving breast
I tell Him all my trials
l tell Him all my grief
And while my lips are speaking
He gives my hear relief.
When full of dread forebodings
And flowing o'er my tears
He calms away my sorrow
And hushes all my fears
He comprehends my weakness
The peril I am in
And He supplies the armour
I need to conquer sin.
I always go to Jesus
No matter when or where
I seek His gracious presence
I'm sure to find Him there
In times of joy or sorrow
What'er my need may be
I always go to Jesus
And Jesus comes to me. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Swallow up Hence Thine Woe
lyrics: SWALLOW up hence thine woe
It’s universal
Let it be forgotten
Further endure on
Patiently ponder on/it during the dusk
To Jesus petition/thou shall find relief.
To Jesus petition, thine desire He knows
To Jesus petition, He shall, thee to aid
Go to savour the joy gave He unto thee
He, thine burden lighten/but in prayer be firm.
Those who so are wretched
More over than thee
Their woeful heart to bow
Thine, them to comfort
Swallow up hence thine woe/others, offer joy
Shine unto them, thine light/to Jesus
report. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Today the Saviour Calls
lyrics: TODAY the Saviour calls
Ye wand’rers, come
Oh, ye benighted souls
Why longer roam?
Today, the Saviour calls
Oh, listen now!
Within these sacred walls
To Jesus bow.
Today the saviour calls
For refuge fly
The storm of justice falls
And death is nigh.
The Spirit calls today
Yield to His power
Oh, grieve Him not away!
Tis mercy’s hour. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: When Temptation Around me Roll
lyrics: WHEN temptation around me roll
And eartth care me encompass
When appear the foe, friend to be
Destruction ploy to o’er me roll.
When Satan craft’ly me deceive
Me to earthly pinacle raise
Me entreated, him to worship
That earthly stock, I may possess.
When earthly lusts me now ensnare
Thy commands me all to ignore
Upon my wand’ring heart impressed
In vain assurance “All is well”.
When all hope and confidence
Not in living God now repose
Vain incantations now my trust
And lusty spells my song at dawn.
When in my self will, love to walk
In the dicates of wand’ring heart
When I in my un-stable breast
In unstable state, me abide.
When all my hearing lost, not found
And the tracer’s call me ignore
When no redemption my hope be
And wallowest me in my sins.
When counsellors from me doth flee
And comforters to me entrange
When sorrow like the wirl-wind rage
My head in penitence to bow.
hymns.author: Yoruba Hymn Book
chorus: O Saviour Lord, me, bid to come
As Thou in Eden, Adam called
Where art thou sinner sound
the voice
That I may from the foul be free.

hymns.title: Day of Judgement Day of Wonders
lyrics: DAY of judgement! Day of wonders
Hark, the trumpet’s awful sound
Lounder than a thousand thunder
Shakes the vast creation round
How the summon, how the summons
Will the sinner’s heart confound!
See the judge, our nature wearing
Clothed in majesty divine
Ye who love the Lord‘s appearing
Then shall say,This God is mine!
Gracious Saviour, gracious Saviour
Own me on that day as thine.
At this call the dead awaken
Rise to life from earth and sea
All the pow’rs of nature, shaken
At this call prepare to flee
Careless sinner, careless sinner
What will then become of thee?
The devil that deceives thee now
Listen thou not unto him
When these riches shall pass away
It shall find thee in the fire
My friend, think thou/2x
Of thy place in burning hell.
Under affliction and mockery
Let this word thy counsel be
The day of the Lord comes quickly
Then our tears will turn to joy
We shall conquer, we shall conquer,
When the world by fire consumed. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Come, Oh Come, when Christ is Calling
lyrics: COME, oh come, when Christ is calling
Linger not in paths of sin
Severe ev’ry tie that binds you
And the heav'nly race begin.
Come oh come, While Christ is pleading
Oh, what love His tones convey
Will you slight His proffer’d mercy
Will you longer from him stray!
Come, Oh come, delay no longer
For th’accepted time is now
Yield, oh yield yourself to Jesus
And before His sceptre bow.
hymns.author: anon
chorus: Calling you now, calling you now)
I Hear the Saviour calling now) - 2ce

hymns.title: Come to the Saviour, Make no Delay
lyrics: COME to the Saviour, make no delay:
Here in His Word He has shown us the
way;
Here in our midst He’s standing today
Tenderly saying “Come”.
Suffer the children to hear His voice
Let every hearts leap forth and rejoice
And let us freely make Him our choice
Do not delay, but come.
Think once again, He’s with us today
Heed now his blest command and obey;
Hear now His accents tenderly say,
“Will you, my children, come?”
hymns.author: anon
chorus: Joyful Joyful will the meeting be
When from sin our hearts are pure
and free And we shall gather,
Saviour with the
In our eternal Home.

hymns.title: Earthly Stocks Shall Fade Away
lyrics: EARTHLY stocks shall fade away
Cherubim, Seraphim
A City built on the cliff
Can’st nay ever be concealed
Earthly stocks shall fade away
Remember wife of Lot
Who to Sodom gazeth back
Thus she turned a pillar of salt.
Earthly stocks shall fade away
Remember Moses’ days
Pharaoh submerged in the sea
To Israel, salvation all they gained.
Earthly stocks shall fade away
Remember Noah’s days
While all men despiseth
Animals on board all were saved.
All ye Band of the elder’s
And ye Band of Mary
Father shall abide with thee
And shall girdle thee with the truth.
Ye members of Martha Band
And ye Queen Esther’s band
Be ready to do thy work
Holy Father will offer thee help.
Members of Choristers Band
And Jesus disciples
Be ready to do thine work
Christ Jesus will offer thee help.
Moses Orimolade
Transited high above
In fellowship with Angels
Starry Crown of glory he hath won.
Members of Prayerist
Band With thee, we commi-serate
Father will confort thee
And shall lift thee above board.
Glory be to our Father
Glory be to His Son
Glory be to Holy Ghost
Everlasting Trinity.
hymns.author: Cherubim & Seraphim Church
chorus: Let us be true - 3ce
Salvation We may gain
at the end.

hymns.title: Stand Soldier of the Cross
lyrics: STAND, soldier of the cross
Thy high allegiance claim
And vow to hold the world but loss
For Thy Redeemer’s name.
Arise, and be baptized
And wash thy sins away
Thy league with God be solemnized
Thy faith avouch’d today.
No more thine own, but Christ's
With all the saints of old
Apostles, seers, evangelists
The martyr throngs enrolled.
In God’s whole armours strong
From hell’s embattled pow'rs
The warfare may be sharp and long
The vict‘ry must be ours.
Oh, bright the conqu‘ror‘s crown
The song of triumph sweet
When faith casts every trophy down
At our great Captain's feet. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Sounding Voice from Wilderness
lyrics: SOUNDING voice from wilderness,
The watchman's cry resound;
Hear how He shouts there aloud
Repentance, repentance,
The voice is sounding warning
Sincere and warning strict
Why are you not moved brethren
Show sign of repentance.
For the kingdom of Heaven
Is now at hand for you;
Those whose garments are washed clean
Shall only be enthroned;
Why don’t you heed the warning?
The watchmem’s cry resound
It sounds repeatedly, hear,
Repent and then be saved.
Abana and Farpar streams
Might be crystal waters: be
But the power of redemption
Was to River Jordan,
Cast delaying thoughts away
And heed God’s warning now:
Come to Lake of Salvation
Wash and be fully clean.
What would now keep you away?
There should be no excuse be
Behold the river, Jordan
All’s ready for you now
It’s long you have been doubting,
Cease to doubt God’s Spirit
Sinners hear the watchman’s cry
Now repent and be saved. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: A Ruler Once Came to Jesus by Night
lyrics: A ruler once came to Jesus by night,
To ask Him the way of salvation and
of light
The Master made answer in words
true and plain
“Ye must be born again” “again”.
Ye children of men, attend to the world
So solemnly uttered by Jesus the Lord
And let not this message to you be in vain:
“Ye must be born “again”.
O ye who would enter this glorious rest
And sing with the ransomed the song of
the blest
The life everlasting if ye would obtain,
Ye must be born “again”.
A dear one in heaven thy heart yearns to see:
At the beautiful gate may bewatching for thee
Then list to the note of this solemn refrain:
hymns.author: anon
chorus: “Ye must be born again" “again” - 2ce
Verily verily, I say unto you
Ye must be born “again”.

hymns.title: March on Jesus to Jordan - 3ce
lyrics: MARCH on Jesus to Jordan - 3ce
To John the Baptist.
Be happy to wear a crown - 3ce
And have full love to all.
Jesus will greet His sons with crown - 3ce
Elect people of God.
Behold asHoly Dove descend - 3ce
On Lord our Jesus Christ.
I heard a lovely voice from Heaven - 3ce
This is my ransom child.
Minister ye to Him always - 3ce
And strengthen His believe.
Behold Jesus is in the stream - 3ce
The sanctified water.
All sinners by me halt and skip - 3ce
lnto Holy Jordan.
Cherub, Seraph ‘Tis time we go - 3ce
To greet Our Saviour Lord.
hymns.author: anon
chorus: March on to River Jordan
With Jesus Christ our Saviour
March on to River Jordan
Believe Him and be saved.

hymns.title: Jesus we Lift our Souls to Thee
lyrics: JESUS, we lift our souls to Thee
Thy Holy Spirit breathe
And let these little infants be
Baptized into Thy death.
Oh let Thine unction on them rest
Thy grace their souls renew
And write within their tender breast
Thy name and nature too.
Thy faithful servants let them prove
Girded with truth divine
May they share in Thy dying love
And followers of Thee.
Lord, plant us all into Thy death
That we Thy life may gain
Partakers of Thy cross beneath
And of Thy crown above. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Great Art this Jehovah’s Command
lyrics: GREAT art this Jehovah’s command
Shall aye ever endure
Wretched sinners art thou and l
Re-Birth is all we need.
Darkness shall over our path be
Shall we in sin persist
Thine Kingdom we may not all see
Lest we be born again.
Up teenth time our baptism be
All in vain it shall be
Nay not a perfect atonement
‘Lest we be bom again.
Behold our insane acts and deeds
Thine help not in it found
Ain’t no our quilty heart renew
‘Lest we be born again.
Escape and flee from sin away
Shatter off satan’s bond
Be faithful and in Christ believe
Thou shall thence be re-born. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Herein Doth Perfect Rest Abide
lyrics: HEREIN doth perfect rest abide
By His side where blood flows
This alone is my only hope
That Jesus died for me.
Jesus, my Saviour and my Lord
The fountain for my sins
Sprinkle me with Thy precious blood
That I may be made pure.
Wash me, Lord, and make me thine own
Wash me, and be Thou mine
Wash me, and not my feet alone
My hands and my hearts my being.
Work Thou in my heart, Jesus Lord
Till faith to end shall fade
And until hope comes to an end
And my heart comes to rest. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Come Holy Spirit Come
lyrics: S.M (FE 646)
COME! Holy Spirit come
Thine faithfuls to baptize
With them in Holy Covenant
Cleanse them from sin we plead.
Satan‘s sceptre destroy
immerse them in Thine blood
Father and Son and Holy Ghost
Them adopt Thine to be. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Father our Fortress Rock and Strength
lyrics: FATHER, our fortress, Rock and strength
Whose promises faileth never
into Thy congregating fold
Wholly, him accept Thine to be.
At the name of the Triune God
He, immerseth in baptism
Worthy be him amongst Thy saints
Our request, grant oh Lord we plead.
Thine rugged cross on him an marked
Symbolic of Thine sufferings here
Christ, may Thine promises at dawn
My testimonies ever be.
Oh Lord we plead, to us now grant
May we never from Thee depart
Ever Thine honest host to be
Thine sacred steward ever be. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Jesus Father of the Child
lyrics: JESUS, Father of the Child
Thine commands all we obey
The child brought we unto Thee
Adopt and make him Thine own.
In sin wast he begotten
Cleanse him thoroughly from sin
By Thine blood he is redeemed
May he of Thine Gift partake. AmeN
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: O Happy Day that Fixed my Choice
lyrics: O happy day, that fixed my choice
On Thee my Saviour and my God
Well may this glowing heart rejoice
And tells it rapture all abroad.
Tis done the great transaction done
I am my Lord’s and He is mine
He drew me; and I followed Him
Charmed to confess the voice Divine.
O happy bond, that scals my vows
To Him who merits all my love!
Let cheerful anthems fill His House
While to that sacred shrine I move.
Now rest, my long divided heart,
Field on this Blessful centre rest
Nor ever from the Lord depart
With Him of every good possessed.
High heaven, heard the solemn vow
That vow renewed shall daily hear
Till in life’s late hour I bow
And bless in death abound so dear.
hymns.author: Philip Doddridge, 1755; Chorus Anonymous
chorus: Happy day! Happy day
When Jesus washed my sins away
He taught me how to watch and pray
And live rejoicing every day
Happy day! Happy day!
When Jesus washed my sins away.

hymns.title: I Heard thy Voice in my Sweet Dream
lyrics: I heard thy voice in my sweet dream
Thy sweet and quiet voice
The voice that tells of our God’s love
Redemption by His blood
I listen patiently to hear
And that to my surprise
The voice exhort me more and more
To pray and always pray.
While wordly trouble on my way
To elder skip and run
Who gave me the golden advice
To watch and pray always
I patiently listen to hear
And made my heart so sweet
He further exhort me nicely
To watch and pray always.
Almighty God deliver us
We Cherubim and Seraphim below
When trouble shall beon our way
To hear our daily prayers
And send the Cherubim and Seraphim
To help us out of it
And harken to our daily prayers
And grant our hearts requests.
hymns.author: anon
chorus: I pray show me thy sight - 2ce
And patiently to see thy face
I pray show me Thy sight.

hymns.title: Worldly Friend of Vain Value be
lyrics: WORLDLY friend of vain value be
All but to vanity I know
No bossom friend like Christ Jesus.
Christ Jesus bossom friend I’ll make
No friend like Christ Jesus I found
Who loved us to death on the cross.
I have no friend no one to call
Before and behind none I see
No sympathiser none is nigh.
Now to Thee, Jesus I will cling
I will never from Thee depart
Save me, Lord Saviour, my help be.
In my cottage quiet-ly I sat
My humble heart Satan enthrall
But Jesus victory me accord
Ye employed be not be discouraged
Ye all the sick, no hope forgone
Christ Jesus to thy needs shall yield.
Glory be to Father above
Glory give to His Holy Son
Glory be to the Trinity.
hymns.author: Cherubim & Seraphim Church
chorus: Christ Jesus is God incarnate
Not herbalists nor occultists
Christ Jesus is Eternal God.

hymns.title: In Starving Condition, Trust Forth on Jesus
lyrics: IN starving condition, trust forth on Jesus
In earth turbulence, trust forth on Jesus
Repose not thine trust in man, but in
Jesus trust
Him alone is thy sure Saviour, put thy
trust in Him.
Ye Salvation Army, trust forth on Jesus
Shout loudest Hossanah, unto David’s Son
Whom in possession be, Key of life and death
Him alone is thy sure Saviour, only do His will.
Ye dear overseers, we doth commend thee
Jah be thine protector, indoor and our door
Let thy good behaviour, not from men
concealed
Heav’ly Host shall witness for thee,
crown of glory earn.
All ye Prayerist Band, be not discouraged
Work now while it is dawn, for the dusk
cometh
Lift up sword of victory, march on! no
retreat!
Repose not forth thine trust in man,
gaze on to Jesus.
Ye Band of Choristers, fine tune ye
thine voice
Forever in heaven, hymns all ye shall rend
Jesus shall lead thee home, in heaven above
In union with heavenly host, all praising
the Lamb.
Ye members of Seraphim and ye Cherubim
Holy Ghost shall guard thee, be not
afrightened
Power descended from high, songs of
victory rend
Glory be to Father and Son, and the
Holy Ghost.
hymns.author: anon
chorus: Whom to ants doth provide
Thou He will thus feed
How great is thine burden?
Trust forth on Jesus.

hymns.title: Once I was Far Way from the Lord
lyrics: ONCE I was far way from the Lord
I frustrate Him with my manners
But now Jesus hath sav’d me
Halleluyah!
Now indignation and anger
Satan now bound me with its chain
Jesus had now out the chain
Halleluyah!
Lusts of the world now fill’d my hearts
And all sorts of arroganey
Now all burnt by Spirit’s fire
Halleluyah!
Now I am free from depression
From all sorts of lukewarmness
Oh praise Jehovah with me
Halleluyah!
I am singing just everyday
In happiness I jump and dance
It’s by the Spiritual pow’r
Halleluyah!
Thy precious blood now cleanseth me
The water of life in me flow
My salvation now is full
Halleluyah!
All ye my brothers and my friends
Who dare this deliverance neglect?
To Him salvation is free Halleluyah!
hymns.author: Cherubim & Seraphim Church
chorus: Oh, how sweet shall it be
Sweet oh sweet it shall be
Oh, how sweet shall it be
For Jesus to dwell within me.

hymns.title: My Times are in thy Hand O! Lord
lyrics: MY times are in Thy hand O! Lord
Jesus my Saviour God:
All my desires and all my thoughts,
I surrender unto Thee.
My times are in Thy hand O! God,
I have nothing to fear;
Father will not let His children
Mourn and suffer or cry.
Who will raise fallen Jacob up?
Was the enemies‘ thought,
Dying soul may receive again
Through the power of Almighty.
If wordly people confront me
If enemies pursue,
I will never be terrified,
lf thou only an with me.
If all friends do depart from me,
If wordly comfort depart,
As my whole trust is in Thee God,
Thou shall my comforter be.
My rock of life everlasting,
My trust is only in Thee,
Putting me to shame disallow
Until l come to Thy throne.
hymns.author: Cherubim & Seraphim Church
chorus: Have mercy, hear my prayer
Be my helper,
Have mercy, hear my prayer,
Be my helper My entire trust is in Thee.

hymns.title: Salvation Divine - 2ce
lyrics: SALVATION divine - 2ce
The world may utter what they would
But I know, salvationis divine.
Salvation is divine - 2ce
My peers may utter what they would
But I know, salvation is divine.
Salvation is divine - 2ce
Families may say what they would
But I know, salvation is divine.
Salvation is divine - 2ce
All friends may utter what they would
But I know, salvation is divine.
Salvation is divine - 2ce
My Father may say what he would
But I know, salvation is divine.
Salvation is divine - 2ce
My Mother may say what she would
But I know, salvation is divine.
Salvation is divine - 2ce
My foes may utter what they would
But I know, salvation is divine. Amen
hymns.author: Cherubim & Seraphim Church

hymns.title: Cherubim Seraphim Gird on thy Loins
lyrics: CHERUBIM, Seraphim gird on thy loins,
Hoist up thy banners unto glorious King
Blessed be He who cometh in His name
Check into Mathew chapter twenty live
Be not like five virgins who were unwise
Emulate the five virgins who were wise
Fill thy lamp with oil band of Seraphim
Fill thy lamp with oil Band of Cherubim
l am the Alpha and the Omega
Ye are my chosen and my beloved
Never be or touch anything unclean
Check in Isaiah chapter sixty-two
Strive hard and truly, truly to be saved
All ye elders and the youth fellowship
Go to the world, my gospel to proclaim
Spread the gospel to all our friends and kins
Beseech them, come aboard salvation ark
Cherubim and Seraphim is the ark
Check the gospel of Mathew chapter five
Crown of glory, we shall earn at the end
With thine fervent prayers be on the watch
Be ready! oh! be ready my brethren
Give glory unto our Father above
Give glory to the Son and Holy Ghost
I am He who endureth forever
hymns.author: anon
chorus: Be ready, be ready and be prepared
Be ready, be ready ye my brethren
Cherubim, Seraphim gird on thy loins.

hymns.title: O Jesus I Have Promised
lyrics: O Jesus I have promised
To serve Thee to the end;
Be Thou forever near me,
My master and my friend;
I shall not tear the battle
If thou art by my side,
Nor wander from the pathway
lf thou will be my Guide.
Oh let me feel Thee near me;
The world is ever drear;
I see the sights that dazzle
The tempting sounds I hear;
My foes are ever near me,
Around me and within;
But, Jesus, draw Thou nearer,
And shield my soul from sin.
Oh let me hear Thee speaking
ln accents clear and still,
Above the storms of passion,
The murmurs of self-will;
Oh speak to reassure me
To hasten, or control;
Oh speak, and make me listen,
Thou Guardian of my soul.
O Jesus, Thou hast promised
To all who follow Thee
That where Thou art in glory
There shall Thy servant be
And Jesus I have promised
To serve Thee to the end!
Oh give me grace to follow,
My Master tind my Friend.
Oh let me see Thy footmarks
And in them plant mine own;
My hope to follow duly
Is in Thy strength alone,
Oh guide me, call me,draw me,
Uphold me to the end;
And then in heaven receive me,
My Saviour and my Friend. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: I Will Go to Thee, Lord Jesus
lyrics: I will go to Thee, Lord Jesus
He who has called me to come
He who is the blessed Saviour
For a sinner such as l.
I will go to Thee, Lord Jesus
Abomination and wrath
Wickedness and all evil work
That men do, Thou possess not.
I will go toThee, Lord Jesus
It delights me so to do
Who love me like the Lord Jesus
He who can save one from sin.
I will go to Thee, Lord Jesus
Jesus Christ who is our friend
With Him is abundant mercy,
For a sinner such as l. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Thine Thine Forever Blessed Bond
lyrics: THINE, Thine forever Blessed Bond
That knit us, Lord toThee
My voice and bean, and soul respond
Amen, so let it be.
When this word strikes its dullest harp
And earth our heaven appears
Be "Thine for ever clear and sharp
God‘s trumpet in our ears.
When sin in pleasure's oft disguise
Would work us deadliest Harm
May Thine for ever from the skies
Steal down and break the Charm.
When Satan flings his fiery darts
Against our weary shield
May Thine for ever in our hearts
Forbid us faint or yield.
Thine all along the flower spring
Along the summer prime
Till autumn fades in welcoming
The silver frost of time.
Thine, Thine for ever, body soul
Henceforth devote to Thee,
While everlasting ages roll;
Amen, so let it be. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Awake, my Soul! Strech Every Nerve
lyrics: AWAKE, my soul! strech every nerve
And press with vigour on
A heav'nly race demands thy zeal
And an immortal crown.
A cloud of witnesses around
Hold thee in full survey
Forget the steps already trod
And onward urge thy way.
“'lis God’s all-animatting Voice
That calls thee from on high
'Tis His own Hand presents the prize
To thine aspiring eye.
Blest Saviour, introduced by Thee
Have I my race begun
And crown’d with vict’ry, at Thy feet
I’ll lay my honours down. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: When Little Samuel Woke
lyrics: WHEN little Samuel woke
And heard his master’s voice
At ev'ry word he spoke
How much did he rejoice
Oh, blessed happy child to find
The God of heav’n so near and kind.
If God would speak to me
And say He is my Friend
How happy I should be
Oh how would I attend
The smallest sin I then should fear
If God Almighty were so near.
And does He never speak
Oh, yes, for in his word
He bids me come and seek
The God that Samuel heard
In almost ev‘ry page I see
The god of Samuel calls to me.
And I breathe in His care
May safely rest my head
I know that God is there
To guard my humble bed
And every sin I well may fear
Since God Almighty is so-near.
Like Samuel let me say
When e'er I read Thy word
Speak, Lord, I would obey
The voice that l have heard
And when I in Thy house appear
Speak for Thy servant waits to hear. Amen
hymns.author: Jane Taylor & Ann Taylor Gilbert

hymns.title: I Am so Glad that our Father in Heaven
lyrics: I am so glad that our Father in heaven
Tells of His love in the Book he has given:
Wonderful things in the Bible I see;
This is the dearest, that Jesus loves me.
Though I forget Him and wonder away,
Still He doth love me, wherever I stray
Back to His dear loving arms do I flee,
When I remember that Jesus loves me.
Oh, if there's only one song I can sing,
When in His beauty I see the great King,
This shall my song in eternity be,
“Oh, what a wonder that Jesus loves me”
Jesus loves me and I know I love Him
Love brought Him down my poor soul
to redeem;
Yes it was love made Him die on the tree
Oh! I am certain that Jesus loves me!
If one should ask of me, how can I tell?
Glory to Jesus, I know very well!
God’s Holy Spirit with mine doth agree,
Constantly witnessing Jesus loves me.
In this assurance I find sweetest rest,
Trusting in Jesus, I know I am blest;
Satan, dismayed, from my soul now doth flee,
When I just tell him that Jesus loves me.
hymns.author: anon
chorus: I am so glad that Jesus loves me
Jesus loves me Jesus loves me
I am so glad that Jesus Ioves me
Jesus loves me! And you.

hymns.title: Satan Led Jesus up to the Edge of
lyrics: SATAN led Jesus up to the edge of
temple top - 2ce
Jesus reply thus, get behind me now
Jesus reply thus, get behind me now.
Satan said again, turn Thee these
stones into bread - 2ce
Jesus reply thus, man lives not by bread
Jesus reply thus, man lives not by bread.
Members of Cherubim, gird on firmly
all thy loins - 2ce
Trample on satan, under neath thy foot
Trample on satan, under neath thy foot.
Come rejoice with me, Jesus blessed
me with a child - 2ce
I‘m no more barren, but mother of choice
I‘m no more barren, but mother of choice.
Come rejoice with me, by Jesus I am alive - 2ce
I'am not a dead, but a living soul
I'am not a dead, but a living soul. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: O God Receive my Soul Today
lyrics: O! God receive my soul today
And let it all Thine be
Let me nay, not wander from Thee
Let me with Thee abide.
Lo! Behold I bow unto Thee
At the foot of the cross
My sins, crucify to the cross
Christ be my all and all.
Heavenly grace, grant unto me
And make me, ever Thine
Thine gracious countenance, I see
All my worship to Thee.
May my thought and my words
and deeds
Thine alone all shall be
May I worship The as I live
In death shall be my rest.
Glory all to the Father be
Glory be to the Son
Glory be to Holy Spirit
Now and forever more. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Oh God of the Great Universe
lyrics: OH! God of the great Universe,
Thou who ordained that there should be light
Whose command brought forth trees
and shrubs,
And all living creatures of all kind.
God who answereth prayers of Moses;
That all kings could not over power him;
God who heard prayers of Elijah
And put all his enemies to shame.
God who ordered ocean to be,
No one knew how thou didst thy
great work;
Thou put seas in their position
No one could ever dislocate them.
Thou who heard the prayers of Hannah,
The Father of the fatherless ones,
Thou God who heard Queen Esther's prayers
And overcame all her enemies.
God who hearkened to Daniel‘s prayers
And delivered him from Lion's den’
God who gave favour to Joseph
And set him ruler over Egypt.
Holy Cherub, Holy Seraph,
Give glory to our Father on High,
For power of victory granted us,
When peeple of world mock and hate us.
Glory be to God the father
Glory to Holy Son our Saviour,
Glory to the Holy Spirit,
All worthy praises to Trinity.
hymns.author: Cherubim & Seraphim Church
chorus: Hear me, Lord! Hear me Lord!
Hear me, Lord!
Thou who answereth all prayers
Hear me Lord! - 3ce
Thou who answereth all prayers.

hymns.title: Ah no Confidant here on Earth
lyrics: AH! No confidant here on, earth
Trouble not thy gentle heart
For no confidant, nay, not one
But Jesus, a friend in need.
Ah! No confidant here on earth
Be ye firm and be not moved
E’en though thou art in fear, threatened
Christ with thee shall ever be.
Ah! No confidant here on earth
Be ye firm and be not moved
E'en though thou art submerged and
drenched
Thine victory is ever sure.
Ah! No confidant here on earth
Be not moved when thou an mocked
And thou art despised of thine folks
And deserted of the World.
Ah! No confidant here on earth
In starving season, endure
God who the earthly ants doth feed
For all thy wants shall provide.
Ah! No confidant here on earth
Value not thine status here
God, to thee, shall of succour be
Unto them, that helpless be.
Jesus our only confidant
He’s our only faithful friend
He's the husband of the widows
Father of the fatherless.
hymns.author: Cherubim & Seraphim Church
chorus: Be of good cheer
And repose thy trust in God.
