When all the face of world shall meet
Holy Messiah our glorious King
Let us have space with thee. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: How Amiable is thy Tabernacle
lyrics: HOW amiable is thy tabernacle?
Lord of host
My soul doth faint for court above
For the sparrow pertcheth on the
tree here below
And the swallow nest for herself.
My soul longeth for sacred abode
high above
To the court of our sacred King
I shall go forth from strength unto
strength for ever
Till I’ll and at the glorious shore.
One day in Thy holy court above,
yes oh Lord
Is better than a thousand days
Divine grace and divine blessings be
Thine oh God
Blessing, His worshippers shall gain.
Holy sacred is our Holy God, Almigthy
Angels, come! let us worship Him
Those who all worship the sacred God,
to the end
Shall earn golden crown at the shore.
hymns.author: Cherubim & Seraphim Church
chorus: But blessings be to members
of Band of Seraphim
We inhabit abode of joy with
the Lord Jesus
Blessings we plead, Halleluyah
Blessing we plead, blessings
we plead
Halleluyah, blessing we plead.

hymns.title: Let us be Glad in Jesus Christ
lyrics: Let us be glad in Jesus Christ
Jesus the custodian of joy
whosoever hath receivelh His joy
Sadness and grief shall flee away.
Just believe in His sacred name
Wholly trust and lean on Him
And Savour the sweetness in
His pure blood
Sadness and grief shall flee away.
Cherubim and ye Seraphim
Still art thou in mourning mood
Christ Jesus bid thee shout Halleluyah
Sadness and grief shall flee away.
Art thou by satan afrightened
Witches or be it wizards
Often call on the name of Jesus Christ
Sadness and grief shall flee away.
Let‘s share love with all and sundry
Not within brethren alone
Thence thine prayers will ascend there above
Sadness and grief shall flee away.
All ye who dwellest on earth
Worship the name of Jesus
His name art the balm to soothe thy sadness
Sadness and grief shall flee away.
Be mindful that He’s Wonderful
King and Counsellor divine
Almighty and Omnipotent Father
Majesty Royal Prince of Peace.
Glory we give to Father God
Glory we give to His Son
Glory be to Holy Spirit our zeal
Triune God all our thanks accept. Amen
hymns.author: Cherubim & Seraphim Church

hymns.title: When upon Life‘S Billows you are
lyrics: WHEN upon life‘s billows you are
tempest tost
When you are discouraged,
thinking all is lost
Count your many blessings,
name them one by one
And it will surprise you what
the Lord hath done.
Are you ever burdened with a load of care
Does the cross seem heavy you are
called to bear
Count your many blessings every
doubt will fly
And you will keep singing as the
days go by.
When you look at others with their
lands and gold
Think that Christ has promised you
His wealth untold
Count your many blessings wealth
can never buy
Your reward in heaven, nor your home
on high.
So amid the conflict, whether great or small
Do not be disheartened God is over all
Count your many blessings Angels will attend
Help and comfort give you to your
journey‘s end.
hymns.author: Johnson Oatman
chorus: Count your blessings name
them one by one
Count your blessings see
what God hath done
Count your blessings name
them one by one
And it will surprise you what
the Lord hath done.

hymns.title: Open the Door for us - 2ce
lyrics: OPEN the door for us - 2ce
We belong to you - 3ce
Cast us not away
Open The door door us.
Father provide for us - 2ce
We belong to you - 3ce
Jehovah Jireh
Father provide for us.
Honey thou all our lives - 2ce
The world is Thlne own - 3ce
Jehovah Nissi
Honey Thou all our lives.
Lest we depart in vain - 2ce
Bless us we beseech - 3ce
Jehovah Barak
Lest we depart in vain. Amen
hymns.author: Cherubim & Seraphim Church

hymns.title: Moses Orimolade
lyrics: MOSES Orimolade
Is our Great Teacher
To earth God has sent him
To establish this Band.
O God of Tunolase
Let thy Spirit descend
In all our daily prayer
Never to let us fail.
Let not devil’s deceit
Make us offend Tunolase
That we be not condemned
When we depart this world.
All ye who are steadfast
To be Moses children
The foundation of truth
Shall guide you to the end.
We are dispersing home
Guide us with Host above
That all worldly evil
Have no power on us.
O! When the end shall come
To reckon high above
Moses Orimolade
Open the gate for us.
Praying Father of our Band
Whom God kindly inspire
May God his aid to be
And ever prosper him.
hymns.author: anon
chorus: Cherubim Seraphim he named
This Holy Band of ours - 2ce

hymns.title: All Christian People Come
lyrics: ALL Christian people come
Spiritual Israel
Assembled here with joy
List to the glad tiding.
The day of atonement
Assemble, Israel
The sacrifice is made
That of the Lamb of God.
The Holy of holies of holies
There went our Saviour Lord
He with holy blood more
Pure than the blood of bull.
Christians, now shout for joy
God accepts our offering
Jesus is pleading there
As our mediator.
hymns.author: anon
chorus: Jesus ascends up to the skies
Our great High Priest
ascends on high.

hymns.title: We Worship Thee Halleluyah
lyrics: WE worship Thee, Halleluyah
Halle, Halleluyah
Our Sacred God, whom we worship
Will make our joy o'er flow.
Awake! Awake! All ye faithfuls
Hark, Seraphim proclaim
The infidels wrouht “miracles”
And the faithfuls despise.
Many are sins that all abound
But the worst of them all
Sins committed ‘gainst Holy Ghost
Not ever forgiven.
Many are tribulations here
But the worst of them all
Financial abysmal, ill health
Jesus conquer for us.
Ain’t no reward here reap on earth
For members of Seraph
Who ever work enduringly
Shall at last gain a crown.
All Prayerist be not weary
Visioners, wardens, all
Amidst the foes, all ye abide
Victory shall Father give.
Ye wretched and all ye sicklers
Nay discouraged nor sad
Great provider, the Great Healer
Shall never, thee forsake.
Glory be to Father above
Glory be to the Son
Glory be unto Holy Ghost
Eternal Trinity.
hymns.author: anon
chorus: There is a pleasant abode
Change never there exist
There is no dusk but ever dawn
Joy shall Seraphim gain.

hymns.title: I Want to be Like Jesus
lyrics: I want to be like Jesus,
So lowly and so meek
For no one marked an angry word
That ever heard Him speak.
I want to be like Jesus
So frequently in prayer
Alone upon the mountain-top
He met His Father there.
I want to be like Jesus
I never, never find
That He, though persecuted, was
To any one unkind.
I want to be like Jesus
Engaged in doing good
So that of me it may be said
She hath done what she could.
I want to be like Jesus
Who sweetly said to all
Let little children come to me
I would obey the call.
But oh, I’m not like Jesus
As any one may see
Then, gentle Saviour, send Thy Grace,
And make me like to Thee. Amen
hymns.author: A. K. Miller

hymns.title: Yet there is Room the Lamb's
lyrics: 'YET there is room The Lamb's
bright hall of song
With its fair glory, beckons thee along
Enter, enter, enter, oh enter now!
Day is declining and the sun is low
The shadow lengthen, light makes
haste to go
Enter, enter, enter, oh enter now!
The bridal hall is filling for the feast
Pass in! pass in! and be the
Bridegroom’s guest
Enter, enter, enter, oh enter now!
Yet there is room! still open stands
the gate
The gate of love, it is not yet too late
Enter, enter, enter, oh enter now!
Pass in! pass in! That banquet is
for thee:
That cup of everlasting love is free
Enter, enter, enter, oh enter now!
All heav'n is there! all joy! Go in, go in
The angels beckon thee the prize
to win:
Enter, enter, enter, oh enter now!
Louder and sweeter sounds the loving call
Come, ling'rer, come! enter that
festal hall:
Enter, enter, enter, oh enter now!
It fills, it fills, that hall of jubilee!
Make haste, make haste! tis not too
full for thee!
Enter, enter, enter, oh enter now!
Ere night that gate may close, and
seal thy doom
Then the last, low, long, cry, “No
room, no room!"
No room, no room! oh, woeful cry!
“No room!". Amen
hymns.author: Horatius Bonar

hymns.title: Thanks we Give Unto Jehovah
lyrics: THANKS we give unto Jehovah
Our King, Gracious Provider
For the victory earn unto us
Amidst and through ages past.
Today, a joyful day to us
We’re worshippping in the morn
Ye Cherubim and Seraphim
In fellowship, God to praise.
Christ Jesus, the Head of our Band
Let’s witness Thee in our midst
Praises we offer unto Thee
For Thine saving grace on us.
Ye Cherubim and Seraphim
We are belo-ved of God
Of God the Blessed Trinity
Our King, Omnipotent God.
All witches and wizards on earth
Their powers are nulified
By the powe’r of the Trinity
We shall all conquer Satan.
Our days on earth are exhausting
Let us, to work he ready
Our toillng here on planet earth
None shall ever be in vain.
We commend, Spiritual Father
God bless thee is all we plead
Golden crown shall be thine reward
By the pow‘r of Trinity.
hymns.author: Cherubim & Seraphim Church
chorus: We’re dancing, and we’re rejoicing
For Thine saving grace till today
Our souls are filled with joy today
Glory be to Trinity.

hymns.title: Bestial Beings in the Forest Dwell
lyrics: BESTIAL beings in the forest dwell
Thus are created of God
Of rare specie the lion is
Crowned as King of the lot.
Image of God and His likeness
Men are created of God
In obedience and of good works
Unto one and to all.
Like true children of St. Mary
Be of good cheers and chaste
In unalloy‘d love like the Lord
Christ Jesus Son of God.
Be gentle and true as the sheep
Embraced by one and all
By men and the Almighty God
As unto adult grows.
Ever the Lord reigneth as King
On sacred throne above
Watching over all His children
Loved, and under His seal. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: We Speak of the Realms of the Blest
lyrics: WE speak of the realms of the Blest
Of that country so bright and so fair
And oft are its glories confess’d
But what must it be to be there?
We speak of its pathways of gold,
Of its walls deck’d with Jewels most rare
Its wonders and pleasures untold
But what must it be to be there?
We speak of its freedom from sin
From sorrow, temptation, and care
From trials without and within
But what must it be to be there?
We speak of its anthems of praise
With which we can never compare
The sweetest on earth we can raise
But what must it be to be there?
We speak of its service of love,
Of the robes which the glorified wear
The Church of the first-born above
But what must it be to be there?
Do Thou, Lord. ‘midst pleasure of woe
Still for Heav’n our spirits prepare
And shortly we also shall know
And feel what it is to be there. Amen
hymns.author: Elizabeth Mills

hymns.title: All Ye Band of Seraphim
lyrics: ALL ye Band of Seraphim
Endure on, endure on
Be ye strong and not weary
Endure on
Onward in thy Journey though
Tempest and storm may arise
Fight a good cause and fear not
Just endure.
Cherubim and Seraphim
Endure on, endure on
As all the Prophets of old
Who endured
Forge ahead and be not slack
Father will thy prayers hark
Endure all tribulations
Just endure.
Thorny the way may though seem
Endure on, endure on
Gaze above the blessed land
Endure on
Remember The Word spake thus
With wings ye will mount the hills
By the power of Trinity
We‘ll be crowned. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: My Spirit Soul and Body
lyrics: MY Spirit, soul and body
Jesus, I give to Thee
A consecrated off'ring
Thine evermore to be
My all is on the altar
Lord, I am all Thine own
Oh, may my faith ne’er falter
Lord, keep me Thine alone.
O Jesus, mighty Saviour
I trust in Thy great name
I look for Thy salvation
Thy promise now I claim
Now, Lord, I yield my members
From sin's dominion free
For warfare and for triumph
As weapon unto Thee.
Oh, blissful self-surrender
To live, my Lord, by Thee
My Saviour and Son of God
Live out Thy life in me
I’m Thine, O blessed Jesus
Wash’d by Thy sacred blood
Sealed by Thy Holy Spirit
A sacrifice to God. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Jesus Loves me this I Know
lyrics: JESUS loves me, this I know
For the Bible tells me so,
Little ones to Him belong
They are weak, but He is strong.
Jesus loves me He who died
Heaven's gate to open wide
He will wash away my sin
Let His little child come in.
Jesus loves me, loves me still
Though I‘m very weak and ill
From His shining throne on high
He will watch me where I lie.
Jesus loves me, He will stay
Close beside me all the way,
Then His little child will take
Up to Heav’n for His dear sake. Amen
hymns.author: Anna Bartlett Warner

hymns.title: Jesus Meek an Gentle
lyrics: JESUS, meek an gentle,
Son of God most High
Pitying, loving Saviour
Hear Thy children’s cry.
Pardon our offences
Loose our captive chains
Break down every idol
Which our soul detains.
Give us holy freedom
Fill our hearts with love
Draw us, holy Jesus
To the realms above.
Lead us on our journey
Be Thyself the way
Through terrestial darkness
To celestial day.
Jesus, meek and gentle
Son of God most High
Pitying, loving Saviour
Hear Thy children’s cry. Amen
hymns.author: George Rundle Prynne

hymns.title: The Eye Has not Seen nor Hath
lyrics: THE eye has not seen nor hath
the ear heard
The feast that God has prepared
for His own
Those people who love Him and
those whom He loved
And who worship before Him here
in His house.
How glorious heav’n is no one can know
It’s joy has not broken into man’s heart
If the kingdom of this world can be
so sweet
How would the Kingdomof God be,
to compare.
A city without sin and without death
A city where we‘ll never say “Good bye
Where there is no parting nor any weeping
Where Jesus reigns how great the rejoicing there.
Where we shall meet with those who
have gone on
The father, the son, the husband and wife
Friend and neighbours all, who have gone
on before
Oh, how pleasant, the kingdom of God will be.
With the saints of God to gather and sing
The song of Moses and that of the Lamb,
Where there will be no more cares as in
the world
Where Jesus will serve us, how pleasant
indeed.
Let me lose the world, its passing riches
Just to set my feet in the glory land
And when I walk the street of gold, up yonder
I‘ll forget all the sufferings l have
gone through. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: I Am so Glad that our Father in Heaven
lyrics: I am so glad that our Father in heaven
Tells of His love in the Book he has given
Wonderful things in the Bible I see
This is the dearest, that Jesus loves me.
Though I forget Him and wonder away
Still He doth love me, where ever l stray
Back to His dear loving arms do I flee
When I remember that Jesus loves me.
Oh, if there's only one song I can sing
When in His beauty I see the great King
This shall my song in eternity be,
‘Oh what a wonder that Jesus loves me!
Jesus loves me and I know I love Him
Love brought Him down my poor
Soul to redeem
Yes it was love made Him die on the tree
Oh! I am certain that Jesus loves me!
If one should ask of me, how can I tell?
Glory to Jesus, I know very well!
God‘s Holy Spirit with mine doth agree
Constantly witnessing Jesus loves me.
In this assurance I find sweetest rest
Trusting in Jesus, I know I am bless‘d
And Satan from my feeblesoul doth flee
When I just tell him that Jesus loves me.
hymns.author: Philip P. Bliss
chorus: I am so glad that Jesus loves me
Jews loves me Jesus loves me
I am so glad that Jesus loves me
Jesus loves me! And you.

hymns.title: Members of Cherubim Seraphim
lyrics: MEMBERS of Cherubim, Seraphim
Be wary of whatever sown
Be it edible fruits or the weeds
Whatever ye sow shall ye reap.
Sow blessings and sooner shall be ripe
Sow pains and sooner it shall grow
Sow mercy and same shall ye savour
Whatever ye sow, shall ye reap.
Sow love and sooner the same
shall spread
And thine heart shall it over whelm
Sow hope and the fruit shall ye so reap
Whatever ye sow, shall ye reap.
Faithfully sow the seed of Gospel
Blessing in return ye shall reap
Many, un‐numbered stars on thine crown
Whatever ye sow, shall ye reap.
Proclaim Christ Jesus with His passion
His salvation, make known on earth
Everlasting life, thus shall ye reap
Whatever ye sow, shall ye read.
hymns.author: anon
chorus: Whatever soweth, same
shall ye reap - 2ce
The harvesting time cometh
quickly
Whatever ye sow, same
shall ye reap.

hymns.title: Now the Day is over
lyrics: NOW the day is over
Night is drawing nigh
Shadows of the evening
Steal across the sky.
Now the darkness gathers,
Stars, their watches keep,
Birds, and beasts, and flowers
Soon will be asleep.
Jesus, give the weary
Calm and sweet repose
With Thy tendrest blessing
May mine eyelids close.
Grant to little children
Visions bright of Thee
Guard the sailors tossing
On the deep blue sea.
Comfort every sufferer
Watching late in pain
Those who plan some evil
From their sin restrain.
Through the long night watches
May Thine angels spread
Their white wings above me
Watching round my bed.
When the morning wakens
Then may I arise
Pure and fresh, and sinless
ln Thy holy eyes.
Glory to the Father
Glory to the Son,
And to Thee, blest spirit
Whilst all ages run. Amen
hymns.author: Sabine Baring-Gould

hymns.title: Omnipotent Almighty God
lyrics: OMNIPOTENT, Almighty God
To Thee our thanks and praises due
Thou who dwellest ‘midst Cherubims
Thine loving light, beam unto us.
God of Saint Orimolade
We thank Thee for unfailling help
Thou established the Seraph Band
On eternal immortal Rock.
When trouble like a gloomy cloud
Hath gathered thick and thundered loud
He, near our soul, doth always stood
And make us victorious so sure.
Though num’rous host of mighty foes
The earth and hell, our ways oppose
He safely lead our souls along
Glory and praises to His name.
Almighty God, the Creator
Protect us from earthly tumult
May peace, provision and blessings
Be ours from now and ever more.
JahJehovah Nissi our King
Thou art our King, Mighty Conqueror
Unto us all Thine victory gain
And to our Fathers Spiritual.
God of Saint Orimolade
Our thanks and praise we plead receive
May we rejoice ever with Thee
In heaven at the end of time.
hymns.author: anon
chorus: Glory, glory to gracious King)
Forever Thine praises endure) - 2ce

hymns.title: There is a Path that Leads to God
lyrics: THERE is a path that leads to God
All others leads astray
Narrow but pleasant is the road
And Christians love the way.
It leads straight through this world
of sin
And dangers must be pass’d
But those who boldly walk therein
Will get to heav’n at last.
How shall an infant pilgrim dare
This dangerous path to tread?
For on the way’s many a snare
For youthful trav‘llers spread.
While the broad road, where
thousands go
Lies near and opens fair
And many turn aside, I know
To walk with sinners there.
But lest my feeble steps should slide
Or wander from Thy way
Lord, condescend to be my guide
And I shall never stray.
Then I may go without alarm
And trust His word of old
The lambs He’ll gather with His arm
And lead them to the fold.
This l may safetly venture through
Beneath my Shepherd’s care
And keep the gate of heav’n in view,
Till l shall enter there. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Thou God who Loved Father Abraham
lyrics: THOU God who loved Father Abraham
And made him Friend on earth
And Bless his children in the world
Like the heavenly Star above
Thy promise made unto Isaac
To recover the land
Fulfilled Thou to Father Jacob
His beloved son on earth.
O Thou who heard our Moses' cry
On Mountain of Sinai
Thou who calleth Father Samuel
When he was yet of a child
Thou who strengthen the young David
To conquer Goliath
Come strengthen Band Cherubim
With Truth and Righteousness.
Hear what Jesus our Lord has said
To all his Apostles
To be ever strong in the Lord
When Holy Spirit given
When Holy Ghost descend on them
They joyfully served Him
Redemption their song everyday
For ever with the Lord.
Cherubim and ye Seraphim
Firm and firm thy girdle tie
Members of the Prayerist Band
Be ready to work for Christ
The promises made of the Lord
Of Christ Jesus the Truth
In mem‘ry let us ever be
Now till the latter-day.
Ye saved and redeemed of the world
Rend to Him salvation hymns
Unto the Lover of our souls
Who with His blood us redeemed
From our servitude here on earth
And all our fears He bore
Unto Canaan the peaceful land
Reigning with Jesus our King.
Thou unto Moses offer help
Our Father Spiritual
Thy fold to shepherd and to care
Cherubim and Seraphim
Victory to Victory grant to us
Conq’rors let us ever be
Victorious crown all we may earn
Like the prophets. saints of old.
hymns.author: anon
chorus: Put on girdle to fight for Christ
Put on girdle to fight for Christ
Put on girdle, I say - 2ce
Put on girdle to fight for Christ.

hymns.title: Thy Way not Mine O Lord
lyrics: THY way, not mine, O Lord
However dark it be!
Lead me by Thine own hand
Choose out the path for me.
Smooth let it be or rough
It will be still the best
Winding or straight, it leads
Right onward to Thy rest.
I dare not choose my lot
I would not, If I might
Choose Thou for me, my God
So shall I walk aright.
The kingdom that I seek
Is Thine, so let the way
That leads to it be Thine
Else I must surely stray.
Take Thou my cup, and it
With joy or sorrow fill
As best to Thee may seem
Choose Thou my good and ill.
Not mine, not mine the choice
In things of great or small
Be Thou my Guide, my Strength
My Wisdom, and my All. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: The Saints of God! their Conflict Past
lyrics: THE saints of God! their conflict past
And life’s long battle won at last
No more they need the shield or sword
They cast them down before their Lord
O happy saints! for ever blest
At Jesus feet how safe their rest!
The saints of God! their wand’rings done
No more their weary course they run
No more they faint, no more they fall
No foes oppress, no fear appeal
O happy saints! for ever blest
In that dear home, how sweet their rest?
The saints of God! life's voyage o'er
Safe landed on that blissful shore
No stormy tempests now they dread
No roaring billows lift their head
O happy saints! for ever blest
In that calm haven of their rest.
The saints of God their vigil keep
While yet their mortal bodies sleep
Till from the dust they too shall rise
And soar triumphant to the skies
O happy saints! rejoice and sing
He quickly comes, our Lord and King.
O God of saints, to Thee we cry
O Saviour, plead for us on high
O Holy Ghost, our Guide and friend
Grant us Thy grace till life shall end
That will all saints our rest may be
ln that bright paradise with Thee. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Pilgrims of Heaven All we are
lyrics: PILGRIMS of heaven all we are
On earth we sojourn, heaven
is our home
On earth we all are sojourners
On earth we sojourn, heaven
is our home
All Dangers now envelope us
Surrounding us everyday
Weeping, rejoicing everyday
On earth we sojourn, heaven
is our home.
Beloved hath slept in the Lord
On earth we sojourn, heaven
is our home
Toiling and strife is now over
On earth we sojourn, heaven
is our home
Unto the Lord thou hath fought
Enter to thine Father‘s joy
Forever thine mem’ry shall be
On earth we sojourn, heaven
is our home.
The young and aged passing on
On earth we sojourn, heaven
is our home
Dying in Jesus is the best
On earth we sojourn, heaven
is our home
Spending our time for Jesus
For a day of death exist
No immortal being here on earth
On earth we sojourn, heaven
is our home.
On the breast of God we shall rest
On earth we sojourn, heaven
is our home
No sorrow there, no weeping there
On earth we sojourn, heaven
is our home
Many mansions abound there
Provided by our Lord God
For those who worship to the end
On earth we sojourn, heaven
is our home.
Beloved rejoice in the Lord
On earth we sojourn. heaven
is our home
Meeting thine lover Christ Jesus
On earth we sojourn, heaven
is our home
Care for us all Father Lord
May we never get drowned here
May we ever be justified
On earth we sojourn, heaven
is our home. Amen
hymns.author: Cherubim & Seraphim Church

hymns.title: Shinning for Jesus Everywhere I Go
lyrics: SHINNING for Jesus everywhere I go
Shinning for Jesus in this world of woe
Shinning for Jesus, more like Him I grow
Shinning all the time for Jesus.
Shinning for Jesus when the way is bright
Shinning for Jesus in the darkest night
Shinning for Jesus, making burdens light
Shinning all the time for Jesus.
Shinning for Jesus in a world of sin
Shinning for Jesus bringing lost ones in
Shinning for Jesus, glorifying Him
Shinning all the time for Jesus.
Shinning for Jesus when He gives me grace
Shinning for Jesus while I run the race
Shinning for Jesus, till I see His face
Shinning all the time for Jesus.
hymns.author: anon
chorus: Shinning all the time, Shinning all the time
Shinning for Jesus beams of love divine
Glorifying Him every day and hour
Shinning all the time for Jesus.

hymns.title: Hosts of Heav'nly Angels
lyrics: HOSTS of heav'nly Angels
The divine heav‘nly hosts
The host of the Apostles Saints
The host of heav‘nly beings
All in heaven above
Praise Thee at noon and night
Almighty God the Trinity
Omnipotent Most High.
Converging Band by Band
Before Thee our Father
To offer unto Thee our thanks
Coupled with our off'rings
Harvest offerings we brought
To the God of harvest
Oh God we plead descend and fill
This house with Thine Glory.
Amidst countless horrors
Encircling us about
Amidst unstable earthly tides
In harvest ages past
To Thee we offer thanks
For sparing all our lives
To this our harvest day oh Lord
We glorify Thy name.
When Noah’s offering he brought
Rainbow, Thou manifest
As sign that no flood will ever
Submerge the earth again
Rainbow please manifest
For the sake of our Christ
May sorrow and grief and anguish
Nay our lot ever be.
The widow then of old
Just little offered she
Abundant blessings she received
For the least offered she
Jesus today we plead
Pour Thy blessings on us
All our offering we plead receive
E‘en though substandard be.
We plead Thee oh our God
Our hearts we plead receive
Unwholesome heart brought we to Thee
Wholly and filthy though
With Thine blood Jesus cleanse
The guilty stains away
May all our hearts an offering be
Of thanksgiving to Thee. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Thanks we Offer to God
lyrics: THANKS we offer to God
For keeping us till now
Our souls not yieldeth to beasts
Nor unto devourers
Death and satan doth rage
Nay us God to forsake
Glory unto Most High God
Great Majesty; our God.
Multitude is Thine grace
On us bestow King of Kings
Thine protection, guide and care
And victory from the foes
In subconscious and life
And Thy bene-volence
Divine healing, miracle
Our thanks accept oh Lord.
Our riches not enough
Our clothings naught of worth
No worthy thanks unto Thee
But our songs rend to Thee
Our souls to Christ we give
Now and eternity
May heav’nly joy for us be
Promiseth us of Christ.
Even though wealth abound
Multitude houses built
Coats of colours purchaseth
Many are kids we born
Nay of joy they shall be
Nay our joy yet is full
Art we nay promises made
When we in dread and fright.
Why afrightened art thou
Christ Jesus all can wrought
Art thou tempest tossed and drift
To Jesus call for help
Peter calleth for help
Peter ne’er left to drown
Hezekiah calleth Him
Victory hath he won.
Those who Christ blood desire
Shall in their heart decide
From Lucifer to depart
And from his evil hosts
Wrath, strife, envy decline
Hatred revellings ignore
All ungodly acts and deeds
Now and for-ever-more.
Thanks we offer to God
King of Kings, Lord of Lords
Almighty, wonderful God
Lord and Saviour of men
Creation, Maker of days
Thy great Name we rever
Great is Thy be-ne-vo-lence
Our thanks receive oh Lord. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: When the Power of God
lyrics: WHEN the pow'r of God descended
On the day of Pentecost
All the days of waiting ended
They received the Holy Ghost.
Tongues of flame came down upon them
And they preached the word in pow‘r
Listening multitudes awaken’d
Turned to God that very hour.
We are waiting Holy Spirit
We are all of one accord
Lord fulfil just now the promise
That is given in Thy Word.
Fill and thrill us with thy presence
Grant the blessing that we need
Flood our souls wish wondrous glory
While the pray’r of faith we plead. Amen
hymns.author: Mary Hubbert Munford
chorus: O Lord, send the pow'r just now
O Lord, send the pow'r just now,
O Lord, send the pow’r just now,
And baptize, every one.

hymns.title: God of my Earthly being
lyrics: GOD of my earthly being
My soul to Thee rejoice
By Thy grace I am made
Still I am so preserved
The day of my birth is now come
So shall I bless - 2ce
My day of birth.
Through all my earthly days
To Thee I pray to live
May all my heart and soul
Thanks and praise offer Thee
My possesions and all my being
My creator - 2ce
And God will praise.
All the strength of my soul
Solely Thine it shall be
All the time I posses
Separated unto Thee
In Thine image, Me incarnate
And I will praise - 2ce
Thee forever.
Thine will all is my wish
As heav’nly Angels do
Born again I in Christ
Forgiveness I'll receive
May I fulfill, Thine perfect will
May I by love - 2ce
Be sanctified.
The toil when accomplished
By the strong power of faith
Receive Thy be-lo-ved
In the time of demise
Call me as Thou hath called Moses
ln perfect peace - 2ce
My soul shall rest. Amen
hymns.author: Cherubim & Seraphim Church

hymns.title: There is Victory Within my Soul
lyrics: THERE is victory within my soul
For the spirit with me abides
Let the waves of temptation roll
Jesus keeps me whate’er betides.
Though the conflict be fierce and long
Though the tempter my heart assail
In my weakness yet I am strong
For with Jesus I’ll e’er prevail.
I have victory over sin
I have victory o’er the grave
Even death now has lost its sting
Hallelujah! I know I’m saved.
hymns.author: anon
chorus: Victory, victory, vict'ry in my souls
I have glorious victory since
Jesus took control
Victory, victory, sweeping like a flood
I have glorious victory through
Jesus’ blood.

hymns.title: I and All those of my Household
lyrics: I and all those of my household
Will worship and serve the Lord God
But I even I will
By my words and by my actions
Show that I know the God of heav’n
And serve Him truthfully.
I will create good example
And remove every obstacle
From the way of my ward
By my life, show them their duty
Yet, in my duty, to obtain
Honour that comes through love.
I'll be easily entreated
And in wrath remember mercy
The Lord’s true disciple
I also want to be holy
And bring my household and
loved ones
Into the narrow way.
When Thou has put the flame of love
Within this chosen vessel’s heart
Receive it to Thyself
Lord, do Thy goodwill within me
Help to show by my life how each
Bible Christian should live.
Grant to me, dear Lord, Thy good grace
Behold, I come to testify
Of Thy wonderful name
That sav'd my soul from perdition
And the grace that is felt within
Of which each tongue can speak.
I who have been set free from sin
Desire my household to be sav’d
I would tell pardon
To my child, my wife and servants
To make them walk in the good way
To a holy heaven. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: I Always Go to Jesus
lyrics: I always go to Jesus
When troubled or distressed
I always find a refuge
Upon His loving breast
I tell Him all my trials
I tell Him all my grief
And while my lips are speaking
He gives my heart relief.
When full of dread forebodings
And flowing o'er my tears
He calms away my sorrow
And hushes all my fears
He comprehends my weakness
The peril I am in
And He supplies the armour
I need to conquer sin.
I always go to Jesus
No matter when or where
I seek His gracious presence
I’m sure to find Him there
In times of joy or sorrow
What’er my need may be
I always go to Jesus
And Jesus comes to me. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Peace Doubting Heart
lyrics: PEACE, doubting heart! my God’s I am
Who formed me man, forbids my fear
The Lord hath called me by my name
The Lord protects, for ever near
His blood for me did once atone
And still He loves and guards His own.
When passing through the watery deep
I ask in faith His promised aid
The waves an awful distance keep
And shrink from my devoted head
Fearless their violence I dare
They cannot harm, for God is there.
To Him mine eye of faith I turn
And through the fire pursue my way
The fire forgets its pow‘r to burn
The lament flames around me play
I own His pow’r, accept the sign
And shout to prove the Saviour mine.
Still nigh me, O my Saviour, stead
And guard in fierce temptation’s hour
Hide me in the hollow of Thy hand
Show forth in me Thy saving pow‘r
Still be Thy arms my sure defence
Nor earth nor hell shall pluck me thence.
Since Thou hast bid me come to Thee
Good as Thou art, and strong to save
I'll walk o’er life's tempestuous sea
Upborne by the unyielding wave
Dauntless, though rocks of pride be near
And yanwning whirl pools of despair.
When darkness intercepts the skies
And sorrow’s waves around me roll
When high the storms of passion rise
And half o‘er whelms my sinking soul
My soul a sudden calm shall feel
And hear a whisper-Peace, be still.
Though in affliction’s furnace tried
Unhurt on snares and death I'll tread
Though sin assail, and hell, thrown wide
Pour all its flames upon my head
Like Moses’ bush, I'll mount higher
And flourish unconsumed in fire. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: I Am Coming to the Cross
lyrics: I am coming to the cross
I am poor and weak and blind
I am counting all but dross
I shall full salvation find.
In Thy promises I trust
Now I feel the blood applied
I am prostrate in the dust
I with Christ am crucified.
Jesus comes! He fills my soul!
Perfected in Him I am
I am every white made whole
Glory, glory to the Lamb.
hymns.author: anon
chorus: I am trusting, Lord in Thee
Dear Lamb of Calvary
Humbly at the cross I bow
Save me, Jesus, save me now.

hymns.title: O God the Help of All thy Saints
lyrics: O God, the help of all Thy saints
Our hope in time of ill
We trust Thee, though Thy face be-hid
And seek Thy presence still.
Why should the men of pride and sin
Thy truth and pow‘r defy
And boast, as if their evil way
Were hidden from Thine eye?
Lord, Thou hast seen, arise and save
To Thee our cause we bring
Reign Thou in righteousness and pow’r
For Thou alone art King.
All our desires to Thee are known
Thine help is ever near
O first prepare our hearts to pray
And then accept our pray’r. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Tis so Sweet to Trust in Jesus
lyrics: ‘TIS so sweet to trust in Jesus
Just to take Him at His Word
Just to rest upon His promises
Just to know, ‘Thus saith the Lord.
O how sweet to trust in Jesus
Just to trust His cleansing blood
Just in simple faith to plung me
Neath the healing, cleansing flood!
Yes, ‘tis sweet to trust in Jesus
Just from sin and self to cease
Just from Jesus simply taking
Life and rest, and joy and peace.
I’m so glad I learn’d to trust Thee
Precious Jesus, Saviour, Friend
And I know that Thou art with me
Wilt be with me to the end.
hymns.author: Cherubim & Seraphim Church
chorus: Jesus, Jesus, how I trust Him
How I've proved Him o'er and o'er
Jesus, Jesus, precious Jesus!
O for grace to trust Him more!

hymns.title: Rise up Ye Band of Seraphim
lyrics: RISE up ye Band of Seraphim
With love and good-will to mankind
Ever brighter your glorious light
In praises to Almighty God.
Rise up ye Band of Seraphim
With joy I say bear ye your cross
Vex not and never be in doubt
Your sorrows will soon change to joy.
Rise up ye Band of Seraphim
Your hopes will never never lose
Father will ever hear your voice
Never allow your faith to shake.
Rise up ye Band of Seraphim
High hills will soon reduce to plain
As Jesus Christ is on our side
No soul on earth can assail us.
Rise up ye Band of Seraphim
The Lord our God will soon appear
The crown of Star will be our own
Amidst the Holy Band above.
hymns.author: anon
chorus: March on, in the glory of the Lord - 2ce
March on, march on, march on
Cherubim and Seraphim.

hymns.title: Blessed Shepherd our Souls Protect
lyrics: BLESSED Shepherd our souls protect
ln perilous seasons
Grant unto Thine flock here below
The zeal on guard to be.
When at the peak our travails be
And dare trials abound
May our souls rest on Thee assured
Ceaseless in fervent pray‘rs.
Suppliant heart to us endow
Graciously time un-end
By grace afford Thy face to see
Thy name to us reveal.
His sacred being to us bestow’d
Un-alloy’d perfect love
May Thee our wish and desire be
Ne’er Thee from us depart.
Thou shall never from me depart
Thine name to me reveal
WithThy salvation my soul bless
Thine image make me be.
Thine face to me brightly reveal
When on the mount I dwell
When Thou our God, our faith we see
Our worship, praise we give. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Arise Arise Soldiers of Christ
lyrics: ARISE! arise, soldiers of Christ
The gospel of the Lord proclaim
Be happy and ever rejoice
With songs of joy the Lord to meet.
Great things for us the Lord hath wrought
Rejoice and ever let’s be glad
For great anniversary today
Thanks we give unto Jehovah.
Be ready ye Soldiers of Christ
For the return of Christ the Lord
Not in humility as thence
As ere to earth our pardon seal.
hymns.author: anon
chorus: Rejoice, for the Lord shall soon)
return) - 2ce
Rejoice, Rejoice, Christ shall
return within the sky.

hymns.title: O Come and Dwell in me
lyrics: O come and dwell in me
Spirit of pow’r within
And bring the glorious liberty
From sorrow, fear, and sin.
The seed of sin’s disease
Spirit of health, remove
Spirit of finished holiness
Spirit of perfect love.
Hasten the joyful day
Which shall my sins consume
When old things shall be passed away
And all things new become.
The original offence
Out of my soul erase
Enter Thyself, and drive it hence
And take up all the place.
I want the witness, Lord
That all I do is right
According to Thy will and word
Well-pleasing in Thy sight.
I ask no higher state
Indulge me but in this
And soon or later then translate
To my eternal bliss. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: Lord to Thee Have we Come
lyrics: LORD to Thee have we come
Cherubim, Seraphirn
Thine Service and worship, attend
To all the earthly beings.
To Thine service, attend
Christ Jesus, Saviour, Lord
Thy sacred Sabbath, who defiles
Most judged at last shall be.
Bow down before the Lord
In worship at His feet
Oh Lord we plead, Thy wrath to cease
Upon the earthly race.
Cherubim, Seraphirn
Ye are the salt on earth
The city found on Sacred Rock
Obscure shall never be.
Blow ye the trump aloud
On sacred day of rest
The sabbath of the Lord to keep
By one and all on earth.
To Father glory give
Glory give to the Son
Glory give to the Holy Ghost
Eternal Trinity. Amen
hymns.author: anon

hymns.title: O my soul, bless Thou Jehovah
lyrics: O my soul, bless Thou Jehovah,
All within me, bless His name;
Bless Jehovah, and forget not
All His mercies to proclaim:
He forgives all thy transgressions,
Thy diseases all who heals,
Who redeems thee from destruction,
Who with thee so kindly deals.
For as east from west is distant,
He hath put away our sin;
Like the pity of a father
Hath the Lord's compassion been.
Bless Jehovah, all His creatures
Ever under His control,
All throughout His vast dominion;
Bless Jehovah, O my soul.
chorus: For as high as is the heaven,
Far above the earth below,
Ever great to them that fear Him,
Is the mercy He will show.

hymns.title: All nations of the world rejoice
lyrics: All nations of the world rejoice
Before the Lord, the Prince of Peace,
Oh worship Him with joyful hearts
His praises all your tougues employ.
The Lord, He surely is the God
It is from Him all blessings flow
All on earth His creatures are.
And the sheep of His fold we are.
Come before His gates with thanksgiving
Enter His courts with songs of praise
Make it a glorious work indeed
To honour Him and sing His praise.
Kind and merciful is our God
His grace and mercy ever sure
All nations of the earth shall know
That His truth ever more endure

hymns.title: The earth is full of goodly towns
lyrics: The earth is full of goodly towns
Bethlehem surpasses them
Truly, from Thee came forth the Lord
To reign over Israel.
The glory of the star that shown
To herald Christ's glorious birth
Was more than that of rising sun
When Christ in the flesh was born.
Wise men came from the East afar
To offer precious, costly gifts;
Behold as they give Him their gold
And their frankincense and myrr.
Jesus, at Thy revelation
Worshipped by gentiles in fear
Glory, we give to Thee, Father
And to the Holy spirit.

hymns.title: Peace, period peace, in this dark world of sin?
lyrics: Peace, period peace, in this dark world of sin?
The blood of Jesus whispers peace within.
Peace, perfect peace, by thronging duties pressed?
To do the will of Jesus, this is rest.
Peace, perfect peace, with sorrows surging round?
On Jesus' bosom nought but calm is found
Peace, perfect peace, with loved ones far away?
In Jesus' keeping we are safe and they.
Peace, perfect peace, our future all unknown?
Jesus we know, and He is on the throne.
Peace, perfect peace, death shadowing us and ours?
Jesus has vanquished death and all its powers.
It is enough: earth's struggles soon shall cease.
And Jesus call us to heaven's perfect peace.

hymns.title: Though the world allure with its gilded charm
lyrics: Though the world allure with its gilded charm,
I'm a child of God, whom it cannot harm;
He will me uphold by His mighty arm,
Every moment of my day.
I can ne'er forget how upon the tree
Laid the Son of God, there to die for me;
Yet to save my soul, thus it had to be,
There could be no other way.
I would e'er be true to my Lord and King,
Every waking hour praises to Him sing,
Knowing that at last He my soul shall bring,
Ever more with Him to stay.
chorus: I've a friend who will ev'ry need supply,
I've a home far beyond the starry sky,
And you know, that is just the reason why,
I am singing Hallelujah!

hymns.title: Time may tarnish earth treasures
lyrics: Time may tarnish earth treasures,
Take what I have lov'd before;
Jesus gives abiding pleasures
Having Him, what need I more?
Having Him, what need I more?
Tho' the beams of worldly gladness,
Fail to light the pathway dim,
Jesus takes away my sadness,
All I need I find in Him,
All I need I find in Him.
To His boundless stores of blessing,
Jesus opens wide the door,
All-in-all in Him possessing,
I shall never want for more,
I shall never want for more.
chorus: I have Christ and need no more
From His hand rich gifts outpour,
Lo, I'm singing o'er and o'er,
I have Christ, I need no more.

hymns.title: Jesu, my Lord, my God, my All
lyrics: Jesu, my Lord, my God, my All,
Hear me, blest Saviour, when I call;
Hear me, and from Thy dwelling place
Pour down the riches of Thy grace;
Jesu, too late I Thee have sought,
How can I love Thee as I ought?
And how extol Thy matchless fame,
The glorious beauty of Thy name?
Jesu, what didst Thou find in me,
That Thou hast dealt so lovingly?
How great the joy that Thou hast brought
So far exceeding hope or thought!
Jesu, of Thee shall be my song,
To Thee my heart and soul belong;
All that I have or am is Thine,
And Thou, blest Saviour, Thou art mine
chorus: Jesu, my Lord, I Thee adore,
Oh make me love Thee more and more

hymns.title: I will love Thee, God the Father
lyrics: I will love Thee, God the Father
My sweet Saviour, Lord and King;
I will love Thee, for without Thee
The world is sore and bitter.
I'll love Thee, for all blessings flow
As token of Thy great love
I'll love Thee, for he who loves Thee
Will never be left alone.
I'll love Thee Lord, take care of me
Oh let Thy eyes be my guide
I'll love thee Lord, this heart will die
Without the food of Thy love.
I have vowed, I will love Thee Lord
My heart trusts in Thy deep love
And loving Thee, I'll not forget
The shed blood of my Saviour.

hymns.title: Thy righteousness alone, my God, not mine
lyrics: Thy righteousness alone, my God, not mine
Can only be the peace my heart craves for
Thy love alone can take away my fears
Can stem the storm that rage deep in my heart.
The cross tells me that Thou art Lord of love
And I read love, even upon Thy grave
All other love shall fail and come to naught
Thy love shall bear me o'er the sea of life.
Thou blessed me, and Thou saved my sinful heart
From hence forth, through endless eternity
When there was no help, Thou liftest me up
Above storms and billows of affliction.
Every hour, Lord, reveal Thyself to me
In the abundance of Thy glory Lord
Reveal Thyself in Thy mercy and might
Show me Thy love, Thy truth and righteousness.

hymns.title: O loving Shepherd, care for us
lyrics: O loving Shepherd, care for us
In these perilous times
Give unto all Thy disciples,
The power to watch and pray.
When our trials persist, O Lord
And afflictions increase,
Grant that our hearts rely on Thee,
In long prevailing prayers.
The spirit of supplication
In faith, give Thou to us
Until we shall behold Thy face,
And know Thy mighty name.
Until we are in communion,
And sweetest fellowship,
Let this be the heart's cry of all,
We will not let Thee go.
I will not let Thee go except
Thou tells Thy name to me,
Oh, bless me with Thy salvation
And let me be like Thee.
O, let me clearly see Thy face
Up there in heaven above,
Where faith will be transformed to sight,
And prayer becomes our praise.

hymns.title: Jesus, Lord we come to Thee
lyrics: Jesus, Lord we come to Thee,
At Thy feet we humbly kneel,
Despise not our petition,
Ah! shall we seek Thee in vain?
In the way Thou choose for us,
We are seeking Thee this hour,
O Lord, we shall not depart,
Until Thou will bless us all.
Send a message in Thy word
That gives joy unto our hearts,
May Thy spirit here bestow
Forgiveness to all our hearts.
Let us seek Thee and find Thee
As a benevolent God
Heal the sick, set-captives free,
Let us all rejoice in Thee.

hymns.title: Heavenly Father, gently lead us
lyrics: Heavenly Father, gently lead us,
Lead us through this vale of tears,
Thy grace bestow Thou upon us,
To make light our burdens here.
When troubles shoot arrows at us
All around us and about,
Do not let Thy goodness fail us,
Lead us in Thy perfect way,
When deep pain rakes through our body
When death's angel is so near,
Forbid that we become weary,
Grant that our hearts will not fear.
When our fleeting life is over
Let us lean upon Thy wings,
Till the angels come to take us,
To that blessed, happy land.
chorus: Comfort us, Lord,
Through this earthly wilderness.

hymns.title: Behold the mercy seat
lyrics: Behold the mercy seat
Thy word it bids me near,
There Jesus His favour displays
That He may answer prayers.
The Lamb's atoning blood,
He shed on Calvary
Provides an intercession for
Those who will seek the Lord.
Thou art ready to give,
More than all I may ask
He gives to those who seek His face,
More than they e'er request.
Give us Thy image Lord
Thy favour grant to us,
Give me the grace to serve Thee here,
That I may dwell with Thee.

hymns.title: Come, reveal Thyself O Lord
lyrics: Come, reveal Thyself O Lord,
Come, our hearts teach to know Thee
Come, and set our hearts on fire,
Come, and bless us ere we part.
Come, put peace within our hearts,
Come, that we all may be blessed
Come, and speak the words of peace,
Come, our faith increase, O Lord.
Come, make all our doubtings flee
Come, and teach us how to pray,
Come, and fill our hearts with love,
Come, and lift our hearts to heaven.
Come, and make our hearts rejoice,
Come, and say, "You are my choice",
Come, Thy fold in safety keep
Come, and bless thy sheep today.

hymns.title: If you are tired of the load of you sin
lyrics: If you are tired of the load of you sin
Let Jesus come into your heart;
If you desire a new life to begin,
Let Jesus come into your heart,
If 'tis for purity now that you sigh,
Let Jesus come into your heart;
Fountains for cleansing are flowing near by,
Let Jesus come in to your heart
If there 's a tempest your voice cannot still,
Let Jesus come into your heart;
If there's a void this world never can fill,
Let Jesus come into your heart.
If friends, once trusted, have proven untrue,
Let Jesus come into your heart;
Find what a friend He will be unto you,
Let Jesus come into your heart
If you would join the glad songs of the blest,
Let Jesus come into your heart;
If you would enter the mansion of rest,
Let Jesus come into your heart
chorus: Just now, your doubtings give o'er
Just now, reject Him no more;
Just now, throw open the door;
Let Jesus come into your heart.

hymns.title: Sinners do come to the Saviour
lyrics: Sinners do come to the Saviour
Who has come to save your soul,
Your pain He bore on His body
When He suffered in your place.
Eternal God is the One, who
Gave of His spirit to you
Heaven and earth shall pass away
But God lives for ever more.
Before your days here are ended
Before death, your eyelids close
Hasten and seek for your Saviour
Now before it is too late.
Hear how His voice sweetly calls you
''Sinners, do come unto me''
Bring to me your burden of sin
Have hope, believe, do not fear.

hymns.title: O lord hide not your face from him
lyrics: O lord hide not your face from him
Who lies down penitently,
Who is shedding tears for his sins
There, before Thy mercy seat.
Enter not to judgement with me
How much my sins may have been
Because I know this for certain
I am guilty before Thee.
You know everything about me
Before I confessed them all
Even the sins I now commit
Nothing is hid from Thy sight.
I make no vain repetitions
You know what my heart longs for
Before I ask, you have known it
I need mercy plenteously.
Mercy, Lord is what I plead for
Mercy is my greatest need
Therefore, Lord, I need Thy mercy
Grant that I be not denied.

hymns.title: Our heveanly Father calls
lyrics: Our heveanly Father calls
Christ calls us unto Him
Our friendship with them shall be sweet
Precious, our fellowship
Thy tender mercy show
In pardoning my sins
My heart He applied to wisdom
And guided my footsteps
His grace how bountiful
He has a rich store house
This grace the Lord Himself bestows
It is bought with His blood
Jesus, my fountain head
I bless Thy holy name
Intercessor with the Father
The Bishop of my soul!
My heart and all my will
Wait patiently, below
Until sweet communion is full
High up in heaven above

hymns.title: Boundless love, O can it be
lyrics: Boundless love, O can it be
That mercy's retained for me
My God, can Thou yet retain
Thine anger for a sinner?
I have long spurned His mercy
I have too long grieved His heart
Turned deaf ears unto His will
I've grieved Him with many sins
Jesus, answer from above
Full of boundless love Thou art
I fall down beneath Thy feet
Will Thou not forgive my sins
Bring my heart to repentance
That I may weep for my sins;
Have contrition for my sins
Believe and ne'er sin again

hymns.title: I have walked with sin, too long
lyrics: I have walked with sin, too long
Seperate us, Saviour, Lord
Friend of destruction is he
Save me Jesus or I die
There's no benefit I find
Within my heart and body
All of them are quite corrupt
Save me  Jesus or I die
I find life within Thy word
Thy communion is so sweet
Sin doth hold me fast, O Lord
Save me Jesus, do save me
Will Thou silently watch me
Till I die 'cause of weakness
Will Thou leave me unto sin
God forbid, Jesus save me
Thou who knows me inside out
My efforts are known to Thee
You know all my strivings Lord
And my secret tears you see
Sin has put me in fetters
Break the fetters and the chains
I will ever worship Thee
Jesus my Saviour and Lord

hymns.title: O Thou stony heart, repent
lyrics: O Thou stony heart, repent
Thou, the blood of Christ make soft
Behold Jesus pierced body
Look upon His bleeding side
Poor sinner, what did you do
You nailed Him to the cross tree
Truly thy sin is the cause
That nailed Him to the cross tree
Crowned Him with thorns on His side
And pierced His side, Christ our Lord
He gave His life to atone
In dying for the sinners
Will His shed blood be in vain
Can you to the grave repair
Will Thou open up His wounds
Or make Him a new cross tree
No, I will forsake my sins
Repent, thou my stony heart

hymns.title: When Jesus left His Father's throne
lyrics: When Jesus left His Father's throne,
He chose an humble birth;
Like us, unhonour'd and unknown,
He came to dwell on earth
Like Him may we be found below,
In wisdom's path of peace;
Like Him in grace and knowledge grow,
As years and strength increase
Sweet were His words and kind His look,
When mothers round Him press'd;
Their infants in His arms He took,
And on His bosom bless'd
Safe from the world's alluring harms,
Beneath His watchful eye,
Thus in the circle of His arms
May we for ever lie
When Jesus into Salem rode,
The children sang around;
For joy they pluck'd the palms, and strow'd
Their garments on the ground
Hosanna our glad voices raise,
Hosanna to our King!
Should we forget our Saviour's praise,
The stones themselves would sing

hymns.title: I must need go home by the way of the cross
lyrics: I must need go home by the way of the cross,
There's no other way but this;
I shall ne'er get sight of the Gates of Light,
If the way of the cross I miss
I must needs go on in the blood-sprinkled way,
The path that the Saviour trod,
If I ever climb to the heights sublime,
Where the soul is at rest with God
Then I bid farewell to the way of the world,
To walk in it never more;
For my Lord says ''Come,'' and I seek my home,
Where He waits at the open door
chorus: The way of the cross leads home,
The way of the cross leads home;
It is sweet to know, as I onward go,
The way of the cross leads home

hymns.title: Heavens sing, ye earth rejoice
lyrics: Heavens sing, ye earth rejoice,
Men and angels join the strain
Come, surround Him as He rose
Sing the praise of Jesus name
The Son broke the serpent's head
Death and satan all vanquished
Captive led captivity
By the ascended Saviour
Thy strife and Thy fight is o'er
Enter Thou into Thy joy
For His own, He intercedes
At His Father's throne on high

hymns.title: Jesus the friend of sinners dies
lyrics: Jesus the friend of sinners dies
The children of Salem doth weep
Thick darkness sets and veils the skies
And suddenly, the earth did quake
Behold the mercy and the love
Of the king of glory for man
Behold what joy doth come our way
Jesus who died doth rise again
Then, fear ye not, O saints of God
Tell how the Lord our King doth reign,
Sing of His victory o'er the foe
Tell how He met and conquered death
Proclaim: ''Thou art our king for aye''
Thou who art born to save us all
Ask death and say ''where is thy sting?''
And grave, ''where is thy victory?''

hymns.title: O Lord our God in heaven
lyrics: O Lord our God in heaven
Thy tabernacle here
The dwelling of Thy love
No beauty can compare
How my heart longs
For to ascend
To Thy dwelling
On high, my God
Joy fills the hearts of those
Who worship where God chose
Who go there oft to serve
And to worship our God
They praise Thee still
Joy is the lot
Of those who love
Thy holy hill
And on from strength to strength
In this miserable world
Until they up ascend
And appear before Thee,
Glorious abode
Where God shall guide
Our footsteps till
We reach that place
The Lord God is our shield
Light and wall of defence
His hands are filled with gifts
We receive blessings there
There is great joy
Reserved for those
Who trust in Thee
O Lord, our God

hymns.title: What are those those Sabbaths of joy without end
lyrics: What are those those Sabbaths of joy without end,
Angels in light and the glorified spend:
Rest for the weary; for victors reward;
There God Himself all and in all adored?
Who is the Monarch? who circle His throne?
What is the calm restful bliss of His own?
Tell us, ye blessed ones worshipping there,
Tell us, if words can your rapture declare
Oh true Jerusalem, city most bright,
Whose perfect peace is eternal delight:
Longings in thee are fulfill'd ere express'd;
More than was long'd for embraced and possess'd
Troubles all past, in the courts of our King
We without fear Zion's anthems shall sing
Off'ring Thee, Lord, in Thy presence above
Love's pure responses for gifts of Thy love
There never Sabbath to Sabbath gives place;
One is their Sabbath who gaze on Thy face.
There never cease heaven's jubilee songs,
Chanted by saints and sweet angel tongues
Meantime in heart and with faith-winged prayers
Seek we our Fatherland yonder and theirs;
While to Jerusalem bounden we roam,
Exiles returning from Babylon home
Now before Him we adoringly fall,
Of whom and through whom and in whom are all;
Of whom the Father, and through whom the Son,
In whom the Spirit of Both, ever One

hymns.title: Redemption work is o'er
lyrics: Redemption work is o'er
Jesus has fought with death,
He rose triumphant o'er the grave
The Lord is victorious.
The promise He has made
For His own disciples
The mighty God and powerful
His truth He has proclaimed.
After the Lord arose
He showed a mighty sign,
A sign nobody ever showed
To confirm His honour.
The mighty sign is this
He ascended to heaven
Without a wing and no ladder
He went into the skies.
His many disciples
Were sad that He has gone,
With love He gave them the promise
That He'll come back again.
When He will come again
It's with great power and might
And He shall gather all His own
To His Father above.
O Lord, count me among
Those that belong to Thee,
To be with Thee for ever in
Thy kingdom without end.

hymns.title: After this dismal and dark world
lyrics: After this dismal and dark world
Eternal glory waits
A country of eternal joy
No mortal eye hath seen
Our eyes long to see half Thy joy
Beautiful city, bright
How our hearts would have wished to leave
This world, the vale of tears
No sickness nor pain will be there
No sorrow will be there,
It's health and joy e'en all day long,
Pleasures that never end
No night in those fair cities bright
It is perpetual day
For sin, the source of all the curse
Will not enter therein
May this cherished hope of heaven
Set all our hearts aflame
Grant to us that this faith and love
Lift high our thoughts to God
O Lord, in mercy, make us meet
For Thy bright courts above,
And grant that our hearts may prepare
To join the heavenly throng

hymns.title: Jesus is coming with joy in the sky
lyrics: Jesus is coming with joy in the sky
Oh happy day! oh, happy day!
Then all who love Him shall heaven-ward fly:
Oh happy day! happy day!
Upward shall fly to the Lord in the air,
Together with Jesus we all shall be there,
Far from the earth and from sorrow and care:
Oh happy day! happy day!
Parents and children shall then again meet;
Oh happy day! oh happy day!
Sisters and brothers oh, it will be sweet!
Oh happy day! happy day!
We missed them on earth, to Jesus they went;
We love them as ever their absence lament
Soon we shall meet them and then be content,
Oh happy day! happy day!
Are we all ready, should Jesus now call?
Oh happy day! oh happy day!
Would each one answer, the great and the small?
Oh happy day! happy day!
We long to rise up and with thee to be,
Thy face, blessed Jesus Our Saviour to see
Would you then, dear children, sing sweetly with me?
Oh happy day! happy day!
Some would stay weeping unable to sing,
Oh happy day! oh happy day!
Yet all may rejoice and their glad praises bring;
Oh happy day! happy day!
For Jesus still waits, He tarries that we
May trust in His name, and thus ready may be,
When brightly beaming, His glory we see:
Oh happy day! happy day!

hymns.title: My heart is carried out beyond
lyrics: My heart is carried out beyond
The grace I now retain,
To heights and depths and lengths and breadths
That thru the Blood I gain,
The world for me has lost its charms,
I'm out and out for God,
I've felt the cleansing Stream flow thru,
And Jesus lift the rod
I'm now secure beneath His wings,
No storm can harm my soul,
My heart in very rapture sings,
I'm sealed to reach the goal
I crave to be an instrument
In God's own hand to guide
Lost sinners to the Living One
That they in Him may hide
chorus: He made me what I am
He made me what I am
Tho' stained with guilt, His Blood He spilt,
To make me what I am

hymns.title: The roseate hues early dawn
lyrics: The roseate hues of early dawn
The brightness of the day,
The crimson of the sunset sky,
How fast they fade away:
Oh for the pearly gates of heaven;
Oh for the golden floor,
Oh for the Sun of Righteousness
That setteth never more!
The highest hopes we cherish here,
How fast they tire and faint;
How many a spot defiles the robe
That wraps an earthly saint:
Oh for a heart that never sins;
Oh for a soul washed white;
Oh for a voice to praise our King,
Nor weary day or night!
Here faith is ours, and heavenly hope,
And grace to lead us higher;
But there are perfectness and peace
Beyond our best desire,
Oh by Thy love and anguish, Lord,
Oh by Thy life laid down,
Grant that we fall not from Thy grace,
Nor cast away our crown

hymns.title: Jesus my life, dwell thou in me
lyrics: Jesus my life, dwell thou in me
Fill me with Thy spirit
Nail to the cross, vile affections
According to Thy death
Thou who art Victor over sin
I want to be holy
Wash my heart, destroy sin nature
Reign in my heart for aye
As the old Adam dies in me,
Thy Spirit will fill it
Jesus, bury me in Thy grave
That I may rise with Thee
Reign in me, conquer Thou the foe
That does not bow to Thee
Bestow Thy image in my heart
And be my light alway
Take care of my imperfections
Make me Thy dwelling place
Fill all my heart with glory
As temple built by God

hymns.title: Keep from presemptuous sin
lyrics: Keep from presemptuous sin
It is what my God hates
Lord, create in me a clean heart,
Renew a right spirit
Then shall this heart of mine
Hate filthiness within
In love Thou hast sanctified it
It will not sin again
Thy commandment is pure
Jesus, teach me Thy laws
Thy Spirit gives laws that bring life
Write them upon my heart
Plant them deep in my heart
That it may ne'er be moved
Law of freedom from transgressions
The perfect law of love
Let your life become mine
A life that is spotless
Draw Thou my heart closer to Thee
Every hour of the day
Life and Spirit Thou art
Redeemer of the world
Make Thou my Father's will in heav'n
Be done in me, I pray

hymns.title: Called, once more, my work to pursue
lyrics: Called, once more, my work to pursue
With joy, I'll do my best
I'll put heart and soul into it
In Thy name, Lord Jesus
Thou art the end of my labour
Thee only do I see
Accept this Holy sacrifice
This labour is for Thee
Father, look down in love upon
This work that is Thy own,
Jesus, let this offering of mine
Be mixed, Lord, with Thine own
When my work is acceptable
Thou wilt then receive it
And Thou wilt be happy with me
That I am Thy good child

hymns.title: Those who make their labour druggery
lyrics: Those who make their labour druggery
Do the Lord's work with idleness,
Those who make religion a cloak
Do not understand work and faith;
They seperate what God has joined:
Diligence with devotedness.
The work we do are established
When it's done with the Spirit's zeal
God, who created days and nights
Decreed to rest on the seventh
As we work to redeem the time
Pleases our God whom we worship.
We all rejoice if God gives us
Such labour with enthusiasm,
Because such work that He commands
Shall be offering for His glory;
Like saints above, as we worship,
It swells our fellowship of love.

hymns.title: The heathens perish day by day
lyrics: The heathens perish day by day
Thousands, pass to eternity
Christians, hurry, they must be saved
Give them the word, before they die.
Mercy, riches, give as offering
Spend, be spent, so they may have life
For what Jesus has done for you
How do you hope to pay Him back?

hymns.title: The Lord God has made Jesus Christ
lyrics: The Lord God has made Jesus Christ
An atonement for sin
He it is on whom my heart trusts,
On whom I hang my faith.
God has shown favour to the blood
Of His Son, Jesus Christ
He has taken the blood into
The holy place on high.
There, the blood of sprinkling speaketh
Better things for us all
And there sweet incense is offered
Up, by our Great High Priest.
The angels look on with surprise
And they bow down their heads
Because of the mercy of God
That saved us by His blood.
I shall come near by faith unto
This holy place to plead
I will sing unto the Saviour,
Him pray to save my soul.
The song I sing is sanctified
By that same precious blood
By faith, it is a sweet refrain,
A foretaste of heaven.

hymns.title: When Jesus to heav'n ascended
lyrics: When Jesus to heav'n ascended
In vict'ry over all His foes
He gave rich gifts unto all men
His goodness was proclaimed abroad.
Through them we had the Apostles
Their pure lives far outshines all fame
Such like them are humble people
As pastors, priests and as teachers.
Christ is the good source of their gifts
He is their very life and grace
As He upholds them by His hand
They stand, unmoved, in afflictions.
Their generations shall not cease
Until the world comes to an end
Through them new bodies will be formed
And shall continue to expand.
Jesus, grant that our hearts may know
The source from where these blessings flow
That the church and pastor praise Thee
For ever, till the world without end.

hymns.title: The Lord is harvesting souls
lyrics: The Lord is harvesting souls
In the world's harvest fields
Where the angels from on High
Shall gather all their sheaves
Accept these as Thy reapers
Put a love in their hearts
Through their labour, let us haste,
Thy kingdom come on earth.
Make them as labourers
In Thy vineyard, O Lord
Give them the satisfaction
To do their work for Thee
When Thou wills to call them home
Let them be satisfied,
Labourers with Thee, O Lord
To bring Thy kingdom in.
Father, continue with them
Son, may Thou dwell with them
Holy Spirit, watch Thou them
The blessed Trinity
Make them real pastors of Thine
Who will serve Thee in truth
Bless them with Thy goodness, Lord
Now and forever more.
Come, Thou Holy Spirit, come,
And fill us with Thy light
Clothe us with that spotless robe
Make us pure and holy
Be with us as we gather
In Thy holy presence
Sanctify Thy people Lord
Assembled in Thy house.

hymns.title: Jesus, deep secrets of Thy word
lyrics: Jesus, deep secrets of Thy word
Who can unfold its truth
Who is so wise, that understands,
Who its depth can fathom.
Who can open the Bible, Lord
And not feel conviction,
Whomsoever that one may be,
When sins are laid open.
Make Thou, Thy minister perfect
He whom you love and choose;
Keep him amidst the storms of life
And all its temptations.
That he may walk in holiness
Where all Thy people;
To make himself an example
Of righteousness and light.
And when he stands before the flock
Those that Thou has redeemed;
Whether to blame them or to praise
Let it be as Thy word.
Pour out Thy spirit upon him
And Thy full blessings, Lord
Feed him that may also feed
Thy flock with bread of life.

hymns.title: Reverence is due Thy annointed
lyrics: Reverence is due Thy annointed,
Messenger of Thy holy word;
His position must honoured be,
Give him the  praise and honour him.
His position is delicate,
His garment must not be spotted,
Let us support him with our love
And humbly listen to his words.
Since it has pleased Thee to make him
A watchman to watch o'er our souls,
Grant him patience to lead us still,
Abundance of perseverance.
By our actions, not to grieve
Nor his patience us to exhaust;
As his days, so shall his strength be
Give him grace meet for his office.
Let us Thy beauty in him see,
Let him grow in humility,
His place as shepherd, let him keep
And know our own place as his sheep.

hymns.title: The work of God is hard to do
lyrics: The work of God is hard to do
Rise up and fight for Him
Upon the battle fields of life
We should not be dismayed.
O ye that work for God, arise
Appreciate God's greatness,
How fierce the battle may become
You must fight on bravely.
Do not regard the praise of men
Suffer all loss for God,
Christ won, not caring for mockery
He calls you to His way.
Truth shall surely prevail at last
As long as God liveth;
For doubt is sure rebellion
And backsliding is sin.

hymns.title: Thou who art fount of all good things
lyrics: Thou who art fount of all good things
We want to do Thy will,
What is it we can give to Thee
Thou King of all the earth
Lord, in this world Thou hast the poor
Who are Thine own people
Their names Thou promised to confess
Before Thy Father's throne.
And when they cry out in their pain
It is Thy cry, we hear,
When we rise up to care for them
We are caring for Thee.
Jesus, accept our offer-ing
Bestow Thy blessings there
Pour out Thy blessings on our gifts
Which are given the poor.
To Father, Son and Holy Ghost
Our God whom we adore
Be glory now and evermore
Ever world without end.

hymns.title: I need not lack for inward power
lyrics: I need not lack for inward power
To live a righteous life;
For God is with me
Every hour to help me in the strife.
I need not lack for friendship true,
For Jesus is my friend;
Though other friends are sometimes few,
He loves us to the end.
I need not lack for joy sublime,
His joy remains in me;
Earths pleasure last but for a time,
His last eternally.
I need not lack for anything,
For God is all in all;
And so each day His praise I sing,
And on His name I call.
chorus: O that I might fully trust Him!
For I know that He is nigh;
He will never leave me helpless
All my needs He will supply.

hymns.title: When we start for the land of heavenly rest
lyrics: When we start for the land of heavenly rest,
Keep close to Jesus all the way;
For He is the Guide, and He knows the way best;
Keep close to Jesus all the way.
Never mind the storms or trials as you go,
Keep close to Jesus all the way;
'Tis a comfort and joy His favour to know,
Keep close to Jesus all the way.
To be safe from the darts of the evil one,
Keep close to Jesus all the way;
Take the shield of faith till the victory is won,
Keep close to Jesus all the way.
We shall reach our home in heaven by and by,
Keep close to Jesus all the way,
Where to those we love we'll never say goodbye,
Keep close to Jesus all the way.
chorus: Keep close to Jesus, keep close to Jesus,
Keep close to Jesus all the way,
By day or by night never turn from the right,
Keep close to Jesus all the way.

hymns.title: Jesus commands that we should watch
lyrics: Jesus commands that we should pray
Every hour of the day,
He sends a revival to those
Who pray for revival.
Jesus commands that we shoulds pray
To fight on and not faint,
O Lord, make us to hear Thy call,
Obedience is our life.
Jesus commands that we should watch
The hour is near at hand
That He shall call us from this world
To our home up in heav'n.
Jesus, we love to pray to Thee
We love to hear Thy voice
We love to walk in Thy precepts
To where joy never ends.

hymns.title: Fierce storms may beat around me
lyrics: Fierce storms may beat around me,
And temptation strong confound me,
Still I need not fear if my Lord is near,
While His loving voice I hear.
Friends untrue may oft distress me,
And the cares of life oppress me;
Still I'll trust His love, for He reigns above,
And my faith in Him I'll prove.
Though I may not understand it,
Still His precious word commands it,
In the dark or light, trust by faith not sight
He will bring all things out right.
chorus: None of these things shall ever move me
While I in Him abide,
He is my comfort and helper
Jesus the crucified.

hymns.title: Trust not in physicians, for trusting is sin
lyrics: Trust not in physicians, for trusting is sin
One vict'ry will give you more strength to o'ercome
Just look up in faith and you will conquer through
Just keep close to Jesus, He will carry you through.
Refrain altogether, from using med'cine,
Trust fully on the arm of the Lord alone
Be faithful, stand boldly and with a pure heart
Just keep close to Jesus, He will carry you through.
The Lord will give strength to all those who believe
We'll conquer, we'll triumph, all through faith alone;
God gives us the promise our strength to renew
Just keep close to Jesus, He will carry you through.
chorus: Ask the Saviour to help you,
To uphold and deliver,
He is willing to heal you,
He will carry you through.

hymns.title: O Almighty, use Thy rod
lyrics: O Almighty, use Thy rod
To touch thou my head gently,
Make Thou Thine anger to cease,
Let me not fall under it.
Heal Thou my infirmity
Look on me, I seek Thy grace;
This alone, my only  plea
Look on me in Thy mercy.
Who is it, deep in the grave
Who can talk of deliverance?
O Lord, sustain Thou my soul,
Utter Thy voice, I will live.
Look! He comes, He heard my plea,
Here He comes, and shadows flee!
What glory surrounds me now!
O my soul, arise, and sing.

hymns.title: They have reach'd yon golden shore
lyrics: They have reach'd yon golden shore,
Up in heav'n; up in heav'n;
They shall hunger there no more,
They are ever free from pain,
Up in heav'n; up in heav'n.
There they need no light or lamp,
Up in heav'n; up in heav'n;
There they have perpetual light,
Jesus is their shining light,
Up in heav'n; up in heav'n.
Ah, the streets are made of gold,
Up in heav'n; up in heav'n;
There the glory never fades,
For the flock of Christ they are,
Up in heav'n; up in heav'n
It is never chilly there,
Up in heav'n; up in heav'n;
For their winter is all past,
Every day is ever bright,
Up in heav'n; up in heav'n
They have all ceased from their fight,
Up in heav'n; up in heav'n;
Jesus Christ has saved their souls,
They with Him walk hand in hand,
Up in heav'n; up in heav'n.
They shall no more cry nor weep,
Up in heav'n; up in heav'n;
Jesus is always with them,
With Him is abundant joy,
Up in heav'n; up in heav'n.
Ah, we shall soon join the throng,
Up in heav'n; up in heav'n;
We expect our time to come,
When our Lord shall call us home,
Up in heav'n; up in heav'n.

hymns.title: Jesu, meek and gentle
lyrics: Jesus, meek and gentle,
Son of God most High;
Pitying, loving Saviour,
Hear Thy children's cry.
Pardon our offences,
Loose our captive chains,
Break down every idol
Which our soul detains.
Give us holy freedom,
Fill our hearts with love;
Draw us, holy Jesu,
To the realms above.
Lead us on our journey,
Be Thyself the way
Through terrestrial darkness
To celestial day.
Jesus, meek and gentle,
Son of God most High;
Pitying, loving Saviour,
Hear Thy children's cry.

hymns.title: Almighty God, send out Thy light
lyrics: Almighty God, send out Thy light
To Thy children, we pray
That we may love and worship Thee
From childhood till old age.
For we have sinned and are all blind
Walking the way of death,
In our hearts and all our actions
We are Thy enemies.
Taught by our close friend and teacher
We are under control;
Taught to come near and seek Thy face
We cannot seek in vain.
Unto the hills we'll lift our eyes
From whence come salvation,
O Sun of Righteousness arise
To heal and make us whole.
Arise and shine in this dark world
Keep shining ever more
Until we shall grow to old age
The Christian's footstep, guide.

hymns.title: If I'm more eloquent than Jews
lyrics: If I'm more eloquent than Jews
And I speak more tongues than angels
Without love, I am like the brass
Sounding so harsh unto the ears.
If I can, by my wisdom, preach
And tell all that is done in heav'n
If my faith can remove mountains
Yet without love, I am all vain.
If I give all the things I have
As charity unto the poor
If I give myself to be burnt
To receive a martyr's glory.
If I do not love God and man
All of my hope is nothing worth
Whatever talents we may have
None can compare with divine love.

hymns.title: Brethen let us walk together
lyrics: Brethen let us walk together
In love and the peace of God
Ought we to begin to question
Whether we should cease all strife?
In communion, sweet communion
Will our love and joy increase.
As we make our journey homeward
Let us help ourselves along
Our foes encircle us around
Snares are laid out on our way
Our duty is, our duty is
To bear each other's burden.
When we think of what God has done
In forgiving o'er and o'er
Brethren, ought we not to learn that
Striving should be set aside
Let us avoid, let us avoid
All the anger and the strife.
Let us seek our brother's honour
More than we would seek our own
Let us leave all spite and hatred
And our hearts be filled with love
'Twill be sweeter, 'twill be sweeter
If we're in oneness on earth.

hymns.title: The peace of God unto the heart
lyrics: The peace of God unto the heart
Where there is divine love
And love is the greatest of all
Our talents and our gifts.
All the faith we possess is vain
As well as all our fear
Sin will soon overcome our hearts
Without God's divine love.
Love will outlive all other things
Whether our faith or hope
Love will be the theme of our song
Up there in heav'n above.

hymns.title: Dwell with us by Thy grace, O Lord
lyrics: Dwell with us by Thy grace, O Lord
Jesus Christ our Saviour,
That the spirit of craftiness
Do not come into us.
Dwell with us by Thy holy word
Most precious Jesus Christ,
That we find salvation and life
Up in heav'n as on earth.
Dwell with us with Thy blessing Lord,
Our rich and wondrous Lord,
Grant Thy good heav'nly gift, dear Lord
To us abundantly.
Dwell with us with Thy protection
Our great and mighty God
That we refuse the enemy
And the world hold us not
Dwell with us, O Lord, with Thy truth
Our good and gracious Lord,
In our affliction dwell with us
Make us to persevere.
Dwell with us with Thy peace O God,
When the death hour is come,
At that moment, speak Thou to us
You redemption is come.

hymns.title: The Chief Controller of heaven
lyrics: The Chief Controller of heaven,
Merciful and all wise God;
My times are in Thy hand, Lord,
Thy word is the end of all.
By Thy word the world was made
My birth also by the word,
Parents, lands and things of time
They are all made by the word.
Times of sickness and of health,
Times of poverty and wealth,
Times of temptations and wrath,
Times of vict'ry and of help.
Times to know Satan's tactics
Times of taste of Jesus love,
Seasons come and seasons go,
As our friend in heaven wills.
Thou who art full of all grace,
I to Thee my soul commend,
I will confess Thy great love,
I bend down my knees to Thee.

hymns.title: Jesu, with Thy church abide
lyrics: Jesu, with Thy church abide,
Be her Saviour, Lord, and Guide;
While on earth her faith is tried;
Arms of love around her throw,
Shield her safe from every foe,
Calm her in the time of woe;
Keep her life and doctrine pure,
Help her, patient to endure,
Trusting in Thy promise sure;
Be Thou with her all the days,
May she, safe from error's ways,
Toil for Thine eternal praise:
May her voice be ever clear,
Warning of a judgement near,
Telling of a Saviour dear;
All her ruined works repair,
Build again Thy temple fair,
Manifest Thy presence there:
All her fettered powers release,
Bid all strife and envy cease,
Grant the heavenly gift of peace:
All her questions reconcile,
Let not Satan's touch defile,
Let not worldly snares beguile:
May she one in doctrine be,
One in truth and charity,
Winning all to faith in Thee:
chorus: We beseech Thee, hear us.

hymns.title: I will rest and tell the story
lyrics: I will rest and tell the story,
How He won my sinful heart;
How He brought me to the Fountain,
Where I never will depart.
Oh, my soul is waiting, longing,
I would leave this vale of tears;
I would fly beyond the regions,
Where the soul will have no fears.
Yes, my work is nearly over,
For my Saviour soon will come,
He will take me home to Glory,
Where I'll be at rest with Him.
Jesus, Jesus, how I've suffered;
How the billows high have rolled;
How my soul has nearly fainted
As I tried to reach the goal.
But at last within the portals,
Tears and suffering all are past,
He will fold me to His bosom,
Whispering, ''Child you're safe at last.''
chorus: Oh, the rapture that awaits me,
When I'm done on earth below!
How I'll rest within His bosom,
How I'll love Him ever more!

hymns.title: The soul that would live close to Jesus
lyrics: The soul that would live close to Jesus,
Is He who spends much time in prayer.
Although it may not always please us,
'Tis that which relieves us from care.
'Twas Elijah that prayed on Mount Carmel,
And the heavens gave ear to his cry;
And I'm sure it was not very formal,
For fire came down from the sky.
We read that a prophet for praying
Was cast to the lions to eat;
But an angel prevented the slaying,
And delivered old Daniel complete.
