No foe have I to fear,
He rolls the sea away!

hymns.title: I've seen the face of Jesus
hymns.author: W. Spencer Walton
lyrics: I’ve seen the face of Jesus—
He smiled in love on me;
It filled my heart with rapture,
My soul with ecstasy.
The scars of deepest anguish
Were lost in glory bright;
I’ve seen the face of Jesus—
It was a wondrous sight!
And since I’ve seen His beauty
All else I count but loss;
The world, its fame and pleasure,
Is now to me but dross;
His light dispelled my darkness,
His smile was, oh, so sweet!
I’ve seen the face of Jesus—
I can but kiss His feet.
I’ve heard the voice of Jesus—
He told me of His love;
And called me His own treasure,
His undefiled, His dove.
It came like softest music
Across an ocean calm,
And seemed to play so sweetly
Some wondrous holy psalm.
I felt the hand of Jesus—
My brow it throbbed with care—
He placed it there so softly,
And whispered Do not fear.
Like clouds before the sunshine,
My cares have rolled away;
I’m sitting in His presence—
It is a cloudless day.
I know He’s coming shortly
To take us all above;
We’ll sing redemption’s story
The story of His love;
We’ll hear His voice of music,
We’ll feel His hand of care;
He’ll never rest, He says so,
Until He has us there.
Source: The Cyber Hymnal #11436
chorus: Oh! glorious face of beauty,
Oh, gentle touch of care;
If here it is so blessèd,
What will it be up there?

hymns.title: I will sing the gospel story
lyrics: I will sing the wondrous story
Of the Christ Who died for me;
How He left His home in glory
For the cross of Calvary.
I was lost, but Jesus found me,
Found the sheep that went astray,
Threw His loving arms around me,
Drew me back into His way.
I was bruised, but Jesus healed me,
Faint was I from many a fall,
Sight was gone, and fears possessed me,
But He freed me from them all.
Days of darkness still come o’er me,
Sorrow’s path I often tread,
But His presence still is with me;
By His guiding hand I’m led.
He will keep me till the river
Rolls its waters at my feet;
Then He’ll bear me safely over,
Where the loved ones I shall meet.
chorus: Yes, I’ll sing the wondrous story
Of the Christ Who died for me,
Sing it with the saints in glory,
Gathered by the crystal sea.

hymns.title: Saved by grace alone, God's own Word believing
hymns.author: J. H. Sammis
lyrics: Saved by grace alone, God’s own Word believing—
It is glory all the way!
Walking in the light, daily grace receiving—
It is glory all the way!
Not a care have I since my Saviour careth—
It is glory all the way!
Guided by His eye, while with me He fareth—
It is glory all the way!
Severed from the world, His dear name confessing—
It is glory all the way!
Taking up the cross, sharing in the blessing—
It is glory all the way!
Sinner, put your trust in this loving Saviour—
It is glory all the way!
Freely He forgives all our past behavior—
It is glory all the way!
Working day by day, minded that He sees us—
It is glory all the way!
Watch and wait and pray, Looking unto Jesus—
It is glory all the way!
Source: The Voice of Thanksgiving #32
chorus: Glory! Glory!
It is glory all the way!
Glory! Glory!
It is glory all the way!

hymns.title: I was drifting away on life's pitiless sea
hymns.author: M. J. Cartwright
lyrics: I was drifting away on life’s pitiless sea,
And the angry waves threatened my ruin to be,
When away at my side, there I dimly descried
A stately old vessel, and loudly I cried:
"Ship ahoy!" "Ship ahoy!"
And loudly I cried: "Ship ahoy!"
’Twas the "old ship of Zion," thus sailing along,
All aboard her seemed joyous, I heard their sweet song;
And the captain’s kind ear, ever ready to hear,
Caught my wail of distress, as I cried out in fear:
"Ship ahoy!" "Ship ahoy!"
As I cried out in fear: "Ship ahoy!"
The good Captain commanded a boat to be low’red,
And with tender compassion He took me on board;
And I’m happy today, all my sins washed away
In the blood of my Savior, and now I can say:
"Bless the Lord!" "Bless the Lord!"
From my soul I can say: "Bless the Lord!"
O soul, sinking down ’neath sin’s merciless wave,
The strong arm of our Captain is mighty to save;
Then trust Him today, no longer delay,
Board the old ship of Zion, and shout on your way:
"Jesus saves!" "Jesus saves!"
Shout and sing on your way: "Jesus saves!"
Source: Bible Truth Hymns #210

hymns.title: My body, soul and spirit
hymns.author: Mary D. James
lyrics: My body, soul and spirit,
Jesus, I give to thee,
A consecrated offering,
Thine evermore to be.
O Jesus, mighty Saviour,
I trust in thy great name;
I look for thy salvation,
Thy promise now I claim.
O let the fire, descending
Just now upon my soul,
Consume my humble offering,
And cleanse and make me whole!
I’m thine, O blessèd Jesus,
Washed by thy precious blood;
Now seal me by thy Spirit
A sacrifice to God.
Source: The Song Book of the Salvation Army #511
chorus: My all is on the altar,
I’m waiting for the fire;
Waiting, waiting, waiting,
I’m waiting for the fire.

hymns.title: My life to the Savior I gave
hymns.author: E. T.
lyrics: My life to the Savior I gave,
And thus I became His slave;
And now by His power, I’m living each hour,
And doing the will of God.
In peace I am living each day,
As heav’nward I wend my way;
The path is so bright, I know I am right,
And doing the will of God.
The story to others I tell,
That with my soul it is well;
That they, too, may share the home over there,
By doing the will of God.
The Savior is coming again,
And then over all He’ll reign;
The sin that we fear will then disappear,
For that is the will of God.
Source: The Cyber Hymnal #1253
chorus: Doing the will of God,
Doing the will of God;
I’m happy and free,
And the sweet thing to me
Is doing the will of God.

hymns.title: When they crucified my Savior
hymns.author: Mrs. Elizabeth Miller
lyrics: When they crucified my Savior
On the cross of Calvary,
There a blessèd fount was opened
For my cleansing, full and free;
And my sins were all forgiven
Just by faith in His shed blood;
They are washed away forever
By the crimson flood.
Now I plead the blood of Jesus,
And He’s with me all the way;
I am happy and rejoicing
In His favor every day;
In the burden and the trial,
There is none so kind as He;
My Redeemer is my kinsman,
And His blood saves me.
He will robe me with white raiment
When my pilgrimage is past;
And present me pure and spotless
With the sanctified at last;
I will sing His praise and glory
Unto all eternity,
Telling evermore the story
How His blood saved me.
Source: The Cyber Hymnal #887
chorus: It cleanseth me! It cleanseth me!
The precious blood of Jesus
Fully cleanseth me.
It cleanseth me! It cleanseth me!
The precious blood of Jesus
Fully cleanseth me.

hymns.title: There's peace in my heart tonight
hymns.author: Helen A. Himes
lyrics: There’s peace in my heart tonight,
So sweet, and still, and strong;
And into my life has dawned a light,
Which fills my heart with song.
Peace, peace, wonderful peace,
Peace from the heart of God;
Peace, peace, wonderful peace,
Peace from the heart of God.
There’s joy in my heart tonight,
So full, so pure, so deep;
The Father of love hath given to me
The gift of gifts to keep.
Joy, joy, wonderful joy,
Joy in my heart tonight;
Joy, joy, wonderful joy,
Joy in my heart tonight.
The Lord to my heart has come;
He deigns to dwell with me;
He cleanses my life from stain of sin
That I like Him may be.
Sing, sing, joyfully sing,
Sing of His love to me,
Sing, sing, joyfully sing,
Sing of His love to me.
Source: The Cyber Hymnal #6594

hymns.title: When I walk thro' the valley of shadow and gloom
hymns.author: E. S. L.
lyrics: When I walk thro’ the valley of shadow and gloom,
When my soul is depressed, and to doubting gives room,
Still a promise I have that my path doth illume,—
My Savior is praying for me!
Tho’ temptations are many, tho’ enemies rail,
Tho’ my sins rise in judgment and courage would fail,
An assurance I have that o’er all I’ll prevail,—
My Savior is praying for me!
I am sure that my Savior knows well all my needs,
That he urges my claims, my necessity pleads;
Shall the Father not hear when his Son intercedes?—
My Savior is praying for me!
Then rejoicing I’ll go, tho’ the way may seem long,
With my heart filled with love and my lips thrilled with song;
Tho’ all else may forsake me, in this I am strong,—
My Savior is praying for me!
Source: Songs of Revival Power #8
chorus: My Savior is praying for me!
My Savior is praying for me!
I will doubt not, nor fear, this my infinite cheer:
My Savior is praying for me!

hymns.title: My blessed Savior holds my hand
hymns.author: Maggie E. Gregory
lyrics: My blessed Savior holds my hand,
And leads me day by day;
He knows the dangers of the land,
For he has passed this way.
My blessed Savior holds my hand,
And he will guide aright;
While I obey his blest command
My path is crowned with light.
My blessed Savior holds my hand,
A tender guide is he;
He’ll lead me to the glory-land
Beyond the silent sea.
So, while my Savior holds my hand,
I cannot go astray;
With him I’ll walk the golden strand
Of everlasting day.
Source: Songs of Revival Power #9
chorus: He’ll never let go my hand
He’ll never let go my hand,
I love him so, and he loves me; I know,
He’ll never let go my hand.

hymns.title: I am clinging to the Rock
hymns.author: W. O. Cushing
lyrics: I am clinging to the Rock,
Tho’ the waves are wild and dark,
Tho’ the angry billows o’er me roll;
For I can not be afraid,
And my heart is undismayed,
While the Savior is the anchor of my soul.
I am clinging to the Rock,
Tho’ the way be lone and dark,
Tho’ the dreary shadows round me lie;
There are gleaming stars that shine
O’er this weary path of mine,
They will light me into joys that never die.
I am clinging to the Rock,
And I fear no tempest shock,
Tho’ the fiery darts of Satan fly;
For my feet are standing sure
On the Rock that shall endure,
When the earth and seas and skies are passed away.
Source: Pearls of Praise #104
chorus: Yes, I’m clinging to the Rock,
I am clinging to the Rock for evermore,
And there’s refuge there for me;
On the Savior trust, there’s refuge there.

hymns.title: Tis the love of Jesus cheers our hearts today
hymns.author: L. B. M.
lyrics: ’Tis the love of Jesus cheers our hearts today,
Makes our earth an Eden, drives the clouds away.
’Tis the love of Jesus lightens every task,
Gives us strength and comfort, more than we can ask.
’Tis the love of Jesus makes our pathway bright,
Fills our hearts with singing, and our lives with light.
Blessèd love of Jesus, freely to us giv’n,
Theme of all the ages, sweetest song of Heav’n.
Source: The Cyber Hymnal #3994
chorus: Love of Jesus, love unbounded, love so free,
Sweetest story ever told to me!

hymns.title: So tender, so precious
hymns.author: J. E. Rankin, D. D.
lyrics: So tender, so precious,
My Savior, to me;
So true and so gracious
I’ve found him to be.
So patient, so kindly
T’ward all of my ways;
I blunder so blindly—
He love still repays.
Of all friends the fairest
And truest is he;
His love is the rarest
That ever can be.
His beauty, tho’ bleeding
And circled with thorns,
Is then most exceeding,
For grief him adorns.
Source: United Praise: for use in Sunday Schools, Young People's Societies and other Church Services #228
chorus: How can I but love him?
But love him, but love him?
There’s no friend above him,
Poor sinner, for thee.

hymns.title: Lord, weak and impotent I stand
hymns.author: M. A. W. Cook
lyrics: Lord, weak and impotent I stand,
As fettered by an unseen hand;
Break Thou the strong and subtle band,
And draw me close to Thee.
In vain I struggle to be free;
I would, but can not, fly to Thee;
Ope Thou the prison door for me,
And draw me close to Thee.
Oh, bring me nearer, nearer still,
That Thine own peace my soul may fill,
And I may rest in Thy sweet will;
Lord, draw me close to Thee.
Here, Lord, I would forever bide,
And never wander from Thy side;
Beneath Thy wing do Thou me hide,
And draw me close to Thee.
Source: The Cyber Hymnal #1261
chorus: Draw me close to Thee, Savior,
Draw me close to Thee;
Beneath Thy wing do Thou me hide,
And draw me close to Thee.

hymns.title: Oh, come, and dwell in me
hymns.author: Charles Wesley
lyrics: O come and dwell in me,
Spirit of pow'r within,
and bring the glorious liberty
from sorrow, fear, and sin.
Hasten the joyful day
which shall my sins consume,
when old things shall be done away,
and all things new become.
I want the witness, Lord,
that all I do is right,
according to Thy mind and word,
well-pleasing in Thy sight.
I ask no higher state;
indulge me but in this,
and soon or later then translate
to Thine eternal bliss.
Source: Our Great Redeemer's Praise #298

hymns.title: In vain in high and holy lays
hymns.author: E. D. Mund
lyrics: In vain in high and holy lays
My soul her grateful voice would raise;
For who can sing the worthy praise
Of the wonderful love of Jesus!
A joy by day, a peace by night,
In storms a calm, in darkness light;
In pain a balm, in weakness might
Is the wonderful love of Jesus.
My hope for pardon when I call,
My trust for lifting when I fall;
In life, in death, my all in all,
Is the wonderful love of Jesus.
Source: Christian Hymns: for every purpose in worship #232
chorus: Wonderful love! wonderful love!
Wonderful love of Jesus!
Wonderful love! wonderful love!
Wonderful love of Jesus!

hymns.title: Thus far the Lord has led me on
hymns.author: Isaac Watts
lyrics: Thus far the Lord hath led me on,
Thus far His pow'r prolongs my days;
And ev'ry evening shall make known
Some fresh memorial of His grace.
Much of my time has run to waste,
And I, perhaps, am near my home;
But He forgives my follies past
And gives me strength for days to come.
I lay my body down to sleep;
Peace is the pillow for my head;
His ever-watchful eye will keep
Its constant guard around my bed.
Faith in Thy name forbids my fear;
O may Thy presence ne’er depart!
And in the morning may I bear
Thy loving-kindness on my heart!
Source: Evangelical Lutheran Hymnary #566

hymns.title: Jesus, thy name I love
hymns.author: James G. Deck
lyrics: Jesus, thy Name I love
All other names above,
Jesus, my Lord:
O thou art all to me;
Nothing to please I see,
Nothing apart from thee,
Jesus, my Lord.
Thou, blessed Son of God,
Hast bought me with thy blood,
Jesus, my Lord:
O how great is thy love,
All other loves above,
Love that I daily prove,
Jesus, my Lord.
When unto thee I flee,
Thou wilt my refuge be,
Jesus, my Lord:
What need I now to fear,
What earthly grief or care,
Since thou art ever near?
Jesus, my Lord.
Soon thou wilt come again;
I shall be happy then,
Jesus, my Lord:
Then thine own face I'll see,
Then I shall like thee be,
Then evermore with thee,
Jesus, my Lord.
Amen.
Source: Trinity Hymnal #546

hymns.title: My Shepherd is the Lord Most High
lyrics: My Shepherd is the Lord most high,
And all my wants shall be supplied;
In pastures green He makes me lie,
And leads by streams which gently glide.
He in His mercy doth restore
My soul, when sinking in distress;
For His name's sake He evermore
Leads me in paths of righteousness.
Yea, though I walk through death's dark vale,
Even there no evil will I fear;
Because Thy presence shall not fail,
Thy rod and staff my soul shall cheer.
For me a table Thou hast spread,
Prepared before the face of foes;
With oil Thou dost anoint my head;
My cup is filled and overflows.
Goodness and mercy shall not cease
Through all my days to follow me;
And in God's house my dwelling place
With Him forever more shall be.
Source: African Methodist Episcopal Church Hymnal #203

hymns.title: Give me the Bible, God's message divine
hymns.author: Harriett H. Pierson
lyrics: Give me the Bible, God's message divine,
Blessed old Bible! its message is mine;
News of salvation it brings from above,
Blest revelation of God and his love.
Rich is its treasure for him who will look;
Heart can not measure the sacred old book;
Wisdom of sages, more precious than gold,
Truth of the ages, for centuries told.
Doubts may assail us, God's promise is sure;
Joys of earth fail us, his word will endure;
Wonderful message of life and of love,
Glorious presage of rapture above.
Lives that are dreary the Bible has blessed;
Hearts that are weary it promises rest;
Solace in sorrow and joy in despair,
Hope for the morrow and comfort in pray'r.
chorus: God's message of love, sent down from above,
My guide on life's journey forever will be;
My refuge and tow'r, my secret of pow'r,
The blessed old Bible is precious to me.

hymns.title: When love is in the heart
hymns.author: W. C. Martin
lyrics: When love is in the heart,
All the world is bright with beauty;
There is joy in doing duty,
And the evils all depart,
When love is in the heart,
When love is in the heart.
When love is in the heart,
All the flowers bloom more brightly,
And the cares of life sit lightly;
Oh, what grace it doth impart!
When love is in the heart,
When love is in the heart.
When love is in the heart,
Earth and heaven all seem smiling;
There's no halting, no reviling;
Angry passions never start,
When love is in the heart,
When love is in the heart.
chorus: When love is in the heart,
Oh, when love is in the heart,
We are very much like Jesus,
When love is in the heart.

hymns.title: Speak as thy Savior would have thee
hymns.author: Mrs. Frank A. Breck
lyrics: Speak as thy Savior would have thee,
Guarding thy tho'ts day by day;
Out of the heart's full abundance
Spring forth the words that we say.
Go where thy Savior would have thee,
Ever his gospel proclaim;
Let us be faithful to witness,
Seek but to honor his name!
Cheerful-ly live for the Master,
Treading the path that is right;
Doing the work that lies nearest,
Doing it, too, “with thy might.”
chorus: Do nothing that you would not do, when Jesus comes;
Say nothing that you would not say, when Jesus comes;
Go nowhere that you would not go, when Jesus comes
To call his children home.

hymns.title: The heavy clouds obscure the sky
hymns.author: Harriett H. Pierson
lyrics: The heavy clouds obscure the sky
Above my head,
And where the dark'ning shadows lie
My feet must tread;
But One is ever near my side
To lead the way;
He who is Light will be my guide
To perfect day.
I climb a bare and craggy steep
By paths unknown,
And in the lonely vale I weep,
But not alone;
One whispers of the joy that waits
The journey's end,
The city fair, within whose gates
No shades descend.
What tho' no sunlight comes to greet
My longing eyes?
Some day will bring to me a sweet
And glad surprise;
Thro' darkest ways the Savior's hand
Will lead me on,
Until I reach the Morning Land,
And night is gone.
Beyond the shadows there is light,
And peace, and love;
'Twill dawn at last upon my sight—
The home above!
There I shall sing the Father's grace,
Life's sorrows o'er,
Behold the glory of his face
For evermore.
chorus: No shadows yonder, no lonely night,
Will ever come;
No sin will darken the light
Of the heav'nly home.

hymns.title: In His steps, oh, words so full of meaning
hymns.author: Cary
lyrics: In His steps, oh, words so full of meaning!
In His steps to follow day by day;
In His steps, the cross its radiance beaming,
In His steps, to guide us on our way.
In His steps, in joy, or pain, or sorrow,
In His steps, what-ever may befall;
In His steps, no fearing for the morrow,
In His steps, we're trusting him for all.
In His steps, no fear of sin's dominion,
In His steps, no fear of Satan's wiles;
In His steps, no fear of men's opinion,
In His steps, no evil now beguiles.
In His steps is pardon, peace and power,
In His steps is hope and joy and love;
In His steps is grace for ev'ry hour,
In His steps, leads to our home above.
chorus: “For hereunto are ye called,
Because Christ suffered for you.
Leaving you an example
That ye should follow in his steps.”

hymns.title: Has your heart e'er been touched by the mercy of God
hymns.author: Mrs. Frank A. Breck
lyrics: Has your heart been touched by the mer-cy of God?
And have you the rightjour-ney be-gun?
Are you walk-ing in faith with the Sav-ior di-vine?
Are you close to the Cru-ci-fied One?
Do you know of his friendship,so lasting and true?
Do you want his blestwill to bedone?
Are you liv-ing for Christ and his glo-ry a-lone?
Are you true to the Cru-cified One?
Is your place in his wonder-ful keep-ing secure?
And have you theya -tion he won?
Do you know the sweet joy of his presence so blest?
Are you glad in the Cru-cified One?

hymns.title: Hope for the weary, the promise of God
hymns.author: Harriett H. Pierson
lyrics: Hope for the wea-ry, the prom-isé of God,
Prom-ise un-failing andtrue;
Rest, bless-ed rest, is a-wait-ing in heay’n,
Wait-ing for me and for you.
Hope for the cap-tive in bond-age to sin,
